v: Ha t'a yichb'anel, ha Dios ixb'o'an satcha'anh yet' lum lum.

Ha t'a jun pekti' chi' malaj stzolal yaj jun yol yib'anhk'inal tik, tzinan yilji. Tonhej panhan ek' ha ha' t'a yib'anh lu'um. K'ik'olinak yilji masanil t'a yib'anh ha', haxo Yespíritu Dios tz'ek' t'a yib'anh ha' chi'.
Ixlajwi chi' ix yalan Dios icha tik: Ayokab' sakil k'inal, xchi. Icha chi' b'i'an ix sakb'i k'inal.
Ix yilan Dios to wach' jun sakil k'inal chi', ix spojanel sakil k'inal chi' t'a skal k'ik' k'inal.
Ha sakil k'inal chi', k'uhalil ix sb'i'ejkan yuj, haxo k'ik' k'inal chi', t'ak'walil ix sb'i'ejkani. Ix k'ik'b'i'emi, ix sakb'i, ix ek'el jun b'ab'el k'u.
Ixlajwi chi' ix yalan Dios icha tik: Ayokab' junok tas skan t'a yib'anh sat lu'um tik yik spojan snanhal ha ha', xchi.
Icha chi' b'i'an, ha Dios ixb'o'an jun chi'. Cha makan ix ajkanel ha ha' chi' yuj: Jun makan ha' ix kan t'a sat lum tik, junxo makan ha' ix k'ekan t'a yib'anh. Ichaton chi' ix aji.
Ha jun ix kan chi' “satcha'anh” ix sb'i'ejkani. Ix k'ik'b'ixi'emi, ix sakb'ixi, ix ek' schab'il k'uhal.
Ixlajwi chi' ix yalan Dios icha tik: Junxonhejokab' tz'aj ha ha' ay t'a yalanh satcha'anh yik scheklajkan lum lum t'a takinhal, xchi. Ichaton chi' ix aji.
Ha b'aj ix cheklajkan stak'inhal chi', “lu'um” ix sb'i'ejkani, haxo ha ha' junnhej ix aj chi', “mar” ix sb'i'ejkan ha'. Haxo ix yilan Dios chi', te wach' ix aji.

Ixlajwi chi' ix yalan icha tik: Pak'okab' anh ank'ultak t'a sat lum lum yet' te te' syak' sat. Ha t'a sat te' chi' yet' anh ank'ultak chi', hata' ay yinhatil hato syala' tas makanhil, xchi. Ichaton chi' ix aji.
Ichaton chi' ix aj spak' anh ank'ultak t'a sat lum lum tik, haton anh ank'ultak yet' te te' syak' sat hato syala' tas inhatil. Haxo ix yilan Dios te wach' ix aji.
Ix k'ik'b'ixi'emi ix sakb'ixi, ix ek' yoxil k'uhal.

Ixlajwi chi' ix yalan Dios icha tik: Ayokab' juntzanh sakil k'inal t'a satcha'anh yik syak' sakil k'inal t'a sat lu'um tik, yik sch'oxanel k'uhalil yet' t'ak'walil, yik scheklaj junjun k'u, junjun ab'il yet' juntzanh tiempo'al, xchi. Ichaton chi' ix aji.

Ha Dios ixb'o'an chab' niwak sakil k'inal. Ha jun niwan sk'ak'al ix och yopisio t'a k'uhalil, haxo jun kennhej sk'ak'al ix och yopisio t'ak'walil, haton k'u yet' k'e'en uj. Ix sb'o'anpax masanil k'e'en k'anal.
Ix yak'anoch juntzanh sakil k'inal chi' t'a satcha'anh yik syak' yok t'a sat lu'um tik
t'a k'uhalil yet' t'ak'walil yuj spojanpaxel sakil k'inal t'a k'ik' k'inal. Ix yilan Dios chi' te wach' ix aji.
Ix k'ik'b'ixi'emi, ix sakb'ixi, ix ek' schanhil k'uhal.
Ixlajwi chi' ix yalanxi Dios icha tik: Pitzwokab' nok' nok', nok' ay t'a yol ha ha' yet' masanil makanhil nok' much tz'ek' jenhenhok, xchi.
Ix sb'o'an nok' niwak nok' Dios chi', nok' ay t'a yol ha' mar yet' masanil makanhil nok' nok' ay t'a yol ha' chi' yet' masanil makanhil nok' much. Haxo ix yilani te wach' ix aji.

Ix yak'an swach'k'olal t'a yib'anh nok' nok' chi', ix yalan icha tik: Yune'ejokab' sb'a nok', k'ib'okab' sb'isul nok', b'ut'jokab'el yol ha' mar yuj nok'. Hanhejtona' nok' much, k'ib'okab' sb'isul nok' t'a yol yib'anhk'inal tik, xchi.
Ix k'ik'b'ixi'emi, ix sakb'ixi, ix ek' yo'il k'uhal.

Ixlajwi chi' ix yalan Dios icha tik: Pitzwokab' cha'anh masanil makan nok' nok' t'a sat lu'um tik, nok' molb'etzal nok', nok' k'ultakil nok' yet' nok' tz'ek' nhernhonok ma tz'ek' jachjon t'a sat lu'um, xchi. Ichaton chi' ix aji, ix sb'o'an masanil makanhil nok' nok' ay t'a sat lu'um tik. Ix yilani, te wach' ix aji.

Ixlajwi chi' ix yalan Dios icha tik: Ha tikne'ik ko b'o'ek anima icha honh tik yik wach' tz'och heb' yajalil t'a yib'anh nok' chay ay t'a yol ha' mar, t'a yib'anh masanil nok' much, t'a yib'anh nok' molb'etzal nok', t'a yib'anh nok' k'ultakil nok' yet' pax t'a yib'anh nok' tz'ek' nhernhonok ma tz'ek' jachjon t'a sat lu'um tik, xchi.
Ichato chi' ix b'oji heb' anima chi' yuj Dios, icha wal Dios chi' ix aj heb'. Ix b'ojikan winh winak yet' ix ix yuj.

Ixlajwi chi' ix yak'an swach'k'olal Dios t'a yib'anh heb'. Ix yalan t'a heb' icha tik: Aljokab' heyuninal, k'ib'okab' he b'isul, b'ut'jokab'el sat lum lum tik heyu'uj, ochanhek yajalil t'a yol yib'anhk'inal tik. Ochanhek yajalil t'a yib'anh nok' chay ay t'a yoltak ha ha', t'a yib'anh nok' much sjenhwi yet' t'a yib'anh masanil nok' tz'ek' nhernhonok ma tz'ek' jachjon t'a sat lum tik, xchi.
Ixlajwi chi', ix yalanxi t'a heb' anima chi' icha tik: Ha hin swak' masanil makanhil anh ank'ultak ay yinhatil yet' masanil te te' syak' sat he lo'o yik syak' yip t'a he niwanil.

Masanil nok' molb'etzal nok', nok' k'ultakil nok', nok' tz'ek' nhernhonok ma tz'ek' jachjon t'a sat lu'um yet' nok' much, ha hin swak' anh ank'ultak yet' xiltak te te' swa'elok nok', xchi. Icha chi' ix aji.
Ix yilanoch Dios, te wach' ix aj masanil tas ix sb'o'o. Ix k'ik'b'ixi'emi, ix sakb'ixi, ix ek' swakil k'uhal.
T'a wake' k'uhal ix sb'o satcha'anh Dios, lum lum yet' masanil tastak ay t'ay. Haxo t'a yukil k'uhal, ix och wa'an smunlaji.
Ix sik'anel jun yukil k'uhal chi' Dios, to yiknhej tz'ajkani, yik tz'ochkan swach'ilok heb' anima, yujto ha t'a jun k'u chi' ix b'o'elk'och masanil tas ix sb'o chi'.
Haton yab'ixal tas ix aj sb'o satcha'anh yet' lum lum tik. Ayik ix sb'o'an satcha'anh Jehová Dios yet' lum lum tik,
mantalaj junok te te' ma junok anh ank'ultak sk'ib'i, yujto mantalaj nhab' syak' t'a yib'anh lu'um yuj Jehová. Mantalaj pax mach smunlaj t'a sat lu'um.
Tonhej xob'ank'e'ul ha ha' t'a sat lu'um yik sch'ayxi lu'um.
Ha t'a jun pekti' chi', ix sb'o jun anima Jehová Dios. Ha spokokal lum lum ix yak'lab'ej sb'o'ani. Ixlajwi chi', haxo yik' ix spu'och t'a yol snhi'. Icha chi' ix aj spitzwi winh anima chi'.
Ix yawej juntzanh awb'en te' Jehová Dios t'a jun lugar skuch Edén, t'a stojolal b'aj sjawi k'u. Hata' ix yak'kanoch winh winak ix sb'o chi'.

Ix yak'an k'ib' masanil te te' te wach' yilji, manhxo jantakok swach'il sat te' syak'a', te wach' sloji. Ha t'a snanhal jun awb'en te' chi', ay jun te' tz'ak'an k 'inal, ay pax junxo te' tz'ak'an nachajel b'aj ay wach'il yet' chukal.
Ha t'a Edén chi', sk'e'ul jun ha ha' tz'ak'anoch yal masanil te' awb'en te' chi'. Haxo tz'el ha' t'a Edén chi', chanhe' tz'aj yel sk'ab' ha'.
Ha jun ha' b'ab'el, Pisón sb'i ha', haton ha' tz'ek' oyoyok t'a yol lum skuch Havila b'aj ay k'e'en oro.
Ha k'e'en oro ay t'a jun lugar chi', te wach' k'e'en. Ay pax juntzanh te te' ay stzatajil te sumumi sjab'. Ay pax juntzanh k'e'en k'e'en skuchan ónice te caro stojol.
Haxo ha' schab'il, Gihón sb'i ha'. Haton ha' tz'ek' oyoyok t'a yol lum skuchan Cus.
Haxo ha' yoxil, Tigris sb'i ha'. Haton ha' tz'ek' oyoyok t'a stojolal b'aj sjawi k'u t'a lum Asiria. Haxo ha' schanhil, haton ha' Éufrates.
Ix yak'ankan winh winak Jehová Dios t'a skal te' awb'en te' t'a Edén chi' yik smunlaj winh yik stanhwanpax winh.
Ix yalan Dios t'a winh icha tik: --Syal ha lo'an sat te te' tik smasanil.
Haxo pax te' tz'ak'an nachajel b'aj ay wach'il yet' chukal, manh ha lo sat te'. Tato ol ha lo sat te' chi', t'a wal yel ol hach chamok, xchi Dios t'a winh.
Ix yalanxi Jehová Dios icha tik: Manh wach'ok yajek' winh winak tik sch'okoj. Ol hin b'o junok yetb'eyum winh to smoj wal skolwaj yet'ok, xchi.

Masanil nok' nok' ix sb'o Dios t'a sat lum tik, nok' k'ultakil nok' yet' masanil nok' much, ix ik'jib'at nok' yuj Dios t'a winh winak chi' yik say sb'i junjun nok' winh. Ha sb'i junjun nok' ix say winh, haton ix sb'i'ejkan nok'.
Ix say sb'i masanil nok' winh, nok' k'ultakil nok', nok' much yet' nok' molb'etzal nok'. Palta malaj junok nok' t'a skal nok' chi' tz'akan tz'aj skolwaj yet' winh.
Haxo Dios ix ak'ankot jun niwan wayanh t'a winh. Ayik chamnak el winh sway chi', ix ik'ji'elta jun sb'akil skostil winh yuj Dios. Ixlajwi chi' ix smakanxi b'aj ix yik'elta jun b'ak chi'.
Haton sb'akil skostil winh chi' ix b'oji ixal yuj Dios. Ixlajwi chi', ix ak'jikanoch ix t'a yol sk'ab' winhaj Adán chi' yuj Dios.
Haxo yik ix yilanoch ix winh, ix yalan winh icha tik: --Haton wal jun tik wal yel hin b'akil, hin b'ak'chil, yujto ha t'ayin ix elta yuj Dios. Yuj chi' “Ix” ol sb'i'ejkani, xchi winh.
Yuj chi' ha winh winak, ol yaktejkan smam snun winh yik junxonhej tz'ajkan winh yet' ix yetb'eyum, junxonhej niwanil tz'ajkan heb' schawanhil.
Malaj spichul heb' schawanhil, palta max k'ixwilaj heb' t'ay junjun.

Ha nok' chan, yelxo wal te jelan nok' t'a yichanh masanil nok' k'ultakil nok' ix sb'o Jehová Dios. Ix yalan nok' t'a ix ix: --¿Tom yel ix yal Dios to max yal he lo'an sat masanil te' awb'en te' tik? xchi nok'.
Ix tak'wi ix t'a nok' icha tik: --Masanil te' syal ko lo'an sat,
anhej jun te' ay t'a snanhal te' awb'en te' tik, ix yal Dios to max yal-laj ko lo'an sat te', ma ko yamani, yik wach' max honh chami, xchi ix.
Ix tak'wi nok' chan chi' t'a ix: --Tonhej syal Dios chi'. Manh ol hex chamlaj.
Palta yojtak Dios, ayik ol he lo'an sat te' chi', ol tz'akwok he pensar, lajan ol hex ajkan yet'ok, ol nachajel wach'il yet' chukal heyu'uj, xchi nok' t'a ix.

Haxo ix yilanoch sat te' chi' ix, te wach' am sloji, te wach' yilji'ochi, ix snib'anoch ix, yik wach' stz'akwi'el spensar ix sna'ani. Yuj chi' ix sb'ixanelta jun sat te' chi' ix, ix slo'an ix. Ixlajwi chi' ix yak'anpax ix t'a winh yetb'eyum chi', ix slo'anpax te' winh yet' ix.
Ha t'a jun rato chi', ix nachajel yuj heb', ix yilanoch sb'a heb' to b'eranel heb', yuj chi' ha xil te' higo ix smol heb', ix stz'isan heb' spichulok, yik tz'och t'a snanhal heb'.

Haxo ix yab'an winh winak chi' yet' ix ix chi' to wan yek' Jehová Dios t'a skal te awb'en te' chi' t'a yemxok'uhalil, yik sikxo k'u, ix el lemnaj heb' sk'ub'ejel sb'a t'ay t'a skal te awb'en te' chi'.
Haxo ix awtaj winh yuj Jehová Dios: --Hach Adán, ¿b'ajtil ayach ek'i? xchi.
Ix tak'wi winh: --Ina wajek' tik, ix wab'i to wan ek' t'a skal te' awb'en te' tik, ix hin xiwb'ati yujto b'eran hin eli, yuj chi' ix hin k'ub'ejel hin b'a, xchi winh.
Ix sk'anb'an Dios t'a winh: --¿Mach ix halan t'ayach to b'eran hach eli? Tope ix ha lo sat te te', te' ix wal t'ayach to max yal-laj ha lo'ani, xchi t'a winh.
Ix tak'wixi winh icha tik: --Ha ix ix, ix ak' wetb'eyumok, ha ix, ix ak'an te' t'ayin, yuj chi' ix hin lo te', xchi winh.
Ix sk'anb'an Dios t'a ix: --¿Tas yuj icha chi' ix ha k'ulej? xchi. Ix tak'wi ix: --Ha nok' chan hin ak'an musansatil, yuj chi' ix hin lo te', xchi ix.

Yuj chi' ix yalan Jehová Dios t'a nok' chan chi': --Yujto icha tik ix ha k'ulej, yuj chi' tzach hin katab'ejkan t'a skal masanil nok' molb'etzal nok' yet' nok' k'ultakil nok'. T'a jun'elnhej ha yalanh ha k'o'ol ol nherwok. Ha spokokal lum lum ol ha lo'o.

Ol wak'kanoch ajk'olal t'a ha kal yet' ix ix tik yet' masanil inhtilal yet' pax yinhtilal ix. Ha yinhtilal ix chi' ol mak'anpoj ha jolom. Ha hach xo, ol ha chi yich yok yinhtilal ix chi', xchi Jehová.

Ix yalanxi Dios t'a ix icha tik: --Ol wak' ha yahelal ayik yab'ix hach, haxo yik ol aljok une', ol wak'an niwtaj ha yahelal chi'. Wach'chom ay yahelal ol ila', ol ha nib'ejnhejoch winh etb'eyum. Ha winh ol och ajalok, xchi Dios.

Ix yalanpax Jehová Dios t'a winhaj Adán chi' icha tik: --Yujto ix ha k'anab'ajej ix etb'eyum tik ha lo'an sat te te' ix wala' to max ha lo'o, ha tikne'ik jun, hu'uj tzin katab'ejkan lum lum tik, yuj chi' t'a skal yahelal ol hach wa'ok yakb'an ayach ek' t'a yol yib'anhk'inal tik.
Ol k'ib'cha'anh te' k'i'ix yet' anh ank'ultak ay sk'ixal t'a sat lum lum tik. Ha yuj juntzanh awal inhat ol ik'an yek' tiempo heyu'uj.
Ol el alil ha munlaji, icha chi' ol aj ha wa'i masanto ol hach meltzajxok och lu'umal. Yujto t'a lum ix hach koti, lum hach taxoni, yuj chi' ol hach meltzajxok och lu'umal, xchi Jehová t'a winh.
Eva ix yak' winhaj Adán sb'i'ok ix yetb'eyum chi', yujto t'a ix, ix pitzwi masanil anima.
Ha stz'umal nok' nok' ix sb'o Jehová Dios spichulok winh winak yet' ix yetb'eyum, ix yak'anoch spichulok heb'.

Ix yalan Jehová Dios: Ha tikne'ik, icha honh tik, icha chi' ix aj heb' anima. Tzaxo nachajel yuj heb' b'aj ay wach'il yet' chukal. Yuj chi' ay smay slo'an sat te te' heb', haton te' tz'ak'an k 'inal yik pitzannhej heb' t'a masanil tiempo, xchi Dios.
Yuj chi' ix pechji'elta heb' t'a Edén chi' yuj Jehová, ix ochkan winhaj Adán chi' smunlaj t'a sat lu'um b'aj ix kot sniwanil.

Ixlajwi yelkankot heb', ix ak'jikanoch juntzanh querubín yuj Jehová t'a stojolal b'aj sjawi k'u yet' jun k'e'en espada tz'ititi yel sk'ak'al yek' oyoyok, yik manhxa junok mach syal yochi yik slo'an sat te te' tz'ak'an k 'inal chi'.
Ix yil-lan sb'a winhaj Adán yet' ix Eva, ix och ix yab'ixal. Ix alji jun yune' ix, ix yak'an ix skuch Caín. Haxo ix yalan ix: Toxo ix ja jun hin winak unin yujto ha Jehová ix och wet'ok, xchi ix.
Ixlajwi chi', ix aljipax winhaj Abel yuktak winhaj Caín. Ha winhaj Abel chi', moloj kalnel ix sk'ulej winh, haxo pax winhaj Caín chi', ix munlaj winh t'a sat lum lum.
Ix ek' junok tiempo'al, ay jun k'u ix yik'b'at silab' winhaj Caín t'a Jehová, haton tas ix yik' winh t'a smunlajel.
Ix yik'anpaxb'at silab' winhaj Abel chi' t'a yichanh Jehová, haton nok' b'ab'el yune' kalnel, nok' te b'ak'ech. Ix stzalaj Jehová yet' winh yet' silab' ix yak' chi'.
Palta maj tzalajlaj Jehová yet' winhaj Caín yet' pax silab'. Yuj chi', ix te chichon sk'o'ol winh, te ow ix aj sat winh.
Haxo ix yalan Jehová t'a winh icha tik: ¿Tas yuj ste chichon ha k'o'ol, te owxonhej ha sat?

Tato wach' tza k'ulej, tzalajk'olal am ayach ek'i, palta to chuk ix ha k'ulej, yuj chi' ha ha chukal chi', ayxonhejoch t'a ib'anh yik tzach em t'a chukal yuj, palta tzato yal skan chukal chi' t'a yalanh hu'uj, xchi Dios.
Ay jun k'u, ha winhaj Caín ix awtan winhaj Abel yik sb'at heb' b'eyelek'. Ayik ayek' heb' b'aj ix k'och chi', ix b'at juknaj winhaj Caín t'a winh yuktak chi', ix smak'anchamok.
Ixlajwi chi', ix sk'anb'an Jehová t'a winhaj Caín chi': --¿B'ajtil ay winh uktak aj Abel? xchi t'a winh. Haxo ix tak'wi winh: --Manh wojtakoklaj. ¿Tom yilumal winh waji? xchi winh.
Ix yalanpax Jehová t'a winh: --¿Tas yuj icha chi' ix ha k'ulej? Ha schik'il winh uktak ix em t'a sat lum tik hu'uj, ichato syal sb'a t'ayin to tzin b'o yaj het'ok.
Ha tikne'ik, katab'il hachxo, swik'kanel opisio t'a sat lum lum tik, haton lum ix uk'anem schik'il winh uktak ix ha mak'cham chi'.
Ayik ol hach munlaj t'a sat lu'um, malaj jab'ok tas ol ik'a', tonhej ol ixtej ha b'a, tonhej ol hach komon b'eyek' t'a sat lu'um, xchi Dios t'a winh.
Ix tak'wi winh icha tik: --Te niwan jun yahelal skotkan tik t'a wib'anh, manh ol techajlaj wu'uj.
Ina ix ik'el wopisio t'a sat lum tik, ix hin ik'anel t'a ichanh t'a jun'elnhej, toxonhej ol hin komon b'eyek'ok. Yalxonhej mach ol hin chalaj hin b'a yet'ok, ol hin smak'chamok, xchi winh t'a Dios.

Haxo ix tak'wi Jehová: --Ma'ay. Tato ay junok mach ol hach mak'anchamok, ha jun chi', ukel ol ek' spak t'ay, xchi t'a winh. Ix yak'anoch Jehová jun yechel winhaj Caín chi', yik wach' tato ay mach schalaj sb'a winh yet'ok, max mak'jicham winh yuj.
Ixlajwi chi', ix el winhaj Caín b'aj ix lolon heb' chi', ix b'at kajnaj winh t'a jun lugar skuch Nod, t'a stojolal b'aj sjawi k'u t'a Edén.
Ix yil-lan sb'a winhaj Caín yet' ix yetb'eyum, ix och ix yab'ixal. Ix alji jun yune' ix, Enoc ix sb'i'ej. Ix sb'o'an jun chonhab' winhaj Caín chi', haxo sb'i yuninal winh chi' ix yak'och sb'i'ok.
Ha winhaj Enoc smam winhaj Irad. Haxo winhaj Irad smam winhaj Mehujael, haxo winhaj Mehujael smam winhaj Metusael, haxo winhaj Metusael smam winhaj Lamec.
Ha winhaj Lamec chi', chawanh ix aj yetb'eyum winh. Ay jun ix skuch Ada, haxo junxo ix skuch Zila.
Ha ix Ada chi', ix alji jun swinak unin ix, Jabal ix sb'i'ej. Haton winh ix b'ab'laj b'eyek' yet' spat mantiado yik smolan nok' snok'.
Ha winhaj Jabal chi', ay jun yuktak winh skuchan Jubal. Ha winh ix b'ab'laj ak'an te' arpa yet' spu'an flauta.

Haxo ix Zila chi', ix aljipax jun yune' ix, winak unin, Tubal-kaín ix sb'i'ej. B'o'um k'e'en ix aj winh. Ay tas ix sb'o winh t'a k'e'en bronce yet' t'a k'e'en hierro. Ay jun ix yanab' winh skuchan Naama.
Ay jun'el ix yal winhaj Lamec t'a heb' ix yetb'eyum icha tik: Hex wetb'eyum, hach Ada yet' hach Zila, ab'ek tas ol wala': Ix hin mak'cham jun winh kelem, yujto hin lajwi smak'an winh.
Tato ukel spaktzitaj yik winhaj Caín, ok hin xom ha hin tik, 77-el ol paktzitaj t'a heb' tzin tzuntzani, xchi winh.

Haxo winhaj Adán ix alji junxo yuninal winh yet' ix Eva. Set ix sb'i'ej yuj ix snun chi'. Ix yalan ix icha tik: Ha Dios ix ak'an junxo wune' tik sk'exulok winhaj Abel mak'b'ilcham yuj winhaj Caín, xchi ix.
Haxo winhaj Set chi', ix alji jun yuninal winh, Enós ix yak' winh sb'i'ok. Atax t'a jun pekti' chi', ix scha'el yich yalan sb'a heb' anima t'a Jehová.
Haton yab'ixal heb' yinhtilal winhaj Adán tik t'a stzolal. Ayik ix b'oji heb' anima yuj Dios, icha Dios ix aj heb'.
Ix b'oji winh winak yet' pax ix ix, ix yak'anpax swach'k'olal t'a yib'anh heb'. Atax t'a jun k'u chi' ayik ix b'oji'el heb' yuj, anima ix sb'i'ejkan heb' yuj.
Ha winhaj Adán chi', 130 ab'il sk'inal winh ayik ix alji junxo yuninal winh skuchan Set, lajan ix aj yet' smam chi'.
Ixlajwi chi', 800 ab'ilto ix yil winhaj Adán chi'. Ayto yuninal winh yet' yisil winh ix alji.
930 ab'il ix yil winh, ix cham winh b'i'an.
Ha winhaj Set chi', 105 ab'il sk'inal winh ayik ix alji jun yuninal winh skuchan Enós.
Ixlajwi chi', 807 ab'ilto ix yil winh, ayto yuninal winh yet' yisil winh ix alji.
912 ab'il ix yil winh, ix cham winh b'i'an.
Ha winhaj Enós chi', 90 ab'il sk'inal winh ayik ix alji jun yuninal winh skuchan Cainán.
Ixlajwi chi', 815 ab'ilto ix yil winh, ayto yuninal winh yet' yisil winh ix alji.
905 ab'il ix yil winh, ix cham winh b'i'an.
Ha winhaj Cainán chi', 70 ab'il sk'inal winh ayik ix alji jun yuninal winh skuchan Mahalalel.
Ixlajwi chi', 840 ab'ilto ix yil winh, ayto yuninal winh yet' yisil winh ix alji.
910 ab'il ix yil winh, ix cham winh b'i'an.
Ha winhaj Mahalalel chi', 65 ab'il sk'inal winh ayik ix alji jun yuninal winh skuchan Jared.
Ixlajwi chi', 830 ab'ilto ix yil winh, ayto yuninal winh yet' yisil winh ix alji.
895 ab'il ix yil winh, ix cham winh b'i'an.
Ha winhaj Jared chi', 162 ab'il sk'inal winh ayik ix alji jun yuninal winh skuchan Enoc.
Ixlajwi chi', 800 ab'ilto ix yil winh, ayto yuninal winh yet' yisil winh ix alji.
962 ab'il ix yil winh, ix cham winh b'i'an.
Ha winhaj Enoc chi', 65 ab'il sk'inal winh ayik ix alji jun yuninal winh skuchan Matusalén.
Yiktax ix alji yuninal winh chi', 300 ab'il ix sk'anab'ajej Dios winh. T'a jun pekti' chi', ayto yuninal winh yet' yisil winh ix alji.
365 ab'il ix yil winh.
Ix sb'eyb'alej wal winh icha snib'ej Dios, yuj chi' ay jun k'u ix satem winh, yujto ha Dios ix ik'anb'at winh yet'ok.
Ha winhaj Matusalén chi', 187 ab'il sk'inal winh ayik ix alji jun yuninal winh skuchan Lamec.
Ixlajwi chi' 782 ab'ilto ix yil winh, ayto yuninal winh yet' yisil winh ix alji.
969 ab'il ix yil winh, ix cham winh b'i'an.
Ha winhaj Lamec chi', 182 ab'il sk'inal winh ayik ix alji jun yuninal winh.
Noé ix sb'i'ej yuj winh yujto ix yal winh: Ha Jehová ix katab'an lum lum tik, yuj chi' te ya ko munlaj t'a sat lu'um, palta ha winh unin tik ol ak'an sniwanil ko k'o'ol, xchi winhaj Lamec chi'.
Ayik toxo ix alji winhaj Noé chi', 595 ab'ilto ix yil winhaj Lamec chi', ayto yuninal winh yet' yisil winh ix alji.
777 ab'il ix yil winh, ix cham winh b'i'an.
Ha winhaj Noé chi', 500 ab'il sk'inal winh ayik ix syamanoch yalji heb' yuninal winh, haton winhaj Sem, winhaj Cam yet' winhaj Jafet.
Ayik ix te k'ib' sb'isul heb' anima t'a sat lu'um tik, ay pax yisil heb' winh winak ix alji.
Haxo heb' winh yuninal Dios, ayik ix yilan heb' ix yisil heb' anima chi' heb' winh, te wach' yilji heb' ix, ix laj sik'lan heb' winh machtak heb' ix syik' heb' winh.
Yuj chi' ix yal Jehová: Manhxo ol wak' sk'inal heb' anima tik yuj spital. Chamelb'a anima yaj heb', yuj chi' haxonhej 120 ab'il olto ek' heb' t'a yol yib'anhk'inal tik, xchi.
Ayik ix b'eykot tiempo, ix yik'lan sb'a heb' winh yuninal Dios yet' heb' ix yisil heb' anima chi', haxo yuninal heb' skuch Nefilim. Ha heb' chi' te tek'an heb', te b'inajnak heb' t'a pekatax chi'.
Ix yilan Jehová to yelk'olal sk'ib' schukal heb' anima t'a sat lu'um tik, to haxonhej tas malaj swach'il ayek' t'a spensar heb'.
Yuj chi' ix yala': Oktom maj hin b'olaj juntzanh anima tik. Te ya swab' yuj heb'.

Ol hin satel juntzanh anima ix hin b'o t'a sat lu'um tik yet' pax nok' molb'etzal nok', nok' k'ultakil nok' yet' nok' tz'ek' nhernhonok ma tz'ek' jachjon t'a sat lu'um yet' pax nok' much. Ste tak wal hin k'o'ol yujto ix hin b'o masanil juntzanh tik, xchi Dios.
Anhej wal winhaj Noé wach' t'a yichanh Jehová.

Haton yab'ixal winhaj Noé tik: Ha winhaj Noé chi', te wach' ix yutej sb'a winh t'a yichanh Dios, anhej winh wach' spensar t'a skal heb' anima t'a jun pekti' chi'. Ix sb'eyb'alej winh icha snib'ej Dios.
Ay oxwanh yuninal winh, haton winhaj Sem, winhaj Cam yet' winhaj Jafet.
Haxo heb' anima, ix te chukb'i heb' t'a yichanh Dios, komonxonhej syixtej yetanima'il heb', smil-lajcham sb'a heb'.
Ix yilan Dios to masanil anima ix te juwi'eli, haxonhej ixtoj anima sk'ulej heb'.
Yuj chi' ix yal Dios t'a winhaj Noé chi': Toxo ix hin na' to ol hin satel masanil anima tik. Yujto haxonhej ixtoj anima sk'ulej heb', yuj chi' ol hin satel heb' yet' masanil yol yib'anhk'inal tik.

Ha tikne'ik, tza b'o junok te' niwan barco. Ha te te' ay stzatajil, ha te' tzak'och ste'alok te'. Makkiltak tzutej yo'ol te', wach' tzutej ak'anoch tzataj chi' b'aj snub'laj sb'a te'. Tzak'och t'a spatik yet' t'a yo'ol, yik wach' malaj b'aj ol och ha' t'a yol te'.
135 metro tzutej sk'atul te', 22 metro yet' nanhalxo tzutej sat te', 13 metro yet' nanhalxo ste'el te'.
Oxe' piso tzutej te'. Haxo t'a sjajk'ek'och te', hata' skan jakan smasanil, nanhal metro tz'ajkan scha'anhil, skanpax junok spuerta'il t'a junok pak'anh.
Yujto ol wak'kot jun owal ha' yik smukan sat lu'um tik, ol b'ut'jokkanel yuj ha', haxo satel jantak tas syik' yik' t'a yol yib'anhk'inal tik.
Anhej het'ok tzin b'okan jun hin trato tik. Ha t'a yol te' niwan barco chi' ol hach ochkan yet' ix etb'eyum, heb' uninal yet' pax heb' ix alib'.
Ol ochpax nok' nok' heyet'ok, junjun mojanh nok' t'a junjun makan ay t'a yol yib'anhk'inal tik, yik wach' ol kolchajkan nok' heyet'ok.
Chatakwanh nok' t'a junjun makan tz'ochkani: Nok' much, nok' molb'etzal nok', nok' k'ultakil nok' yet' nok' tz'ek' nhernhonok ma tz'ek' jachjon t'a sat lu'um, yik wach' manh ol satel nok'.
Ol ha molankanoch jantak tas ol wajok, yik wach' ay tas tze wa yet' tas swa nok', xchi Dios t'a winhaj Noé chi'.
Ix sk'anab'ajan winhaj Noé chi' masanil tas ix yal Dios.

Haxo yik ix k'och sk'uhal sjawi jun owal ha' mukwajum chi', ix yalan Jehová Dios t'a winhaj Noé chi' icha tik: Ochanh t'a yol te' niwan barco tik yet' ix etb'eyum, heb' uninal yet' heb' ix alib', yujto ha hachnhej ix ha k'anab'ajej t'ayin t'a skal masanil heb' anima t'a jun pekti' tik.
Ik'och uk mojanhok nok' nok' syal yoch silab'ok snhuschaji, haxo pax masanil nok' komon nok', junjunnhej mojanh nok' tz'ochi.
Ik'paxoch uk mojanhok junjun makan nok' much, yik wach' max lajwi'el yinhtilal nok'.
Yik wal ukub'ix tikne'ik, ol wak'em nhab'. Chawinak k'u, chawinak ak'wal ol yak'a'. Icha chi' ol aj hin satanel masanil tas ix wak' pitzwok t'a sat lum tik, xchi Jehová t'a winh.
Ichaton chi' ix aj sk'anab'ajan winhaj Noé masanil tas ix yal Jehová chi' t'ay.
Ayik ix ja jun owal ha' mukwajum chi', 600 ab'il sk'inal winhaj Noé chi'.
Ix ochkan winh t'a yol te' niwan barco chi' yet' ix yetb'eyum, heb' yuninal yet' heb' ix yalib', yik skolchaj heb' t'a jun owal ha' mukwajum chi'.
Ix ochpax nok' nok': Nok' syal yoch silab'il snhusji, nok' komon nok', nok' much yet' nok' tz'ek' nhernhonok ma tz'ek' jachjon t'a sat lu'um.
Junjun mojanh ix aj sjawi nok' yik tz'och nok' t'a yol barco chi' yet' winh, icha ix aj yalan Dios t'a winh.
Haxo t'a yukil k'uhal chi' ix jawi seknaj jun owal ha' mukwajum chi' t'a sat lu'um.
Ha wal stz'akwi 600 ab'il sk'inal winhaj Noé chi', yik 17 yoch schab'il ujal, ix k'e'ul t'inhnaj ha' niwak ha' t'a yol lu'um, ix kotpax seknaj ha' niwak ha' t'a satcha'anh.
40 k'uhal, 40 ak'wal ix yak' nhab' t'a sat lu'um tik.

Ha t'a sk'uhal skot nhab' chi', hata' ochnakkan winhaj Noé t'a yol te' barco yet' oxwanh heb' yuninal winh, haton winhaj Sem, winhaj Cam yet' winhaj Jafet yet' ix yetb'eyum winh yet' oxwanh heb' ix yalib' winh.
Ayxo och masanil makanhil nok' nok' yet' winh, nok' molb'etzal nok', nok' k'ultakil nok', nok' tz'ek' nhernhonok ma tz'ek' jachjon t'a sat lu'um yet' pax nok' much.
Masanil nok' nok' syik' yik', chatakwanhil ix aj sjawi nok' t'a winhaj Noé chi' yik tz'ochkan nok' t'a yol te' barco chi',
jun nok' smam, jun nok' snun. Icha chi' ix aj yoch masanil makanhil nok', icha ix aj yalan Dios t'a winhaj Noé chi'. Ixlajwi chi', ha wal Jehová ix makankan spuerta'il te' niwan barco chi'.
Chawinak k'uhalxo sk'e sib'ib'ok ha ha' chi', ix kuchjichanh te' barco chi' yuj ha'.
Ix mukchaj jantak niwak witz yuj ha'.
Ix k'enhej ha', ay am uke'ok metro ix ek' ha' t'a yib'anh lum niwak witz.

Ichaton chi' ix aj scham masanil anima ay t'a yol yib'anhk'inal tik yet' masanil nok' nok', nok' much, nok' molb'etzal nok', nok' k'ultakil nok' yet' nok' tz'ek' nhernhonok ma tz'ek' jachjon t'a sat lu'um.
Masanil tastak syik' yik' t'a sat lu'um tik, pilan ix chameli.
Haxonhej winhaj Noé yet' heb' ayoch yet' t'a yol te' barco chi' yet' nok' nok' ix kolchaji. Haxo anima smasanil, ix satel heb'.
Oye' ujal ix kan panhan ha' t'a yib'anh lu'um.
Yujto na'an winhaj Noé chi' yuj Dios yet' masanil nok' nok' ayoch yet' winh t'a yol te' barco chi', yuj chi' ix ak'jikot jun ik' te ow yuj Dios t'a yib'anh ha ha' chi', yik wach' stupem ha'.
Ix makchaj masanil sjaj ha ha', ha' sk'e'ul t'a yol lu'um yet' jantak ha' niwak ha' skot sekekok t'a satcha'anh. Ix och wa'an yak'an nhab'.
Oye' ujal ix kan ha', ix och ijan stupxi'em ha', k'ojank'olal ix tupem ha'.
17 k'uhalxo yoch yukil uj, ix kan b'akhnaj te niwan barco chi' t'a sjolom jun lum witz t'a yol yik Ararat.
Numumi yem ha ha' chi'. Ha t'a b'ab'el k'uhal yik lajunhexo ujal, chekelxo sjolom lum niwak witz.
Haxo yik ix ek' 40 k'uhalxo, ix sjakan te' wentena winhaj Noé b'ob'il yuj t'a te' barco chi'.
Ix yaktanelta jun nok' joj winh, ix ek' jenhenhok nok' stanhwan stupem ha' t'a sat lu'um.
Ix yaktanpaxelta jun nok' uch winh yik syil nok' tato takinhxo sat lu'um.

Haxo nok' uch chi', ix k'ochxi nok' t'a te' barco chi', yujto malaj b'aj syal skan wa'an nok'. Te sib'anto ek' ha' t'a sat lu'um chi'. Ix yak'anelta sk'ab' winh yik scha'anxi'och nok' winh t'a yol te' barco chi'.
Ixto stanhwej ukexo k'uhal winhaj Noé chi', ix yak'anelta nok' uch chi' winh jun'elxo.
Numumixo sk'ik'b'i ix k'ochxi nok', nhak'b'ilxo jun te' xil olivo yaxxo yuj nok'. Icha chi' ix aj yojtakanel winh to wan stakji sat lu'um.
Uketo k'u ix stanhwej winh, ichato chi' ix sjakanelta nok' winh jun'elxo, palta majxo k'ochxoklaj nok'.
601 ab'ilxo sk'inal winhaj Noé chi', ayik ix takjixi lum lum chi'. Ayik b'ab'el k'u yoch b'ab'el uj ix yik'anel yib'anh te' barco chi' winh, haxo ix yilan winh to takinhxo lu'um.
Haxo t'a 27-xo k'uhal yoch yik schab'il ujal, te takinhxo lu'um.
Haxo ix yalan Dios t'a winh:
Elanhkot t'a yol te' barco yet' ix etb'eyum yet' heb' uninal yet' heb' ix alib'.

Tzik'anelta masanil makanhil nok' nok' ayoch het'ok: Nok' much, nok' molb'etzal nok', nok' k'ultakil nok', nok' tz'ek' nhernhonok ma tz'ek' jachjon t'a sat lu'um. Unewokab' nok' yik sb'ut'jixi sat lu'um tik yuj nok', xchi Dios.
Ixlajwi chi', ix elta winhaj Noé chi' yet' ix yetb'eyum yet' heb' yuninal yet' heb' ix yalib' t'a yol te' barco chi'.
Ix elixta nok' nok' chi' smasanil t'a junjun makan.

Ixlajwi chi', ix sb'o'an jun altar winh t'a yichanh Jehová. Ix yik'ankot nok' molb'etzal nok' winh yet' nok' much, haton nok' smoj yoch silab'il t'a Dios. T'a junjun makan nok' chi' ix yik'kanel junjun nok' winh snhustz'a silab'ok t'a yichanh Jehová.

Te wach' sjab' nok' silab' chi' ix yab' Jehová. Yuj chi' ix yalan icha tik: Manhxo ol hin katab'ej lum lum tik yuj smul heb' anima, yujto yiktax unin anima heb', anhej chukal snib'ej heb' sk'ulej. Manhxa b'ak'inh ol hin satel masanil tas pitzan, icha ix wutej t'a jun'el tik.

Yakb'an ayto ek' yol yib'anhk'inal tik, ol awchaj sat awal inhat, ol molchajpax sat. Ay stiempo'al k'ak', ay stiempo'al si'ik. Ay stiempo'al nhab'il k 'inal, ay stiempo'al waresma. Ay k'uhalil, ay pax t'ak'walil, xchi Jehová.
Ix lolon Dios t'a winhaj Noé yet' t'a heb' yuninal winh, ix yalani to ol yak' syaxil t'a yib'anh heb'. Ix yalan icha tik: Tzijtumokab' heyuninal tz'alji, b'ut'jokab' yol yib'anhk'inal tik yuj heb'.
Masanil nok' nok' ay t'a sat lu'um tik yet' nok' much yet' nok' ay t'a yol ha' mar ol xiw nok' t'ayex. Masanil juntzanh nok' tik skan nok' t'a yol he k'ab'.
Ha tikne'ik syal he chi'an masanil nok' nok' tik. Ha hin swak' nok' t'ayex icha ix aj wak'an anh itaj he chi'a.
Palta ay jun tas manh ol yal-laj he chi'ani, haton nok' chib'ej syuk' schik'il, yujto ha t'a schik'il nok' chi' ay sk'inal.
Ha hin ol hin ch'olb'itej heb' anima smilancham junok yetanima'il. Ha nok' nok' smilancham anima, ol miljokpaxcham nok'.
Ha mach smilancham yetanima'il, anima pax ol milanchamok, yujto ha hex anima hex tik, icha honh tik, icha chi' hex kutej ko b'o'ani.
Tzijtumokab' heyuninal tz'alji, b'ut'jokab'el yol yib'anhk'inal tik heyu'uj, xchi Dios.
Ix yalanpax Dios t'a winhaj Noé yet' t'a heb' yuninal icha tik:
Ha tikne'ik, swak'kan jun hin trato tik heyet'ok yet' masanil heb' heyinhtilal,
yet' masanil nok' nok' ix elta heyet'ok t'a yol te' barco tik: Nok' much, nok' molb'etzal nok', nok' k'ultakil nok' yet' masanil nok' nok' ay t'a yol yib'anhk'inal tik.

Ha jun hin trato ol wak' heyet'ok tik, manhxo ol hin k'exa'. Manhxo ol hin satel anima yet' nok' nok' yuj junok owal ha' mukwajum. Manhxo ol jax jun owal ha' mukwajum yik satxi'el sat lu'um tik, icha jun ix ek' tik.
Haton yechel hin trato tik swak'kan heyet'ok yet' masanil nok' nok' t'a masanil k 'inal.
Swak'och jun chakpan t'a kal asun, ha jun chi', haton yechel hin trato yet' yol yib'anhk'inal tik.
Ayik swak'ankot asun haxo scheklaj jun chakpan chi' t'a skal,
hata' tzin nakot hin trato ix wak' heyet'ok yet' nok' nok', yuj chi' manhxo ol hex hin satel yuj junok owal ha' mukwajum.
Ayik swilan jun chakpan chi', tzin na'ankoti to ay jun hin trato ix wak' t'a jun'elnhej heyet'ok yet' masanil nok' nok' ay t'a yol yib'anhk'inal tik.
Haton yechel hin trato tik ix hin b'o heyet'ok yet' jantak nok' nok', xchi Dios t'a winhaj Noé chi'.
Ha heb' yuninal winhaj Noé ix elta t'a yol te' barco yet'ok: Haton winhaj Sem, winhaj Cam yet' winhaj Jafet. Ay jun yuninal winhaj Cam chi' skuchan Canaán.
Ha heb' tik yuninal heb' winhaj Noé, haxo t'a yinhtilal heb' ix pitzwi'elta jantak chonhab' ay t'a sat lu'um tik.
Ha winhaj Noé ix munlaj winh t'a sat lu'um. Ha te' uwa ix sb'ab'laj awej winh.
Ay jun k'u ix yuk' yal sat te' uwa chi' winh, ix k'e t'a sjolom winh, ix satel sk'o'ol winh yuj. Ix skichel spichul winh, ix kan pak'jab' winh t'a yol smantiado.
Haxo ix yilan winhaj Cam, smam winhaj Canaán to b'eranel winhaj Noé chi', wan stzetzan winh smam winh chi' ayik ix yalan winh yab' heb' yuktak chi' schawanhil.

Ayik ix yab'an heb' yuktak winh chi', ix yak'ankot jun k'apak sábana heb' t'a sjolom sjenhjab'. Ix b'eyb'at heb' t'a spatik, ix ochk'och heb' b'aj ay smam chi', ix spichan winh heb' t'a k'apak sábana chi'. Ch'ok b'aj k'elanb'at heb' yik wach' max yil sniwanil smam heb' chi'.
Haxo yik ix nachajxi sk'o'ol winhaj Noé chi', ix yab'an winh tas ix yutej sb'a winhaj Cam chi', haton winh schab'il yuninal.
Yuj chi' ix yalan winh icha tik: Tzin katab'ejkan winhaj Canaán. Chekab' emnakil ol ajkan winh t'a heb' yuktak, xchi winh.
Ix yalanxi winh icha tik: Yak'okab' swach'k'olal Jehová ko Diosal t'a yib'anh winhaj Sem, haxo winhaj Canaán tz'ochkan schekab'ok winh.
Niwanokab' tz'ajkan slu'um winhaj Jafet yuj Dios. Kajnajokab' Dios t'a skal yinhtilal winhaj Sem, haxo winhaj Canaán tz'ochkan schekab'ok winhaj Jafet chi', xchi winh.
Ayik ix lajwi yek' jun owal ha' mukwajum chi', 350 ab'ilto ix ek' winhaj Noé chi',
yuj chi' 950 ab'il sk'inal winh ayik ix cham winh.
Ha yab'ixal heb' yinhtilal winhaj Noé tik: Haton winhaj Sem, winhaj Cam yet' winhaj Jafet. Ayik ix lajwi yek' jun owal ha' mukwajum chi', ix laj alji yuninal heb'.
Ha sb'i heb' yuninal winhaj Jafet: Haton winhaj Gomer, winhaj Magog, winhaj Madai, winhaj Javán, winhaj Tubal, winhaj Mesec yet' winhaj Tiras.
Ha sb'i heb' yuninal winhaj Gomer: Haton winhaj Askenaz, winhaj Rifat yet' winhaj Togarma.
Ha sb'i heb' yuninal winhaj Javán: Haton winhaj Elisa, winhaj Tarsis, winhaj Quitim yet' winhaj Dodanim.
Haton heb' tik yinhtilal winhaj Jafet. Ix kajnaj heb' t'a stitak ha' mar, junjun makan yinhtilal heb' yet' smakb'en yet' sti' syala'.
Ha sb'i heb' yuninal winhaj Cam: Haton winhaj Cus, winhaj Mizraim, winhaj Fut yet' winhaj Canaán.
Ha sb'i heb' yuninal winhaj Cus: Haton winhaj Seba, winhaj Havila, winhaj Sabta, winhaj Raama yet' winhaj Sabteca. Ha sb'i heb' yuninal winhaj Raama: Haton winhaj Seba yet' winhaj Dedán.
Ha winhaj Cus ay yuninal winhaj Nimrod. Ha winhaj Nimrod chi' b'ab'el ix och yajalil t'a skal heb' chonhab'.
Te julum nok' winh t'a yichanh Jehová, yuj chi' ay jun lolonel t'a skal heb' anima tz'alan icha tik: Lajan winh icha winhaj Nimrod, winh te julum nok' t'a yol sat Jehová, xchi jun lolonel chi'.
Ha t'a sb'ab'elal, yajal yaj winhaj Nimrod t'a yib'anh Babel, Erec, Acad yet' Calne. Ha t'a yol smakb'en Sinar hata' ay juntzanh chonhab' chi'.
Ixlajwi chi', ix b'at winh t'a Asiria. Hata' ix sb'o chanhexo niwak chonhab' winh: Haton chonhab' Nínive, Rehobot, Cala
yet' Resén, haton jun chonhab' ay t'a skal Nínive yet' Cala. Ha chanhe' chonhab' chi', junxonhej niwan chonhab'il ix aji.
Haxo t'a winhaj Mizraim ix kot heb' Ludim, heb' Anamim, heb' Lehabim, heb' Naftuhim,
heb' Patrusim, heb' Casluhim yet' heb' Caftorim. Ha t'a heb' chi' ix kot heb' filisteo.
Ha winhaj Canaán smam winhaj Sidón yet' winhaj Het. Ha winhaj Sidón chi', b'ab'el unin winh.
Ha winhaj Canaán chi' smam icham heb' jebuseo, heb' amorreo, heb' gergeseo,
heb' heveo, heb' araceo, heb' sineo,
heb' arvadeo, heb' zemareo, heb' amateo. Ayik ix b'ey tiempo ix saklemkanb'at heb' cananeo chi'.

Ha slu'um heb', tzato k'och t'a smojonal Sidón masanto t'a stojolal Gerar, masanto t'a Gaza. Skumlajxib'at lu'um t'a yol smakb'en chonhab' Sodoma, Gomorra, Adma yet' Zeboim masanto sk'och lum t'a chonhab' Lasa.
Hata' ix kajnaj heb' yinhtilal winhaj Cam, junjun makan yinhtilal heb' t'a yol smakb'en yet' sti' syala'.
Haxo pax winhaj Sem, winh b'ab'el winak t'a winhaj Jafet, ay pax yuninal winh. Ha honh masanil honh tik, yinhtilal honh winhaj Heber, kotnak honh t'a yinhtilal winhaj Sem.
Ha heb' yuninal winhaj Sem chi', haton winhaj Elam, winhaj Asur, winhaj Arfaxad, winhaj Lud yet' winhaj Aram.
Haxo heb' yuninal winhaj Aram, haton winhaj Uz, winhaj Hul, winhaj Geter yet' winhaj Mas.
Ha winhaj Arfaxad ay yuninal winhaj Sala, haxo winhaj Sala chi' ay yuninal winhaj Heber.
Haxo winhaj Heber chi', chawanh yuninal winh, Peleg sb'i jun winh. Ha t'a yol stiempo'al winh tik ix pukaxkanb'at heb' anima t'a sat lum lum tik. Haxo junxo winh skuchan Joctán.
Ha winhaj Joctán chi' ay yuninal winhaj Almodad, winhaj Selef, winhaj Hazar-mawet, winhaj Jera,
winhaj Adoram, winhaj Uzal, winhaj Dicla,
winhaj Obal, winhaj Abimael, winhaj Seba,
winhaj Ofir, winhaj Havila yet' winhaj Jobab. Masanil heb' tik, ha winhaj Joctán ay yuninal heb'.
Ix kajnaj heb' t'a lum skot t'a Mesa, masanto sk'och t'a Sefar t'a tzalkixtak t'a stojolal b'aj sjawi k'u.
Hata' ix kajnaj heb' yinhtilal winhaj Sem, junjun makan yinhtilal heb' t'a yol smakb'en yet' sti' syala'.

Masanil juntzanh anima tik, ha heb' yuninal winhaj Noé ay yinhtilal heb', junjun makan yinhtilal heb' yet' smakb'en. Ayik ix lajwi yek' jun owal ha' mukwajum chi', ix saklemkanb'at heb'. Ha t'a heb' tik ix pitzwi juntzanh nación ay t'a yol yib'anhk'inal tik.

Ha t'a peka', ayik toxo ix ek' jun owal ha' mukwajum chi', junnhej ti'al syal heb' anima. Ayik wan sb'at heb' t'a stojolal b'aj sjawi k'u, ix k'och kajan heb' t'a jun niwan ak'lik t'a yol yik Sinar. Hata' ix kajnaj heb'.

Ay jun k'u ix yal-laj yab' heb' icha tik: Ko b'o'ek lum ladrillo, sko mukan chakb'ok lu'um, xchi heb'. Ha lum ix yak'lab'ej heb' sk'exulok k'e'en k'e'en. Haxo spixul lu'um, ay jun sk'eta t'a yol lu'um, te tat, haxo stakji, te tzatz tz'aji, asfalto sb'i, ha jun chi' ix yak'lab'ej heb'.

Ixlajwi chi', ix yalan heb' winh icha tik: Kak'ek kip ko b'o'ek junok ko niwan chonhab'. Sko b'o'anekpax junok niwan torre, te cha'anh tz'ajk'e t'a satcha'anh yik wach' tzonh te b'inaji. Junxonhej skutej ko b'a, manh ol honh saklemb'at t'a yol yib'anhk'inal tik, xchi heb' winh.
Haxo Jehová ix emul yil jun chonhab' yet' jun torre wan sb'o'an heb' chi'.
Ix yalan icha tik: Ix el yich jun munlajel yuj heb' anima tik. Malaj tas skachanoch wa'an heb' winh yik sb'o'an heb' tas nab'il yuj, yujto junnhej chonhab'il yaj heb', junnhej ti' syal heb'.
Ha tikne'ik, konh emek t'a skal heb' yik sko somchitan sti' heb', yik wach' manhxo ol nachajel yuj heb' tastak syal junjun, xchi Jehová chi'.
Icha chi' ix aj saklemkanb'at heb' yuj Jehová t'a sat lu'um tik. Ix yaktan heb' sb'o'an jun chonhab' chi'.
Haton ta' ix somchajkanb'at sti' heb' anima chi' yuj Jehová. Yuj chi' ix saklemkanb'at heb' t'a smasanil yol yib'anhk'inal tik. Yuj chi' Babel ix sb'i'ejkan jun chonhab' chi'.
Haton yab'ixal winhaj Sem tik: Schab'ilxo ab'il yek'b'at jun owal ha' mukwajum chi', ayik 100 ab'ilxo sk'inal winhaj Sem, ix alji jun yuninal winh skuchan Arfaxad.
Ixlajwi chi', 500 ab'ilto ix yil winh, ayto yuninal winh yet' yisil winh ix alji.
35 ab'il sk'inal winhaj Arfaxad chi' ayik ix alji jun yuninal winh skuchan Sala.
Ixlajwi chi', 403 ab'ilto ix yil winh, ayto yuninal winh yet' yisil winh ix alji.
30 ab'il sk'inal winhaj Sala chi' ayik ix alji jun yuninal winh skuchan Heber.
Ixlajwi chi', 403 ab'ilto ix yil winh, ayto yuninal winh yet' yisil winh ix alji.
34 ab'il sk'inal winhaj Heber chi' ayik ix alji jun yuninal winh skuchan Peleg.
Ixlajwi chi', 430 ab'ilto ix yil winh, ayto yuninal winh yet' yisil winh ix alji.
30 ab'il sk'inal winhaj Peleg chi' ayik ix alji jun yuninal winh skuchan Reu.
Ixlajwi chi', 209 ab'ilto ix yil winh, ayto yuninal winh yet' yisil winh ix alji.
32 ab'il sk'inal winhaj Reu chi' ayik ix alji jun yuninal winh skuchan Serug.
Ixlajwi chi', 207 ab'ilto ix yil winh, ayto yuninal winh yet' yisil winh ix alji.
30 ab'il sk'inal winhaj Serug chi' ayik ix alji jun yuninal winh skuchan Nacor.
Ixlajwi chi' 200 ab'ilto ix yil winh, ayto yuninal winh yet' yisil winh ix alji.
29 ab'il sk'inal winhaj Nacor chi' ayik ix alji jun yuninal winh skuchan Taré.
Ixlajwi chi', 119 ab'ilto ix yil winh, ayto yuninal winh yet' yisil winh ix alji.
70 ab'il sk'inal winhaj Taré chi' ayik ix alji jun yuninal winh skuchan Abram. Ixlajwi chi', ix alji winhaj Nacor yet' winhaj Harán, haton heb' oxwanh yuninal winhaj Taré chi'.
Haton yab'ixal winhaj Taré tik: Haton winh smam winhaj Abram, winhaj Nacor yet' winhaj Harán. Ha winhaj Harán chi' smam winhaj Lot.
Ix cham winhaj Harán chi' t'a chonhab' Ur t'a yol yik Caldea, ayik mantzak cham winhaj Taré chi'. Ha b'aj aljinak winh chi', hata' chamnakpax winh.
Ix yik'lan sb'a winhaj Abram yet' ix Sarai. Haxo winhaj Nacor ix yik'laj sb'a yet' ix Milca, yisil winhaj Harán, snulej sb'a ix yet' ix Isca.
Ha ix Sarai chi' max unewilaj ix.

Ix el winhaj Taré chi' t'a chonhab' Ur t'a yol yik Caldea, yik skotkan winh t'a yol yik Canaán yalani. Ix yik'ankot winh yuninal winh yet'ok, haton winhaj Abram yet' pax winhaj Lot, haton yixchikin winh yuninal winhaj Harán chamnak. Ix yik'paxkot ix yalib' winh, haton ix Sarai. Haxo yik ix jawi heb' t'a chonhab' Harán, ix kajnajkan heb' ta'.
Ha t'a Harán chi' ix cham winhaj Taré chi'. 205 ab'il sk'inal winh ayik ix cham winh.
Ayxotax yalan Jehová t'a winhaj Abram icha tik: Aktejkan ha lum tik yet' jantak heb' ay uj ha b'a yet'ok yet' heb' ayek' t'a spat ha mam, ol hach b'at t'a jun lu'um ol hin ch'ox t'ayach.
Ha inhtilal ol och niwak nacional wu'uj, ol hin ch'oxan hin wach'k'olal t'ayach. Yelxo wal niwan ol aj ha b'inaji, hu'uj ol scha wach'k'olal masanil heb' anima.

Ol wak' hin wach'k'olal t'a heb' wach' syutej sb'a t'ayach, ol hin katab'ejpax heb' chuk syutej sb'a. Hu'ujnhej ol wak' hin wach'k'olal t'a yib'anh masanil heb' anima t'a yol yib'anhk'inal tik, xchi Jehová chi'.

Yuj chi' ix el winhaj Abram t'a yol yik Harán chi', icha ajnak yalankan Jehová t'a winh. 75 ab'il sk'inal winh ayik ix el winh t'a yol yik Harán chi'. Ix yik'ankot ix yetb'eyum winh yet'ok, haton ix Sarai. Ix yik'paxkot winhaj Lot winh, haton winh yunin winh yuktak winh chamnak. Ix yik'paxkot heb' schekab' winh yet' jantak tas ix aj t'a winh ayik ix ek' winh t'a Harán chi'. Icha chi' ix aj sja winh t'a yol yik Canaán.
Ix kotnhej winh t'a yol yik Canaán chi' masanto ix jawi winh t'a Siquem b'aj ay jun te' ji t'a yol yik More. Ha jun te' chi' chajul yuj heb' cananeo kajan ta'.

Hata' ix sch'ox sb'a Jehová t'a winhaj Abram chi', ix yalan t'a winh icha tik: Masanil jun lu'um tik ol wak' t'a heb' inhtilal, xchi t'a winh. Yuj chi' ix sb'o jun altar winhaj Abram chi' t'a yichanh Jehová, yujto hata' ix sch'ox sb'a t'a winh.

Ixlajwi chi', ix b'at winh t'a tzalkixtak t'a snanhal chonhab' Betel yet' chonhab' Hai. Hata' ix sb'ok'e smantiado winh. Ha chonhab' Betel chi', ha t'a stojolal b'aj tz'em k'u ay. Hata' ix sb'o junxo altar winh yik syal sb'a winh t'a Jehová.
Ixlajwi chi' k'ojank'olal ix kotxi winh masanto ix jawi winh t'a yol yik Neguev.
Ha t'a jun pekti' chi', ix ja jun niwan wejel t'a jun lugar b'aj ayek' winhaj Abram chi'. Yuj chi' ix b'at kajan winh jun pekti' t'a Egipto.
Ayik wan sk'och winh t'a Egipto chi', ix yalan winh t'a ix yetb'eyum chi' haton ix Sarai: Ha tikne'ik ay jun tas tzin na'a: Ha hach tik te wach' ilji.
Yuj chi' ayik ol hach yilan heb' winh aj Egipto tik, ol am yal heb' winh icha tik: Ha ix tik yetb'eyum ton wal winh tik ix, yuj chi' ko milekcham winh yik skan ix ket'ok, xcham heb' winh.
Yuj chi' swal t'ayach to wanab' hach halani, yik wach' xajan ol hin aj yuj heb' winh, manh ol hin smilcham heb' winh hu'uj, xchi winh t'a ix.
Ayik ix k'och winh t'a Egipto chi', ix yilanoch heb' winh kajan ta' to ha ix Sarai chi' te wach' yilji ix.
Ix yilanpax heb' ay yopisio yet' winh rey to te wach' yilji ix, ix b'at yalan heb' winh t'a winh rey chi'. Yuj chi' ix yik'anb'at ix heb' winh t'a spat winh rey chi'.

Yuj ix Sarai chi', te xajan ix aj winhaj Abram yuj winh rey chi'. Tzijtum nok' kalnel, nok' wakax, nok' mam b'uru yet' nok' snun yet' nok' camello ix si'aj t'a winh yuj winh rey chi'. Ay pax heb' winh winak yet' heb' ix ix, ix ak'ji schekab'ok winh.
Palta yujnhej ix, tzijtum yahelal ix jawi t'a yib'anh winh rey yet' heb' kajan yet' winh t'a spat yuj Jehová.
Yuj chi' ix schek winh rey chi' awtajkot winhaj Abram chi', ix yalan winh icha tik: ¿Tas yuj icha tik tzin utej? ¿Tas yuj maj al t'ayin tato etb'eyum ix tik?
Ina ix ala' to anab' ix, yuj chi' ix hin na to tz'och ix wetb'eyumok. Ha tikne'ik jun, ik'b'at ix, ixikek, xchi winh.
Ixlajwi chi' ix yalan winh rey chi' t'a heb' schekab' to tz'ik'ji'el winhaj Abram t'a yol smakb'en Egipto chi' yet' ix yetb'eyum yet' masanil tas ay t'a winh.
Ayik ix el winhaj Abram yet' ix yetb'eyum t'a Egipto chi' yet' masanil tas ay t'a winh, ix meltzaj heb' t'a yol yik Neguev. Ix meltzajpax winhaj Lot yet' heb'.
Ha winhaj Abram chi', te b'eyumxo winh, ay k'e'en oro, k'e'en plata yet' jantak nok' nok' t'a winh.
Ix helxi winh t'a Neguev chi'. k'ojank'olal ix k'ochxi winh t'a yol yik Betel b'aj ek'nak t'a sb'ab'elal, haton t'a skal Betel yet' Hai.
Hata' b'ob'ilkan jun altar yuj winh t'a yalanhtaxo. Hata' ix yalxi sb'a winh t'a Jehová.
Ha winhaj Lot chi' junnhej tz'ek' winh yet' winhaj Abram chi'. Tzijtum pax nok' skalnel winh yet' nok' swakax. Tzijtum pax heb' schekab' winh.
Maxtzak yab'laj lugar b'aj swa nok' snok' heb' chi' yujto te tzijtum nok'. Yuj chi', maxtzak yal-laj junnhej tz'ek' heb'.

Ha heb' winh stanhwumal nok' smolb'etz nok' winhaj Abram chi', syak' owal heb' yet' heb' winh stanhwumal nok' yik winhaj Lot chi'. Ha t'a jun pekti' chi', ayto'ek' kajan heb' cananeo yet' heb' ferezeo ta'.

Ay jun k'uhal ix yal winhaj Abram t'a winhaj Lot chi' icha tik: Ina ayto ku'uj ko b'a, manh wach'ok tato skak' owal, wach'chom ha heb' stanhwumal nok' ko molb'etzal nok' tik, manh wach'ok tato syak' owal heb'.

Masanil jun lugar tik kolan yaji. Syal ha sik'lani b'ajtil tzach kani, yik wach' sko poj ko b'a. Tato tzach elkan t'a yelk'och chi', ha hinxo tzin ochkan t'a yochk'och chi'. Tato tzach ochkan t'a yochk'och chi' jun, ha hinxo tzin elkan t'a yelk'och chi', xchi winhaj Abram chi' t'a winh.

Ix b'at t'anhan winhaj Lot chi' t'a jun niwan ak'lik ay t'a sti' ha' Jordán masanto sk'och t'a chonhab' Zoar. Te yax sat jun ak'lik chi' yuj ha ha' chi', lajan yilji icha jun awb'en te' b'ob'il yuj Jehová, icha yilji yol yik Egipto ix yil winh. Ayik ix sb'o'an strato winhaj Abram yet' winhaj Lot chi', manto satel-laj chonhab' Sodoma yet' Gomorra yuj Jehová.
Ha jun ak'lik t'a sti' ha' Jordán chi' ix sik'kanel winhaj Lot chi', ix b'at kajnaj winh t'a stojolal b'aj sja k'u. Icha chi' ix aj spojlan sb'a winhaj Abram yet' winhaj Lot chi'.
Yuj chi' ix kan winhaj Abram t'a yol smakb'en Canaán, haxo pax winhaj Lot chi', ix kajnaj winh t'a skal juntzanh chonhab' t'a yak'likal sti' ha' Jordán, t'a slak'anil chonhab' Sodoma.
Ha t'a jun chonhab' chi', te chuk sb'eyb'al heb' anima, manh jantakok chukal sk'ulej heb' t'a yichanh Jehová.
Ayik toxo ix b'at winhaj Lot chi', ix yalan Jehová t'a winhaj Abram chi' icha tik: Ha tikne'ik ilb'at t'a ichanh, t'a ha patik yet' t'a ha tz'eytak.
Masanil juntzanh lu'um wan ilanb'at chi', swak' t'ayach t'a jun'elnhej yet' t'a heb' inhtilal.
Icha wal spokokal lum lum, malaj mach syal sb'isani, icha chi' ol aj inhtilal.
Ha tikne'ik k'e'anh wa'an yik tza b'eytzitan yok jun lum tik yet' sk'atul, yujto swak' jun lu'um tik t'ayach, xchi Jehová t'a winh.

Ixlajwi chi' ix yik'ancha'anh scampamento winhaj Abram chi', ix b'at kajnaj winh t'a slak'anil juntzanh te' ji t'a yol smakb'en jun winh skuch Mamre t'a slak'anil chonhab' Hebrón. Ix sb'o'an jun altar winh b'aj syal sb'a t'a Jehová.

Ha t'a jun pekti' chi', ix yak' owal cha makan heb' winh rey. Jun makan heb' winh: Haton winhaj Amrafel sreyal Sinar, winhaj Arioc sreyal Elasar, winhaj Quedorlaomer sreyal Elam yet' winhaj Tidal sreyal Goim. Junxo makan heb': Haton winhaj Bera sreyal Sodoma, winhaj Birsa sreyal Gomorra, winhaj Sinab sreyal Adma, winhaj Semeber sreyal Zeboim yet' winh sreyal Bela, haton jun chonhab' Zoar tikne'ik.
Ha owanh heb' winh rey chi' ix slajti'ej sb'a heb' winh, junxonhej ix yutej soldado heb' winh t'a jun ak'lik skuch Sidim b'aj ay ha' mar Muerto tikne'ik.
Ha heb' winh rey chi', slajchawilxo ab'il yajoch heb' winh t'a yalanh smandar winhaj rey Quedorlaomer. Haxo ix ek' junxo ab'il majxo yak'laj k'e'en tumin heb' winh syak'taxon t'a winh.

Yuj chi' t'a junxo ab'il ix b'at winh rey chi' yet' oxwanhxo heb' winh rey ayoch yet'ok t'a yol yik Astarot Carnaim. Hata' ix ak'ji ganar heb' refaíta yuj heb' winh. Ix ak'jipax ganar heb' zuzita yuj heb' winh t'a yol yik Ham. Ix ak'jipax ganar heb' winh emita yuj heb' winh t'a yol yik Save-kiriataim.
Ix ak'jipax ganar heb' horeo yuj heb' winh t'a jun tzalan skuch Seir, ix pechji heb' masanto t'a jun ak'lik Parán, t'a slak'anil jun lum takinh lu'um.

Ayik ix meltzajxi winhaj rey Quedorlaomer yet' heb' winh ayoch yet'ok, ix jawi heb' winh t'a En-mispat, hanheja' jun lugar chi' skuchanpax Cades. Ix satel masanil tas ay t'a yol yik heb' amalecita yuj heb' winh yet' tas ay t'a heb' amorreo ay t'a yol yik Hazezon-tamar.

Haxo owanh heb' winh rey, haton winh yik Sodoma, winh yik Gomorra, winh yik Adma, winh yik Zeboim yet' winh yik Bela, ix b'at heb' winh t'a ak'lik Sidim. Hata' ix yak' owal heb' winh yet' chanhwanhxo heb' winh rey chi', haton winhaj Quedorlaomer, winhaj Tidal, winhaj Amrafel yet' winhaj Arioc.

Ha t'a yak'likal Sidim chi', tzijtum b'ajtak sk'eta jun asfalto te tzayayi. Yuj chi' ayik ix b'at winh sreyal Sodoma yet' winh yik Gomorra elelal, ay heb' soldado heb' ix b'atkan t'a skal asfalto chi', ay juntzanhxo heb' ix b'atkan elelal t'a jolomtak witz.
Ha chanhwanh heb' winh rey ix ak'an ganar chi', ix b'at heb' winh yik'elta masanil tas swaji yet' masanil tas te ay stojol t'a Sodoma yet' t'a Gomorra chi', ix b'at heb' winh b'i'an.
Ha winhaj Lot, sk'ab' yok winhaj Abram, kajan t'a Sodoma chi', ix ik'jib'at winh yuj heb' winh yet' masanil tas ay t'ay.

Palta ay jun winh ixto yak' ganar yeli, ix b'at yalan winh t'a winhaj Abram winh hebreo to ix ik'jib'at winhaj Lot chi'. Ha winhaj Abram chi' kajan winh t'a slak'anil juntzanh te' ji t'a yol smakb'en winhaj Mamre winh amorreo, yuktak sb'a yet' winhaj Escol yet' winhaj Aner. Ha heb' chi' wach' yak'an heb' yet' winhaj Abram chi'.

Ayik ix yab'an winhaj Abram to ix ik'jib'at winhaj Lot chi', ix smolb'an masanil heb' schekab' winh k'ayb'ab'il t'a owal, haton heb' ix alji t'a yol scuenta winh, 318 heb' smasanil. Ix b'at heb' t'a spatik heb' chanhwanh rey chi' masanto b'aj ay chonhab' Dan tikne'ik, hata' ix yamchaj heb' yuj heb'.

Haxo t'ak'walil ix spojanb'at masanil heb' swinak winhaj Abram chi', ix och heb' winh yak' owal yet' chanhwanh heb' winh rey chi'. Ix pechji heb' winh yuj heb' winh, masanto t'a Hoba t'a yichanhb'at chonhab' Damasco ix k'och heb' winh.
Ix yik'anxi'ek' winhaj Abram jantak tastak ix yik'ek' heb' chi', ix ek'xikan winhaj Lot yet' masanil tas ay t'ay yet' pax heb' ix ix yet' juntzanhxo heb' ix ik'jib'at yuj heb' winh rey chi'.

Ayik toxo ix ak'ji ganar winhaj rey Quedorlaomer yet' heb' winh rey ayoch yet'ok yuj winhaj Abram chi', ix meltzajxi winh yet' heb' ix kolchajkan chi' yuj. Haxo winh sreyal Sodoma ix elta t'a yol b'e scha winh t'a jun ch'olan skuch Save, Ch'olan yik heb' Rey sb'i paxi.
Ha winhaj Melquisedec, sreyal Salem, sacerdote'al Dios Haxonhej Niwan Yelk'ochi, ha winh ix ak'an ixim pan yet' wino t'a winhaj Abram chi'.
Ix yalan wach' lolonel winh t'a yib'anh winh icha tik: Yak'okab' swach'k'olal Dios t'a ib'anh, haton Dios Haxonhej Niwan Yelk'ochi, haton ixb'o'an satcha'anh yet' sat lu'um.

Aljokab' wach' lolonel t'a Dios ix ak'anoch heb' ajk'o'ol t'a yol ha k'ab', xchi winh t'a winhaj Abram chi'. Ixlajwi chi', ha jantak tastak ix yik'ek' winhaj Abram t'a heb' winh rey chi', ix yak'an sdiezmo'al winh t'a winhaj Melquisedec chi'.
Haxo ix yalan winh sreyal Sodoma t'a winhaj Abram chi' icha tik: --Anhej heb' anima tzak' meltzaj t'ayin, haxo masanil tastak, kanokab' t'ayach, xchi winh.
Haxo ix yalan winhaj Abram chi' icha tik: --Toxo ix wak' hin ti' t'a Jehová, haton Dios Haxonhej Niwan Yelk'ochi, jun ixb'o'an satcha'anh yet' yol yib'anhk'inal tik,
to malaj jab'ok tas skan t'ayin, malaj wal jab'ok ch'al ma junok ch'anhal xanhab' skan t'ayin, yik wach' manh ol ala' to hu'uj tzin och b'eyumal.

Malaj jab'ok tas ix b'at wik'ek' tik tzin nib'ej skan t'ayin, anhej tas ix swa heb' hin chekab'. Haxo heb' ajun wet' tik, haton winhaj Aner, winhaj Escol yet' winhaj Mamre, ha heb' winh tik, scha'okab' yik heb' winh.
Ixlajwi juntzanh chi', ix lolon Jehová t'a winhaj Abram icha t'a wayichal, ix yalan icha tik: --Hach Abram manh hach xiwok, ha hin ol hach hin kolo', te niwan spak ol wak' t'ayach, xchi t'a winh.

Ix tak'wi winhaj Abram icha tik: --Hach Jehová Wajalil, ¿tas wal yopisio jun spak chi' wu'uj? Ojtak wal to malaj junok wuninal ix ak'a' yik hata' swak'xikan jantak tas ay t'ayin, yuj chi' ha junok hin chekab' ol cha'ankan masanil tas ay t'ayin, haton winhaj Eliezer aj Damasco, ha winh sat yaj t'a heb' hin chekab' smasanil, xchi winh.
Ix yalanxi Jehová t'a winh: --Ma'ay, ha t'a junok uninal ol kanok, manhoklaj t'a winh komon anima chi' ol kanok, xchi t'a winh.

Ixlajwi chi', ix ik'ji'elta winh yuj Dios t'a sti' smantiado, ix yalan t'a winh icha tik: --K'e'anh k'elan t'a satcha'anh. B'isto juntzanh k'anal chi' na'ik, tato syal ha b'isani. Ichaton chi' ol aj sb'isul heb' inhtilal, xchi t'a winh.
Ix yak'och winhaj Abram chi' t'a sk'o'ol tas ix yal Jehová chi', yuj chi' wach' ix kan winh t'a yichanh.
Ix yalanxi Jehová icha tik: --Ha hin ton Jehová hin hach wik'elta t'a chonhab' Ur t'a yol yik Caldea yik swak' jun lu'um tik t'ayach yik tzikej, xchi t'a winh.
--Palta hach Jehová Wajalil, ¿tas wal tz'aj wojtakaneli tato swikejkan jun lu'um tik? xchi winhaj Abram chi'.

Ix yalanxi Jehová: --Ik'kot junok nok' kob'es wakax t'ayin yet' junok nok' chiwa yet' junok nok' ch'ak kalnel, oxe' ab'il sk'inal junjun nok'. Tzik'anpaxkot junok nok' kuwajte' yet' junok nok' paramuch, xchi t'a winh.

Ix yik'kankot juntzanh nok' nok' chi' winh t'a yichanh Jehová chi', ix lajwi chi' ix schapojan snanhal junjun nok' winh. Jilip nok' ix kan t'a stz'ey jilipxo nok'. Haxo nok' much chi', maj schapojejlaj snanhal nok' winh.
Tz'em nok' ostok t'a yib'anh nok', haxo winhaj Abram chi' spechan nok'.
Ayik wanxo sk'ik'b'i, ix te sat sk'o'ol winhaj Abram chi' swayi, ix ja jun niwan xiwelal t'a yib'anh winh yuj jun niwan k'ik' k'inal.
Ixlajwi chi' ix yalan Jehová t'a winh: --Yowalil tzojtakejeli to ha heb' inhtilal, ol b'atkan kajan heb' t'a junokxo ch'ok chonhab'il, ol ochkan heb' chekab'ok, chanhe' ciento ab'il ol ixtaj heb'.
Palta ha hin ol wak'och yahelal t'a yib'anh jun chonhab' b'aj ayoch heb' chekab'ok chi'. Slajwi chi', ol elta heb' yet' jantak sb'eyumal.
Palta ha hach tik junk'olal ol aj ha chami ayik ol hach och icham winakil.
Chanh makanhxo inhtilal ix ek'i, ichato chi' ol meltzajxikot heb' t'a tik, yujto manto tz'akwok schukal heb' amorreo t'a tik, xchi Jehová.
Ayik t'ak'walilxo, ix sch'oxan sb'a jun k'ak' kulkon sk'e'i, b'akaki sk'e stab'il. Tz'ek' t'a skal nok' nok' chapoj yaj chi'.

Haton t'a jun ak'wal chi' ix sb'o strato Jehová yet' winhaj Abram chi', ix yalan icha tik: --Ha jun lu'um tik ol wak' t'a heb' inhtilal, schakot lum t'a jun smelemal ha' t'a yik Egipto, masanto t'a ha' Éufrates,
haton slu'um heb' ceneo, heb' cenezeo, heb' cadmoneo,
heb' hitita, heb' ferezeo, heb' refaíta,
heb' amorreo, heb' cananeo, heb' gergeseo yet' heb' jebuseo, xchi t'a winh.
Ha ix Sarai, yetb'eyum winhaj Abram, max unewilaj ix, palta ay jun ix scriada ix manb'il yuj, haton ix Agar, ix aj Egipto.

Ix yalan ix Sarai t'a winh yetb'eyum chi' icha tik: --Ina malaj wune' syak' Jehová, yuj chi' tzin tewi t'ayach to tzach way yet' ix hin criada tik, talaj tz'alji junok yune' ix yik tz'och wune'ok, xchi ix. Ix sk'anab'ajan winhaj Abram tas ix yal ix chi'.
Slajunhilxo ab'il ayek' heb' t'a Canaán, ix yak'anoch ix scriada ix chi' t'a yol sk'ab' winh yetb'eyum chi', yik tz'och ix schab'ilok yetb'eyum winh.
Ayik ix way winhaj Abram yet' ix Agar chi', ix skuchkanoch yune' ix. Haxo ix yab'an ix to yet'nakxo yune' ix, ix spatikanel ix Sarai chi' ix, manhxalaj tz'och ix t'a ix.

Ixlajwi chi', ix yalan ix Sarai t'a winhaj Abram chi' icha tik: --Hu'ujnhej emnakil tzin yutejkan ix hin criada tik. Tik pax ix wak' ix etb'eyumok, haxo tikne'ik yujto ix yab' ix to yet'nakxo yune' ix, tzin spatikanel ix. Wach' tzonh sch'olb'itej Jehová, ¿tom ha hach ay ha mul, mato ha hin? xchi ix Sarai chi'.
Ix tak'wi winhaj Abram chi' icha tik: --Ha ix ha criada tik, yol ha k'ab' ayoch ix. Ha hach tza na' tas tzutej ix, xchi winh t'a ix. Yuj chi' ix och ix Sarai ajk'olal t'a ix masanto ix elta ix.
Palta haxo Yángel Jehová ix schalaj sb'a yet' ix t'a tzinan lu'um t'a slak'anil jun ha ha' b'aj sb'atkan sb'e'al Sur t'a yol yik Egipto.
Ix sk'anb'an t'a ix icha tik: --Hach Agar, scriada ix Sarai, ¿b'ajtil ha petoj? ¿b'ajtil tzach b'ati? xchi t'a ix. --To tzin el t'a ix Sarai, ix hin patrona, xchi ix.
Ix yalan Yángel Jehová chi' t'a ix icha tik: --Meltzajanh t'a ix ha patrona chi', emnakil tzutej ha b'a t'a ix, xchi t'a ix.
Ix yalanpax Yángel Jehová chi': Ol wik'cha'anh sb'isul inhtilal, malaj mach ol yal sb'isani.
Ayxo unin het'nak, yuj chi' ayik ol aljok jun une' chi', Ismael ol ak' sb'i'ej, yujto ix yab' Jehová ok' yuj ha kusk'olal.

Icha nok' nok' te itz'at ol aj jun une' chi', icha junok nok' kaltakte'al b'uru. Ol yak' owal winh yet' heb' anima, ol yak'anpax owal heb' anima yet' winh. Ol kajnaj winh b'aj syak' snib'ej, wach'chom max schalaj sk'o'ol heb' ayto yuj sb'a chi' yet'ok, xchi jun ángel chi'.
Yujto ix lolon ix Agar chi' yet' Jehová, yuj chi' icha tik ix yak' ix sb'i'ok Jehová chi': Ha Dios Tzin hilani. Ix yalan ix icha tik: Toton wal yel ix wil Dios tzin hilani, xchi ix.
Ha ha' uk'b'ila' yik Dios Pitzan, Jun Tzin Hilani, icha chi' ix yak' ix sb'i'ok jun ha' uk'b'ila' chi'. Ha t'a skal Cades yet' Bered, hata' ay ha'. Ixlajwi chi' ix meltzajxi ix b'aj aytaxonek'i.
Ix alji jun yune' ix Agar yet' winhaj Abram chi'. Ismael ix yak' winh sb'i'ej.
86 ab'ilxo sk'inal winhaj Abram chi' ayik ix alji winhaj Ismael chi'.
Ayik 99 ab'il sk'inal winhaj Abram ix sch'oxanxi sb'a Jehová t'a winh, ix yalan icha tik: --Ha hin ton Dios hin, syal wu'uj masanil, wach'nhej tzutej ha b'a t'a wichanh.
Ol wak' jun hin trato het'ok, tzijtum inhtilal ol elok, xchi.
Ixlajwi chi' ix em nhojan winhaj Abram chi' t'a sat lu'um yakb'an wan slolon Dios yet' winh. Ix yalan icha tik:
--Haton jun hin trato tik ol wak' het'ok: Ol hach och smam yichamok tzijtumal nación.
Manhxo ol ha kuch Abram, palta Abraham xo ol ha b'i'ej, yujto ol hach wak'och smam yichamok tzijtumal nación.
Tzijtum ol aj wik'ancha'anh sb'isul inhtilal, tzijtum nación ol pitzwok yuj heb'. Ha t'a skal inhtilal chi', ay heb' rey ol elta.
Ha jun hin trato swak' het'ok tik yet' masanil heb' inhtilal chi' to ha Diosal hin, sDiosal hin pax heb' inhtilal chi' t'a jun'elnhej.
Ha tikne'ik paxyalwum hach t'a lum Canaán tik, palta masanil lu'um tik ol wak' ikej yet' heb' inhtilal t'a jun'elnhej, sDiosal hin pax heb', xchi Jehová.
Ix yalanxi Dios t'a winh: --Ha hachxo tik, k'anab'ajej jun hin trato tik, yowalil sk'anab'ajej pax heb' inhtilal chi' ayik ol b'eynhejb'at tiempo.
Ha jun hin trato wan hin b'o'an tik heyet'ok to yowalil tze k'anab'ajej. Masanil heb' winak unin, ochokab' yechel sniwanil heb'.
Yuj chi' ik'jokab'el stz'umal sjolom swinakil heb' he winak unin. Ha jun chi' yechel hin trato yaj heyet'ok.

Yukub'ixihal yaj junjun winak unin tz'och jun yechel chi' t'a heb', wach'chom heyuninal ma yuninal heb' he chekab'. Yowalil tz'ak'jipaxoch jun yechel chi' t'a heb' he chekab', heb' manb'il t'a ch'ok chonhab'il. Yowalil tz'och jun yechel chi' t'ayex, max yal yek'b'ati. Icha chi' b'i'an, ha jun hin trato tik heyet'ok niwan chekel ol aj t'a he niwanil t'a jun'elnhej.
Yalnhej mach junok winak to malaj jun yechel chi' t'ay, yowalil tzeyik'el t'a he kal, yujto max sk'anab'ajej hin trato ix wak' heyet'ok, xchi t'a winh.
Ix yalanxi Dios t'a winhaj Abraham chi' icha tik: --Ayik ol b'eyb'at tiempo tik, manhxo Sarai-ok ol sb'i'ej ix etb'eyum, palta Sara ol sb'i'ej ix.

Ol wak' hin wach'k'olal t'a yib'anh ix, ol aljok junok uninal yet' ix. Wal yel ol wak' hin wach'k'olal t'a yib'anh ix. Nunab'il ol aj ix t'a tzijtumal nación. Tzijtum heb' winh sreyal chonhab' ol elta t'a skal yinhtilal ix chi', xchi.

Ayik ix yab'an jun chi' winhaj Abraham chi', ix em nhojan winh t'a sat lu'um, ix och ijan winh stzewaji, ix och ijan winh sna'ub'tanhani: ¿Tom olto aljok wuninal? cien ab'ilxo hin k 'inal, 90 ab'ilxo sk'inal ix Sara, ¿tom olto wal aljok yune' ix? xchi winh.
Ixlajwi chi' ix yalan winh t'a Dios icha tik: --Tzin k'an t'ayach, tzok el wal t'a ha k'o'ol tzak' sk'inal winhaj Ismael tik yik wach' ol elk'och winh, xchi winh.

Ix tak'wi Dios chi' t'a winh icha tik: --Toxo ix wal t'ayach to ol aljok junok uninal yet' ix Sara. Isaac ol ak' sb'i'ej, haton yet' winh ol wak'elk'och jun hin trato tik t'a masanil k 'inal yet' heb' yinhtilal winh.

Ha pax winhaj Ismael jun, toxo ix wab' tas ix ala', ol wak' hin wach'k'olal t'a yib'anh winh, yuj chi' tzijtum ol aj yinhtilal winh. Ol k'ib'cha'anh sb'isul yinhtilal winh. Ha t'a skal yinhtilal winh chi', ol elta lajchawanh heb' niwak yajal. Ha yinhtilal winh chi', niwak nación ol ajok.
Palta ha hin trato ix wak' het'ok, ol wak'elk'och yet' winhaj Isaac winh uninal ol aljok t'a ix Sara t'a junxo ab'il icha tiempo tik, xchi Jehová.
Ayik ix lajwi slolon Dios yet' winh, ix paxk'e'i.

Haton t'a jun k'u chi' ix schek winhaj Abraham ak'ji'och jun yechel chi' t'a winhaj Ismael yet' t'a masanil heb' winh schekab' winh, heb' aljinak t'a yol scuenta winh yet' masanil heb' winh manb'il yuj winh yet' masanil heb' kajan yet' winh. Ix ak'ji'och yechel heb' smasanil, icha ix aj yalan Dios t'a winh.
Ha winhaj Abraham chi', 99 ab'il sk'inal winh, haxo winhaj Ismael 13 ab'il sk'inal winh ayik ix ak'ji'och jun yechel chi' t'a heb' winh.
Ha t'a jun k'u chi' ix ak'ji'och jun yechel chi' t'a heb' winh schawanhil
yet' t'a masanil heb' winh ayek' yet' winhaj Abraham chi', heb' schekab' winh aljinak t'a yol scuenta yet' heb' manb'il yuj winh t'a juntzanhxo ch'ok chonhab'il.
Ixlajwi chi' ix sch'oxanxi sb'a Jehová t'a winhaj Abraham t'a slak'anil juntzanh te' ji t'a yol yik winhaj Mamre. Chimk'uhalil am wal k'ojanelta winh t'a sti' smantiado.
Haxo ix yilan winh, linhjab' ek' oxwanh winak t'a yichanhb'at winh. Ayik ix yilan heb' chi' winh, ix b'at lemnaj winh schakot heb', ix emk'och nhojnaj winh t'a sat lum t'a yichanh heb'.
Ix yalan winh icha tik: --Hach mamin, tato wach' hin tzila', tzin tewi t'ayach to manh b'enhejok tzex ek'i.
Tanhwejek, b'at wala' yik tz'ik'chajkot jab'ok ha ha' yik tze b'ikel heyok, tzeyik'an heyip t'a yich te te' tik.
Yakb'an ayex ek' t'a hin tz'ey tik, tzin b'at wik'kot jab'ok tas ol he wa', yik wach' tz'och heyip, ichato chi' ol hex b'atxok, xchi winh t'a heb'. --Ixik an, xchi heb' t'a winh.
Ix ochb'at lemnaj winh t'a yol smantiado. Ix yalan winh t'a ix Sara icha tik: --Lem, ik'kot junok koxtal ixim harina te wach', tza b'o'an jantakok pan staji t'a kal tzak'ak', xchi winh t'a ix.
Ix b'at lemnaj winh b'aj ay nok' swakax, ix b'at yik'ankot jun nok' kelem wakax winh te wach', ix yak'an nok' winh t'a jun winh schekab' yik sb'o nok' winh t'a elanhchamel yik schichaj nok'.

Ix yik'ankot mantequilla winh yet' lech yet' nok' chib'ej ix b'ochaj chi', ix yik'anb'at winh t'a yichanh heb' yik swa heb'. Yakb'an wan swa heb' chi', ix och tek'tek' winh t'a stz'ey heb' t'a yich te te' chi'.
Ix sk'anb'an heb' t'a winh icha tik: --¿B'ajtil ayek' ix Sara ix etb'eyum? xchi heb'. --Ayoch ix t'a yol ko mantiado tik, xchi winh t'a heb'.

Ix yalan junok heb' icha tik: --Yab' icha tik junab', swak'anxi ha paxyal, hata' ol aljok junok yune' ix etb'eyum tik, winak unin, xchi t'a winh. Yakb'an ha ix Sara chi' wan smaklan yab' ix tas syala', ayek' ix t'a sti' smantiado heb' t'a spatik winhaj Abraham chi'.
Ha winhaj Abraham yet' ix Sara chi' te ichamtak animaxo heb'. Ha ix Sara chi' pekatax manhxalaj yechel unin syil ix,

yuj chi' tonhej ix tzewaj ix t'a yol sk'o'ol. Ayik ix yab'an ix yalji jun chi', ix sna'an ix icha tik: ¿Tasto wal ol aj hin nib'anoch jun tik, ina te chichim hinxo, te ichamxo pax winh wetb'eyum? xchi ix.
Yuj chi' ix yalan Jehová t'a winh icha tik: --¿Tas yuj tonhej stzewaj ix etb'eyum chi'? ¿Tzam sna' ix yujto chichimxo ix maxtzak yal yalji junok yune' ix?
¿Tom ay tas ajaltak t'ayin tze na'a? Yab' icha tik junab', tzin jax jun'elxo, swak'anxi ha paxyal. Hata' ol aljok jun yune' ix Sara chi', winak unin, xchi Jehová.
Ayik ix yab'an jun chi' ix Sara chi', ix te xiw ix, ix yalan ix icha tik: --Malaj hin tzin tzewaji, xchi ix. Haxo ix tak'wi Jehová t'a ix icha tik: --Wojtak to ix hach tzewaji, xchi.
Ixlajwi chi' ix b'at heb' oxwanh chi' t'a sb'e'al Sodoma. Ix b'at winhaj Abraham yet' heb' yik stak'lankan sb'a heb' yet' winh.
Ix yalan Jehová icha tik: Max yal-laj hin k'ub'anel t'a winhaj Abraham tik tas toxo ol hin k'ulej.
Ina to ha winh ol och smam yichamok jun niwan nación te tek'an ol ajok. Toxo ix wak' hin ti' to yuj winh ol scha' hin wach'k'olal masanil nación t'a yol yib'anhk'inal tik.

Ha hin ix hin sik'elta winh, yik wach' syalel hin cheknab'il winh t'a masanil yuninal yet' heb' kajan yet'ok, yik wach' sk'anab'ajej heb' sb'eyb'alan masanil tas wach' yet' tojolal, yik wach' swak'elk'och jantak hin lolonel ix wal t'a winh, xchi Jehová.
Yuj chi' ix yalan t'a winhaj Abraham chi' icha tik: --Masanil anima ay t'a Sodoma yet' t'a Gomorra, yalxonhej b'aj te chuk yel spekal heb', haxonhej wal chukal sk'ulej heb'.
Ha tikne'ik, tik tzin b'at wila', tato yel haxonhej chukal chi' sk'ulej heb' icha tz'aj yalchaj chi' t'ayin yik ol wojtakejeli tas yaji, xchi Jehová chi'.
Ay chawanh heb' b'enhej ix b'atkan t'a Sodoma, haxo winhaj Abraham chi' ix lolonkan winh yet' Jehová.
Ix snitzanb'at jab'xo sb'a winh t'a stz'ey Jehová chi', ix sk'anb'an winh icha tik: ¿Tom ol ha satel heb' anima malaj smul yet' heb' ay smul?
K'inalok ay 50-ok heb' wach' t'a jun chonhab' chi', ¿tom ol ha satel heb'? ¿tom manh ol ak' niwank'olal yuj heb' 50 malaj smul chi'?

Manh ol yal utan icha chi'. Tato tza satel heb' malaj smul yet' heb' ay smul chi', ichato lajan smul heb' smasanil syal chi'. Manh utej icha chi'. Ha hach tik Juez hach t'a yol yib'anhk'inal tik, ¿tokwal ol ha k'ulej junok tas manh tojolok? xchi winh t'ay.
Ix tak'wi Jehová t'a winh icha tik: --Tato ay 50-ok heb' wach' t'a chonhab' Sodoma chi', yuj heb' swak' niwank'olal masanil heb' kajan t'a jun chonhab' chi', xchi.
Ix yalanxi winhaj Abraham chi' icha tik: --Ak' niwank'olal t'ayin hach Wajalil yuj tas swal tik t'ayach, yujto ha hin tik, anima hinnhej.

K'inalok ayxonhej owanhok max tz'akwi 50 anima wach', ¿tom yujxonhej owanh chi', tza satel jun chonhab' chi' smasanil? xchi winh. Ix tak'wixi Jehová icha tik: --Tato ay 45-ok heb' wach', max hin satel-laj jun chonhab' chi', xchi.
Ix yalanxi winhaj Abraham chi' icha tik: --K'inalok anhej 40-ok heb' wach', xchi winh. --Yuj heb' 40 chi', manh ol hin satel-laj jun chonhab' chi', xchi Jehová.

Ix yalanxi winhaj Abraham chi' icha tik: --Hach Wajalil tzin tewi t'ayach, mokab' kot owal swalan t'ayach. K'inalok anhej 30-ok heb' wach' tz'ilchaj hu'uj, xchi winh. Ix tak'wixi Jehová chi' icha tik: --Ha yuj heb' 30 chi', ol wak' niwank'olal jun chonhab' chi', xchi.

Haxo winhaj Abraham chi' ix ochnhej ijan winh yalani: --Mamin Wajalil, tzin tewi wal t'ayach, ¿tas tzutej ta haxonhej 20-ok heb' wach'? xchi winh. Ix tak'wixi Jehová chi' icha tik: --Ha yuj heb' 20 chi', manh ol hin satel-laj jun chonhab' chi', xchi.

Ix yalanxi winhaj Abraham chi': --Ak'wal niwank'olal t'ayin hach Wajalil, mokab' kot owal t'ayin, haxonhej jun'el tik tzin tewi t'ayach, manhxa tas ol wala': ¿Tas tzutej, k'inalok tato haxonhej lajunhwanhok heb' wach' sb'eyb'al tz'ilchaj hu'uj? xchi winh. Ix yalanxi Jehová chi' icha tik: --K'inalok ay lajunhwanhok heb' wach' sb'eyb'al, manh ol hin satel-laj jun chonhab' chi', xchi.
Haxo ix lajwi slolon heb' chi', ix b'at Jehová, ix smeltzajkan winhaj Abraham chi' t'a smantiado.

Ayik wanxo sk'ik'b'i ix k'och chawanh heb' ángel chi' t'a chonhab' Sodoma. Ha winhaj Lot k'ojanek' winh t'a spuerta'il chonhab' chi'. Ix yilan winh to wan sja heb', ix k'e wa'an winh b'at schakot heb'. Ix em nhojnaj winh t'a yichanh heb'.

Ix yalan winh: --Hex mamin, tzin tewi t'ayex, koyek wet' t'a hin pat. Ay ha ha' b'aj ol he b'ikel heyok, ay pax b'aj wach' ol hex kan t'a jun ak'wal tik, haxo k'ik'an spet hex b'ati, xchi winh t'a heb'. Ix tak'wi heb' icha tik: --Yuj wal Dios t'ayach, palta ha honh tik ol honh kan t'a calle tik, ha tik ol honh wayok, xchi heb'.
Palta ix och wal te'an winhaj Lot chi' t'a heb', masanto ix b'at heb' t'a spat winh chi'. Haxo ix k'och heb', ix sb'o'an ixim pan winh malaj yich swa heb', ix wa heb' sik'lab'il.
Ayik mantzak way heb', ix k'och masanil heb' winh winak kajan chi' ta', ix oymaj heb' winh t'a spatiktak spat winhaj Lot chi'.

Ix och ijan heb' winh yawajoch t'a winhaj Lot chi', ix yalan heb' winh icha tik: --¿B'ajtil ayek' juntzanh heb' winh winak ix jakan t'a ha pat tik t'a jun ak'wal tik? Ik'elta heb' winh t'ayonh yik skixtej heb', xchi heb' winh.
Ayik ix yab'an juntzanh lolonel winhaj Lot chi', ix elta winh yil heb' winh. Wach' ix yutej winh smakankanelta te' puerta chi' t'a spatik.
Ix yalan winh: --Hex wetanima'il, tzin tewi t'ayex to manh he k'ulej jun chukal chi'.

Ay chawanh heb' ix wisil kob'estak, mantalaj winak tz'ek' t'a spatik heb' ix, syal wik'anelta heb' ix t'ayex yik tze k'ulej icha he gana chi' yet' heb' ix. Palta ha yet' heb' winh tik, max yal-laj, yujto tonhej ix jakan heb' winh t'a hin pat tik, xchi winh t'a heb' winh.

Ix yalan heb' winh: --Manh ak'och ha b'a, elanh t'a kichanh. Ha hach tik ch'ok chonhab'il hach, ¿tom ha hach ijan tzala'? Ha tikne'ik ek'b'al ol hach kixtej t'a yichanh heb' winh, xchi heb' winh. Ix och ijan heb' winh yekanel winhaj Lot chi' yik sk'och heb' winh t'a te' puerta chi', yik smak'anpoj te' heb' sna'ani.
Palta ha chawanh heb' ángel chi', ix yak'elta sk'ab' heb' yik tz'ik'ji'och winhaj Lot chi' yuj heb' t'a yol pat chi', ix smakanelta te' puerta chi' heb'.
Ix yak'an k'ik'yatax heb' anima ayek' t'a patik pat chi' heb', heb' icham winak yet' heb' kelemtak, ix te k'unb'i heb' sayanek' sti' te' pat chi'.
Ixlajwi chi', ix yalan heb' chawanh chi' t'a winhaj Lot: --Tato ayto heb' ay uj ha b'a yet'ok t'a tik, heb' winh uninal, heb' ix isil, heb' ha nhi', ma heb' ha k'ab'ok, ik'el heb' t'a tik.
Yujto ol ko satel jun chonhab' tik. Yujto ix te' k'ek'och schukal heb' t'a yichanh Jehová, yuj chi' honh schekkoti yik tzul ko satel juntzanh anima tik, xchi heb' ángel chi'.

Yuj chi', ix b'at winhaj Lot chi' yal t'a heb' winh t'inhan yik'lan sb'a yet' heb' ix yisil chi', ix yalan winh: --Pilek heyip, konh elek, yujto ha jun chonhab' tik ol satel yuj Jehová, xchi winh t'a heb'. Palta maj schalaj yab' heb' tas ix yal winhaj Lot chi'. Tonhej spukhan winh sna'an heb'.

Palta haxo yik wanxo sakb'i, ix yalan heb' ángel chi' t'a winhaj Lot chi': --Pil ip tato max yal ha k'o'ol tzach satel yet' jun chonhab' tik. Ik'b'at ix etb'eyum tik yet' heb' ix isil tik schawanhil, xchi heb' t'a winh.

Palta ha winhaj Lot chi', max spil-laj yip winh yeli. Yuj chi' ha heb' ángel chi' ix ketzan sk'ab' heb' schanhwanhil, yik tz'ik'ji'el heb', yujto tz'ok' sk'o'ol Jehová t'a heb'. Icha chi' ix aj yik'ji'el winhaj Lot yet' ix yetb'eyum yet' heb' ix yisil t'a yol chonhab' chi'.

Ayik toxo ix el heb' t'a sti'el chonhab' chi', ix yalan junok heb' ángel chi' t'a heb': --Yelk'olal tzex b'ati, manh hex meltzajkot k'elan t'a he patik. Manh hex och wa'an he b'ey t'a jun ak'lik tik, k'e'anhek t'a jolomtak witz, tato max yal he k'o'ol tzex sateli, xchi t'a heb'.
Ix tak'wi winhaj Lot chi': --Ma'ay mamin, yuj wal Dios t'ayex.
Te niwanxo he wach'k'olal ix he ch'ox t'ayin, ina ix hin heyik'elta yik max hin chami. Palta max yal-laj hin b'atkan t'a jolomtak witz chi', tekan tzin yamchajk'och yuj jun yahelal chi', tzin chami.
Ha t'a slak'anil tik ay jun yune' chonhab', tzam yal hin b'atkan t'ay. ¿Tom max yala' tzin he chab'at ta' yik tzin kol hin b'a? Wal yel yunenhej jun chonhab' chi', xchi winhaj Lot chi'.
Ix yalan jun ángel chi': --Toxo ix wab'i, yik'okab' icha tzal chi'. Manh ol hin satel jun chonhab' ix al chi'.
Elanhchamel he b'ati, yujto malaj tas syal hin b'o'ani ta maxto hex k'och ta', xchi jun ángel chi'. Yuj chi' Zoar ix sb'i'ejkan jun chonhab' chi'.
Ayik wan sjawi k'u ix k'och winhaj Lot chi' t'a jun chonhab' chi'.
Ixlajwi chi' ix yak'ankot k'ak' Jehová yet' azufre t'a satcha'anh t'a yib'anh chonhab' Sodoma yet' Gomorra chi'.
Ix satel juntzanh chonhab' chi' yet' masanil heb' kajan t'ay yet' masanil jun niwan ak'lik chi' yet' tas sk'ib' t'ay.
Ha ix yetb'eyum winhaj Lot chi', najat tzak'anto skot ix, ix meltzajxikanb'at k'elan ix t'a spatik. Hata' ix ochkan ix atz'amil.
Haxo t'a yewi'al slolon winhaj Abraham yet' Jehová, t'a k'inhib'alil, ix b'at winh b'aj lolon heb' chi'.
Haxo ix yilan winh to ha Sodoma yet' Gomorra yet' masanil jun ak'lik chi', b'akakixonhej sk'e stab'il icha sk'e stab'il junok niwan horno.

Ayik ix satji'el juntzanh chonhab' chi' yuj Dios t'a jun niwan ak'lik b'aj ix ek' kajan winhaj Lot chi', ix sna'ankot Dios tas ix sk'an winhaj Abraham, yuj chi' ix kolchaj winhaj Lot chi' t'a skal jun niwan yahelal chi'.
Ixlajwi chi', ix xiw winhaj Lot skajnaj t'a chonhab' Zoar chi', yuj chi' ix k'ekan winh t'a jolomtak witz yet' heb' ix yisil schawanhil, ix kajnaj heb' t'a yol jun k'e'en nhak'e'en.
Ay jun k'uhal ix yal ix b'ab'el ix t'a ix snulej: --Ha winh ko mam tik, te ichamxo winh, malaj junok winak t'a jun lugar tik syal kik'lan ko b'a yet'ok icha sb'eyb'al heb' anima.
Yuj chi' kak' yuk' anh winh ko mam tik, yik ol honh way yet' winh, yik wach' ol kan yinhtilal winh ket'ok, xchi ix.

Ha t'a jun ak'wal chi', ix yak' anh heb' ix yuk' winh, ix k'e anh t'a sjolom winh. Yuj chi' ha ix b'ab'el ix, ix way yet' winh. Maj yab' winh janik' ix way ix yet'ok, maj yab'pax winh janik' ix k'exwan ix t'a stz'ey.

Haxo t'a junxo k'u ix yalan ix b'ab'el chi' t'a ix snulej chi': --Ha k'ik'i t'ak'wal ix hin way yet' winh ko mam tik, haxo tikne'ik kak'xi anh yuk' winh yik wach' tzach way yet' winh yik ol kan yinhtilal winh ket' ko chawanhil, xchi ix.

Yuj chi' t'a jun ak'wal chi', ix yak'anxi anh heb' ix yuk' winh smam chi', haxo ix schab'il chi' ix way yet' winh. Palta ha winhaj Lot chi', maj yab' winh janik' ix way ix yet'ok, maj yab'pax winh janik' ix k'exwan ix.
Icha chi' ix aj yochkan heb' ix yisil winh chi' schawanhil yab'ixal yuj.
Ha ix b'ab'el, ix alji yune' ix, Moab ix yak' ix sb'i'ej, haton winh aykan yinhtilal heb' moabita tikne'ik.
Ix aljipax yune' ix schab'il chi', Ben-ammi, ix yak' ix sb'i'ej, haton winh aykan yinhtilal heb' amonita tikne'ik.
Ix el winhaj Abraham chi' t'a yol yik winhaj Mamre, ix b'atkan kajan winh t'a yol yik Neguev t'a jun chonhab' skuch Gerar. Ha t'a skal Cades yet' Shur, hata' ay Gerar chi'.
Ayik ayek' winh ta', ix yal winh to manh yetb'eyumok ix Sara winh, yanab' ix winh yalani. Ha winhaj Abimelec sreyal Gerar chi', ix schek winh ik'chajkot ix Sara chi' yik tz'och ix yetb'eyumok yalani.
Ay jun ak'wal, ix lolon Dios t'a winh rey chi' t'a swayich icha tik: Ol hach chamok, yujto ha ix ix, ix ik'kot etb'eyumok halani, ay yetb'eyum ix, xchi t'a winh.
Palta manto waylaj winh yet' ix Sara chi', yuj chi' ix yalan winh: Mamin, malaj hin mul, ¿tom tzin ha satel yet' hin chonhab' tik?

Yujto ha winhaj Abraham chi' ix halan t'ayin to yanab' ix winh. Ix yalanpax ix t'ayin: Hin nulej winh, xchi ix. Ha hin tik ix hin k'ulej t'a smasanil hin k'o'ol, manhok chukal na'an wu'uj, xchi winh rey chi'.
Ix tak'wi Dios t'a winh: Wojtak to ix ha k'ulej jun tik t'a stojolal, yuj chi' maj hin cha ha yam ix, yik wach' max och ha mul t'ayin.

Ha tikne'ik, ak' meltzaj ix t'a winh yetb'eyum chi', yujto hin chekab' yaj winh. Syal slesalwi winh hu'uj yik max hach chami. Palta tato max ak' meltzaj ix jun, wal yel ol hach chamok, ol champax jantak heb' kajan het'ok, xchi Dios t'a winh.
Haxo ix k'inhib'i, ix k'e wa'an winh rey chi', ix yawtankot masanil heb' schekab' winh, ix yalan winh t'a heb' tas ix swayichej chi'. Ayik ix yab'an jun chi' heb', ix te xiw heb'.

Ixlajwi chi' ix schekan winh rey chi' awtaj winhaj Abraham chi', ix yalan winh: --¿Tas yuj icha tik ix hin utej? ¿Tas hin mul t'ayach, yuj chi' ijan tzik'kot jun niwan mul tik t'a wib'anh yet' t'a yib'anh jantak heb' hin chonhab' tik? Manh wach'ok ix hin utej.
¿Tas ix ha na' yuj chi' icha tik ix ha k'ulej? xchi winh rey chi'.
Ix tak'wi winhaj Abraham chi' t'a winh: --Ha hin na'ani to ha t'a jun lugar tik malaj mach xiw t'a Dios. K'inalok ay mach tzin mak'ancham yuj ix wetb'eyum tik hin na'ani.
Wal yel wanab' ix, yisil ix winh hin mam, palta ch'ok snun ix, yuj chi' ix yal wik'lan hin b'a yet' ix.
Ayik ix yalan Dios to tzin el t'a spat winh hin mam, ix hin k'anan pawor t'a ix to sch'ox swach'k'olal ix t'ayin, yuj chi' yalnhej b'aj tzonh ek'i, syal ix to wanab' ix, xchi winhaj Abraham chi'.
Ix yak'anxi meltzaj ix Sara chi' winh t'a winhaj Abraham chi'. Ix ak'jipax nok' kalnel, nok' wakax, heb' winh chekab' yet' heb' ix chekab' t'a winh yuj winh rey chi'.
Ix yalanxi winh rey chi' t'a winh: --Ina hin makb'en tik, syal ha sik'lani b'ajtil syal ha kajnaji, xchi winh rey chi' t'a winh.

Ix yalanpax winh rey chi' t'a ix Sara: --Ix wak' mil siclo k'e'en plata t'a winh ha nulej tik, yik tz'och spakok t'ayach, yik sko ch'oxaneli to malaj ha mul ix ochi, yik wach' malaj mach syal yalan chukal t'a ha patik, xchi winh t'a ix.

Ixlajwi chi' ix lesalwi winhaj Abraham chi' t'a Dios yuj winhaj Abimelec chi'. Yuj chi' ix yik'xi'el skatab' Dios chi' t'a yib'anh winh yet' ix yetb'eyum yet' heb' ix schekab' winh, yik tz'aljixi yune' heb' ix.
Yujto yujnhej ix Sara chi', manhxa junok heb' ix ayek' t'a spat winhaj Abimelec chi' ixto unewi junok tiempo'al yuj Jehová.
Icha ix aj yalan Jehová Dios t'a ix Sara to ol aljok junok yune' ix, icha chi' ix aj yelk'ochi.
Ix skuchoch yune' ix, ix alji ayik te icham winakxo winhaj Abraham chi'. Ix alji jun swinak unin ix, icha wal stiempo'al alb'ilkan yuj Dios.
Isaac ix sb'i'ej yuj winhaj Abraham chi'.
Yukub'ixihal yalji winh unin chi', ix ak'ji'och yechel strato Dios t'a sniwanil winh yuj winhaj Abraham chi' icha yaj yalan Dios t'a winh.
Cien ab'ilxo sk'inal winhaj Abraham chi' ayik ix alji winhaj Isaac.
Ix yalan ix Sara icha tik: Ix hin yak' tzewaj ko Mam Dios. Masanil heb' tz'ab'ani to ay wune', ol tzewajpax heb' wet'ok.
¿Tok ay heb' anima ix halan t'a winhaj Abraham, tato olto wak' chunok unin? Palta ixto alji wune' yet' winh wach'chom icham winakxo winh, xchi ix Sara chi'.
Ix k'ib' winhaj Isaac, ix el winh t'a yim, yuj chi' ix yak'och jun niwan k'inh winhaj Abraham chi'.
Haxo ix yilan ix Sara to ha jun yuninal winhaj Abraham yet' ix Agar, ix aj Egipto, sb'uchwaj t'a winhaj Isaac chi'.

Yuj chi' ix ak'ji sk'o'ol winhaj Abraham yuj ix Sara chi', ix yalan ix: Pechb'at ix criada tik yet' winh yune' tik, yujto malaj hin gana ol yik' yik winh t'a tastak ol ak'kan t'a winh wune' aj Isaac tik, xchi ix.
Ha jun lolonel tik te ya ix och t'a winhaj Abraham chi', yujto yuninal pax winhaj Ismael chi' winh.

Haxo Dios ix halan t'a winh: Manh hach kus yuj winh unin tik yet' pax ix ha criada tik. k'anab'ajejnhej tas syal ix Sara chi', yujto ha t'a winhaj Isaac tik ol b'eynhejb'at jantak inhtilal, icha ix aj walan t'ayach.
Ha pax winh yune' ix criada chi' jun, ha hin ol hin b'o jun niwan nación t'a yinhtilal winh yujto uninal pax winh, xchi Dios.

Haxo t'a junxo k'u te ak'walto, ix yik'ankot wa'el winhaj Abraham chi' yet' jun nok' tz'u'um yet'tal ha' b'ut'an, ix yak'an winh skuch ix Agar chi', ix ak'jipax winh yune' ix t'a yol sk'ab', ix tak'ajb'at heb' yuj winh. Ix b'at ix, ix satb'eyek' ix t'a jun tzinan lu'um t'a yol yik Beerseba.
Ayik ix lajwi ha ha' t'a yol nok' tz'um chi', ix yaktankan winh yune' ix chi' t'a yich jun te' yune' te'.
Najattak ix b'at ix, ix em k'ojan ix, yik wach' max yil ix scham winh yune' chi' sna'ani. Ayik ix em k'ojan ix chi', ix k'e sjaj winh yok'i.

Ix yab'an Dios yok' winh, hato t'a satcha'anh ix lolonemta yángel Dios t'a ix Agar chi', ix yalani: Hach Agar, ¿tas tzach ik'ani? Manh hach xiwok, ha Dios toxo ix ab'an yel yaw winh une' chi' yok' b'aj ix aktejkan chi'.
Ixik b'at il winh, tzik'ank'e wan winh, tza montan winh, yujto ha yet' yinhtilal winh ol hin b'o jun niwan nación, xchi.
Haxo Dios ix ak'an yil jun sjaj ha ha' ix Agar chi', ix b'at ix, ix yak'an b'ut'jok nok' tz'u'um chi' ix t'a ha', ix yak'an ha' ix yuk' winh yune' chi'.
Ha Dios ix och yet' winhaj Ismael chi', ix k'ib' winh. Ix kannhej winh t'a jun tzinan lum t'a yol yik Parán. Te julum nok' ix aj winh. Haxo ix snun winh ix sayan jun ix aj Egipto yik'a'.

Ha t'a jun pekti' chi', ix jawi winhaj Abimelec t'a winhaj Abraham, ajun winhaj Ficol yajal yaj t'a heb' soldado yet' winh. Ix yalan winhaj Abimelec t'a winhaj Abraham chi' icha tik: --Ix kila' to ha Dios aynhejoch het'ok t'a masanil tas tza k'ulej.

Yuj chi' ak' ha ti' t'ayin t'a yichanh Dios t'a jun lugar tik, to manh ol ak' chukal t'ayin, t'a heb' wuninal yet' pax t'a heb' winhtilal. Tzak'an ha ti' to wach'nhej ol utej ha b'a t'ayin, icha ix wutej hin b'a t'ayach. Icha pax chi' ol utej ha b'a t'a heb' anima kajan t'a jun chonhab' b'aj janak hach kajan tik, xchi winh.
Ix tak'wi winhaj Abraham chi': --Swak' hin ti'.
Palta ay jun ha' uk'b'ila' hin chek joychajnak ix yik'ek' heb' winh ha chekab', xchi winh t'a winh.
Ix tak'wixi winhaj Abimelec chi': --Wal yel manh wojtakok tas yaj jun chi', malaj tas tzal t'ayin, hato tikne'ik swab'i. Mach am ix k'ulan jun chi', xchi winh.
