Yuj chi' ix yik'ankot nok' kalnel winhaj Abraham chi' yet' nok' wakax, ix yak'an nok' winh t'a winhaj Abimelec chi'. Ha t'a jun k'u chi' ix sb'okan jun strato heb' chi' schawanhil.
Ha winhaj Abraham chi' ix yik'elta ukwanh nok' kob'estak kalnel winh t'a skal nok' skalnel.
Yuj chi' ix sk'anb'an winhaj Abimelec chi': --¿Tas yuj tzik'elta nok' kalnel chi'? xchi winh.
Ix yalan winhaj Abraham chi' icha tik: --Cha nok' t'ayin, ha nok' sch'oxani to ha hin hin joynak jun ha' uk'b'ila' tik, xchi winh.
Yuj chi' Beerseba ix sb'i'ejkan jun lugar chi', yujto hata' ix yak'kan sti' heb' t'ay junjun.
Icha chi' ix aj sb'o'ankan jun strato heb' t'a Beerseba chi'. Ixlajwi chi' ix meltzaj winhaj Abimelec yet' winhaj Ficol t'a schonhab', haton schonhab' heb' filisteo.
Ha t'a Beerseba chi', ix yawej jun te te' winhaj Abraham skuch tamarisco. Ha t'a Beerseba chi' ix yal sb'a winh t'a Jehová, haton Dios aynhejek' t'a jun'elnhej.
Najtil ek'nak winh t'a smakb'en heb' filisteo chi'.
Ixlajwi yek' jun pekti', ix ak'ji prowal winhaj Abraham yuj Dios, ix awtaj winh, ix tak'wi winh icha tik: --Ina wajek' tik Mamin, xchi winh.

Ix yalan Dios t'a winh icha tik: --Ik'b'at winhaj Isaac jun pitanh uninal te xajan hu'uj, tzach b'at t'a lum Moriah. Ayik tzach k'och t'a sjolom lum tzalan ol hin ch'ox t'ayach, hata' ol ha nhustz'a winh silab'il t'ayin, xchi Dios.

Haxo t'a junxo k'u, te ak'walto ix k'e wa'an winhaj Abraham chi'. Ix yak'anoch stz'um nok' sb'uru winh, ix xikan te' sk'atzitzal jun silab' chi' winh. Ix yik'anb'at winhaj Isaac yuninal yet' chawanh heb' schekab', ix b'at winh yet' heb' t'a jun lugar ix yal Dios chi'.
Haxo t'a schab'ji'al, najatto ix yilb'at lum tzalan chi' winh.

Ix yalan winh t'a heb' schekab' chi': --Kananhek t'a tik yet' nok' b'uru tik, ha hinxo yet' winh wuninal tik, ol honh b'at t'a chi', yik skak'em ko b'a t'a ko Mam Dios. Slajwi chi', ol honh jax t'ayex, xchi winh t'a heb'.
Ixlajwi chi' ix yak'an te' k'atzitz chi' winh skuch winhaj Isaac chi', ix yik'anb'at skuchilub' winh yet' sk'ak', ix b'at heb' schawanhil.

Kenanto wal sb'at heb', ix yalan winhaj Isaac chi' t'a winh smam chi' icha tik: --Mamin, xchi winh. --¿Tas xchi wuninal? xchi winhaj Abraham chi'. --Ina ket'nak ko k'atzitz yet' ko k'ak', ¿b'aj ay pax nok' kalnel ol och silab'il chi'? xchi winh.
--Hach wuninal, ha Dios ol ak'an nok', xchi winh. Ix b'eynhejb'at heb'.

Haxo ix k'och heb' b'aj ix yal Dios chi', ix sb'o'an jun altar winhaj Abraham chi', ix sb'o'ank'e te' k'atzitz chi' winh t'a yib'anh. Ixlajwi chi' ix tzuyan winh yuninal winh chi', ix yak'ank'e winh t'a yib'anh te' k'atzitz chi'.
Ix yik'ankot k'e'en kuchilub' chi' winh yik smilancham yuninal winh chi' silab'il.
Haxo yángel Jehová ix awajemta t'a satcha'anh icha tik: --Abraham, Abraham, xchi. --¿Tas xchi Mamin? xchi winh.

Ix yalan jun ángel chi': --Manh ak'och ha k'ab' ha milancham winh uninal chi'. Ix wojtakejeli to ay welk'och t'a yol ha sat, yujto maj ha tenek' ak'an jun pitanh uninal chi' t'ayin, xchi yángel Jehová chi'.

Ix b'at k'elnaj winhaj Abraham chi' t'a spatik, ix yilan winh ayek' jun nok' ch'ak kalnel sut'ankan sch'ak t'a skal jun te' k'i'ix. Ix b'at lemnaj winh yik'kot nok', ix snhusan nok' winh silab'il sk'exulok winh yuninal chi'.
Ix yak'ankan sb'i jun lugar chi' winh: Ha Jehová tz'ak'an tas tz'och ku'uj. Yuj chi' syalnhej heb' anima icha tik: Ha t'a lum witz ha Jehová tz'ak'an tas tz'och ku'uj, xchi heb'.
Ix yalanxi'emta yángel Jehová chi' t'a winh:
--Ha hin ton Jehová hin swala': Yujto ix ha k'anab'ajej ha k'ulan jun tik, maj ha tenek' ak'an jun pitanh uninal t'ayin, yuj chi' swak' hin ti',

t'a wal yel ol wak' hin wach'k'olal t'a ib'anh. Ol wak' k'ib' sb'isul inhtilal, icha k'e'en k'anal t'a satcha'anh, ma icha pax yarena'il sti' ha' mar. Hanhejtona' pax heb' inhtilal ol yak' ganar heb' ayoch ajk'olal t'a heb'.
Yujto ix ha k'anab'ajej tas ix wala', yuj chi' masanil nación t'a yol yib'anhk'inal tik ol scha hin wach'k'olal yuj heb' inhtilal, xchi t'a winh.
Ixlajwi chi', ix meltzajxi winhaj Abraham chi' yet' winh yuninal b'aj aykan chawanh heb' schekab', junxonhej ix aj smeltzaj heb' t'a Beerseba chi', hata' ix kajnajkan heb'.
Ayik ix ek' jun tiempo, ix yab'an spekal winhaj Abraham chi' to ayxo yuninal winh yuktak winh, haton winhaj Nacor yet' ix Milca.
Ha winh sb'ab'el unin heb', Uz sb'i winh. Ha winh schab'il Buz sb'i winh, haxo winh yoxil Kemuel sb'i winh, haton winh smam yichamkan heb' Aram.
Ix aljipax winhaj Quesed, winhaj Hazo, winhaj Pildas, winhaj Jidlaf yet' winhaj Betuel.
Haton wajxakwanh heb' winh tik yune' ix Milca yet' winhaj Nacor chi'. Ha winhaj Betuel chi', haton winh smam ix Rebeca.
Ay juntzanhxo heb' yuninal winhaj Nacor yet' junxo ix yetb'eyum skuch Reúma, haton winhaj Teba, winhaj Gaham, winhaj Tahas yet' winhaj Maaca.
Ha ix Sara 127 ab'il sk'inal ix,
ayik ix cham ix t'a chonhab' Quiriat-arba, haton Hebrón t'a yol yik Canaán. Ix te ok' winhaj Abraham yuj schamel ix Sara chi', ix ochkan winh t'a kusk'olal yuj ix.
Ix kan sniwanil ix yetb'eyum winh chi', ix b'at winh t'a heb' hitita kajan t'a jun lugar chi', ix yalan winh t'a heb' icha tik:
--Wach'chom ch'ok chonhab'il wajek' t'a he kal, palta elokab' t'a he k'o'ol tze chonh jab'ok hin lu'um b'aj tzin muk sniwanil ix wetb'eyum chi', xchi winh t'a heb'.
Ix tak'wi heb' t'a winh:

--Mamin, ab' tas ol kal t'ayach, ha hach tik te niwan elk'och t'a ko kal tik, yuj chi' syal ha mukan ha chamnak chi' b'aj te wach' t'a ko kampusante. Malaj junok honh max ko cha ha muk sniwanil ix etb'eyum chi' t'a k'e'en k'e'en joyb'ilel yo'ol, xchi heb' t'a winh.
Haxo winhaj Abraham chi', ix k'e linhan winh, ix em nhojnaj winh yik sch'oxan winh to ay yelk'och heb' winh t'a sat winh.
Ix yalan winh: --Tato yel tz'el t'a he k'o'ol tzin muk sniwanil ix wetb'eyum chi' t'a tik, alek t'a winhaj Efrón, yuninal winhaj Zohar
to schonh k'e'en nhak'e'en winh t'ayin t'a Macpela t'a stitak slu'um winh. Ol hin tup t'a winh icha stojol yik swikejkan jun lugar chi' b'aj tzin muk hin chamnak t'a he kal, xchi winhaj Abraham chi'.
Ayek' winhaj Efrón hitita chi' t'a skal heb'. Ix tak'wi winh. Te cha'anh ix yal winh yik wach' syab' masanil heb' yetchonhab' molanek' chi' yet' heb' tz'och t'a yol chonhab' chi'. Ix yalan winh:

--Ma'ay mamin, swal t'ayach to ha jun nhak'e'en yet' lum lum chi' tonhej tzin si'ej t'ayach. Testigo tz'ajkan heb' wetchonhab' tik to tonhej tzin si'ej jun lum chi' t'ayach. Muk ix etb'eyum chi' ta', xchi winh.
Yuj chi' ix emxi nhojnaj winhaj Abraham chi' t'a yichanh heb' ayek' chi',
ix yalan winh t'a winhaj Efrón t'a yichanh heb' smasanil: --Ab' wal tas swal t'ayach to tza cha stojol lu'um, ichato chi' ol hin mukan ix wetb'eyum chi' ta', xchi winh.
Ix tak'wi winhaj Efrón chi':
--Ab' jun mamin, 400 siclo k'e'en plata stojol lu'um. Yujto ha hach, swak' lum t'ayach icha jun stojol chi', toxonhej b'at ha muk ix, xchi winh.
Ix scha sk'o'ol stojol lum chi' winhaj Abraham icha ix yal winh t'a yichanh masanil heb' winh hitita chi'. Ix stupan lum winh icha ix aj strato heb' chi'.

Icha chi' ix aj yochkan lum slu'um winhaj Efrón chi' yikok winhaj Abraham chi', lum Macpela t'a slak'anil lum yik winhaj Mamre, b'aj ay k'e'en nhak'e'en yet' te te'. Ix yikejkan masanil juntzanh chi' winh.
Ix yikejkan lum winhaj Abraham chi' t'a yichanh masanil heb' winh hitita molanek' ta'. Masanil heb' tz'och t'a spuerta'il chonhab' chi', testigo pax ix ajkan heb' t'a jun trato chi'.
Ixlajwi chi', ix smukankan ix yetb'eyum winh chi' t'a k'e'en nhak'e'en t'a lum Macpela chi', t'a slak'anil slu'um winhaj Mamre t'a Hebrón t'a yol yik Canaán.
Icha chi' ix aj schonhankanel slu'um heb' winh hitita yet' k'e'en olan k'e'en t'a winhaj Abraham b'aj smuk schamnak.
Te icham winakxo winhaj Abraham, haxo Jehová ix yak' swach'k'olal t'a yib'anh winh yet' t'a yib'anh masanil tas ay t'a winh.

Ay jun schekab' winh te ichamxo, sat yaj t'a juntzanhxo heb' schekab', ayoch yilumalok masanil tastak ay t'a winh. Ay jun k'uhal ix awtaj winh yuj winhaj Abraham chi', ix yalan winh: --Ak'och ha k'ab' t'a yalanh hin xub' tik,
tzak'an ha ti' t'a yichanh Jehová Dios yajal satcha'anh yet' yol yib'anhk'inal tik, to manh ol ha saylaj ix yetb'eyum winh wuninal t'a skal heb' aj Canaán, b'aj kajan honh tik,
palta t'a hin chonhab' tzach b'ati, b'at ha say junok ix yetb'eyum winh t'a skal heb' hin k'ab' wok, xchi winh t'a winh.
Ix tak'wi winh schekab' winh chi': --K'inalok max stak'kot sb'a ix wet'ok, ¿tas swutej? ¿Yowalil am swik'b'at winh b'aj kotnak hach chi'? xchi winh schekab' chi'.
Ix tak'wi winhaj Abraham chi': --Ma'ay, manh ik'b'at winh.

Ha Jehová sDiosal satcha'anh ix hin ik'anelta b'aj ay spat hin mam yet' t'a hin chonhab' b'aj ek'nak hin. Ix yak'an sti' t'ayin yak'an jun lum tik t'a winhtilal. Hanheja', ha' ol chekanb'at yángel het'ok, yik wach' tzik'kot ix yetb'eyum winh wuninal tik ta'.
Palta tato max yal sk'o'ol ix skot het'ok jun, kolan tzach ajkan t'a jun ko trato skak' tik. Palta jun'elnhej max yal-laj ik'anb'at winh wunin tik ta', xchi winh t'a winh.
Ixlajwi chi', ix yak'anoch sk'ab' jun winh chekab' chi' t'a yalanh xub' winhaj Abraham chi', ix yak'an sti' winh to ol sk'anab'ajej winh masanil tas ix yal winh spatrón chi'.

Ixlajwi chi', ix sik'anelta juntzanh silab' winh t'a skal masanil tastak ay t'a winh spatrón chi', juntzanh te wach'. Ix yik'anb'at lajunhwanh nok' camello winh skuchumalok, ix b'at winh t'a chonhab' b'aj ek'nak winhaj Nacor chamnak, t'a yol yik Mesopotamia.
Ayik ix k'och winh chekab' t'a sti'el chonhab' chi', yik wanxo sk'ik'b'i, ix yik' yip winh yet' nok' camello t'a sti' jun ha' uk'b'ila'. Ha t'a jun hora chi' tz'ek' heb' ix kob'estak yik' ya'al.

T'a jun rato chi', ix och ijan winh slesalwi t'a Dios t'a spixan icha tik: Mamin Jehová, hach ko Diosal yet' winhaj Abraham hin patrón, tzin k'an t'ayach to wach'okab' tz'elk'och jun hin cheknab'il tik, tza ch'oxan ha wach'k'olal t'a winh hin patrón chi'.
Tik tzin kan t'a sti' jun ha' uk'b'ila' tik, yakb'an sja heb' ix kob'estak aj chonhab' tik ul yik' ya'al.

Elokab' t'a ha k'o'ol to ha junok ix kob'es ol ja yik' ya'al, ol wal t'a ix icha tik: Tzin tewi t'ayach, ik'emta ha ch'ub' chi', tzak'an jab'ok ha'al chi' wuk'u', xin cham t'a ix. Haxo ol yalan ix: Uk' ha', ol wak'anpax ha' yuk' nok' ha camello tik, xcham ix, a'okab' ix chi' tza sik'eli yik tz'och yetb'eyumok winhaj Isaac ha chekab'. Icha chi' ol aj snachajel wu'uj to ay ha wach'k'olal t'a winh hin patrón, xchi winh chekab' chi' t'a slesal.

Manto lajwilaj slesalwi winh, ix yilan winh skot jun ix kob'es, ayk'e sch'ub' ix t'a sjolom sjenhjab', haton ix Rebeca yisil winhaj Betuel. Ha winhaj Betuel chi' yunekan winh ix Milca yet' winhaj Nacor, winh yuktak winhaj Abraham.

Ha ix Rebeca chi' te wach' yilji ix, kob'es ton wal ix, mantalaj junok winak sk'uman ix. Ix em ix b'aj ay ha' uk'b'ila' chi' yik syik'k'eta ha' ya'al ix, ix yak'an b'ut'jok sch'ub' ix chi'. Ayik wan spax ix,
ix b'at lemnaj winh chekab' chi' stzak'wej ix, ix yalan winh t'a ix icha tik: --Tzin tewi t'ayach, ak' wuk' jab'ok ha'al t'a yol ha ch'ub' chi', xchi winh t'a ix.
--Uk'ej ha' mamin, xchi ix. Elanhchamel ix yak'em sch'ub' ix chi', ix yak'an ha' ix yuk'ej winh.
Ixlajwi yuk'an ha' winh, ix yalan ix icha tik: --Syalpax wik'ank'eta ha' yuk' nok' ha camello tik, hato syala' jantak syuk' nok', xchi ix.
Elanhchamel ix sekem ha' ix t'a yol jukub' b'aj syuk'taxon ha' nok' nok'. Tzijtum el ix yak' ix yik'ank'eta ha' masanto ix yuk' ha' nok' smasanil.
Haxo winh chekab' chi' jun, tonhej ix och k'elan winh t'a ix. Malaj tas ix yal winh, anhej to sna'a winh yik syojtakejeli tas wan sk'ulan Jehová yik wach' tz'elk'och jun scheknab'il chi'.

Haxo ix lajwi yuk'an ha' nok' camello chi', ix yik'ank'eta jun k'e'en oro winh icha uchikin, nanhal siclo yalil, ix yak'anoch winh t'a snhi' ix, ix yak'anpax chab' k'e'en brazalete winh t'a ix, nab'a oro k'e'en, ek'b'al 10 siclo yalil k'e'en.
Ix yalan winh: --Tzin tewi t'ayach to tzal t'ayin mach ayach yiko', talaj kolan tzonh waykan t'a spat winh ha mam chi' t'a jun ak'wal tik, xchi winh t'a ix.
Ix yalan ix: --Yisil hin winhaj Betuel, yuninal winhaj Nacor yet' ix Milca.
Ha t'a ko pat kolan tzex wayi. Ay pax tas ol swa nok' ha camello tik, xchi ix.
Ix yab'an winh chekab' chi', ix em kumnaj winh, ix yalan wach' lolonel winh t'a Jehová, ix yak'an yuj diosal winh t'ay.

Ix yalan winh: Alchajokab' wach' lolonel t'a Jehová ko Diosal yet' winhaj Abraham hin patrón. Yelton wal aynhejoch Jehová yet' winh, aynhej swach'k'olal t'a winh, yuj chi' ix hin skuchb'ej t'a yoltak b'e tik masanto t'a skal heb' sk'ab'yok winh hin patrón chi', xchi winh.
Haxo ix Rebeca ix b'at lemnaj ix t'a spat snun, yik syalan masanil tas ix yal winh chekab' chi' t'ay.
Ay jun winh snulej ix skuch Labán, elanhchamel ix b'at lemnaj winh b'aj ay ha' uk'b'ila' chi' yik syik'kot winh chekab' chi'.
Yujto ix yiloch k'e'en oro winh, k'e'en ayoch t'a snhi' ix yet' k'e'en brazalete ayoch t'a sk'ab' ix yanab' chi', yuj chi' ix b'at winh b'aj ayek' winh schekab' winhaj Abraham chi' yet' nok' camello.

Ix yalan winh t'a winh chekab' chi': --Mamin, konh wet'ok b'aj ay hin pat, yujto ay swach'k'olal Jehová t'ayach. Max yal tzach kan t'a tik. Toxo ix hin b'o b'aj ol hach wayok, ay pax b'aj wach' ol kan nok' ha camello tik, xchi winh.

Ixlajwi chi', ix b'at winh chekab' chi' t'a spat winh. Ix kolwaj winhaj Labán chi' yik'anel yikatz nok' camello chi'. Ix yak'an wa nok' winh. Elanhchamel ix yik'kot ha ha' winh yik sb'ikchaj yok winh chekab' chi' yet' heb' ajun yet'ok.
Ayik ix ak'ji wa heb', ix yalan winh chekab' chi': --Manto ol hin walaj, yowalil ol walkan tas hin cheknab'il wet'nak, xchi winh. --Lolonanh an mamin, xchi winhaj Labán chi'.
Ix yalan winh chekab' chi': --Ha hin tik schekab' hin winhaj Abraham.

Ix yak' swach'k'olal Jehová t'a yib'anh winh. B'eyum wal winh sik'lab'il. Ay nok' skalnel winh, ay nok' swakax winh, ay nok' scamello winh, ay nok' sb'uru winh, ay pax k'e'en oro yet' k'e'en plata t'a winh. Ay pax heb' winh schekab' winh yet' heb' ix schekab' winh.
Hanhejtona' ix Sara yetb'eyum winh, yikxo wal schichimal, ix alji jun yune' ix. Haxo masanil tas ay t'a winh hin patrón chi', yiknhejton winh yuninal winh chi'.

Ha winh hin patrón chi' ix yal winh to swak' hin ti' yik tzin k'anab'ajej scheknab'il. Ix yal winh icha tik: Manh ol yal-laj yik'lan sb'a winh wuninal tik yet' junok heb' ix aj Canaán b'aj ay honh ek' tik.
Yuj chi', tzach b'at ha say ix yetb'eyum winh wuninal tik t'a skal heb' hin k'ab' wok. Hata' tzach b'ati, xchi winh t'ayin.
Ix walan t'a winh hin patrón chi': Ha junok ix ix sb'at wik'kot chi', tato max stak'kot sb'a ix wet'ok, ¿tas wach' swutej? xin chi.

Ix tak'wi winh t'ayin: Ha hin tik, emnakilnhej swutej hin b'a t'a Jehová. Ha' ol schekb'at yángel het'ok yik wach'nhej ol aj yelk'och jun ha cheknab'il chi', yik tzik'ankot junok ix yetb'eyum winh wuninal tik t'a skal heb' hin k'ab' wok.
Haxonhej tato ha heb' chi' max ak'an ix kob'es chi' t'ayach, kolan hach b'aj ix ak' ha ti' t'ayin, xchi winh hin patrón chi' t'ayin.

Icha chi' jun, ix hin ja t'a sti' ha' uk'b'ila' chi' tikne'ik, ix hin lesalwi t'a Dios icha tik: Hach Jehová ko Diosal yet' winhaj Abraham hin patrón, tato yel ayach och wet'ok, tato wach' ol elk'och jun hin cheknab'il tik,

tzin tewi t'ayach, yakb'an ayinek' t'a sti' ha' uk'b'ila' tik, haxo ol ajok, to ha ix kob'es ol ja ik'oj ha', ol walan t'a ix: Tzin tewi t'ayach to tzak' wuk' jab'ok ha'al t'a yol ha ch'ub' chi', xin cham t'a ix.
Axom ol yalan ix chi': Uk'a', swik'paxk'eta ha' yuk' nok' ha camello tik, xchampax ix. Haton wal ix chi' ix ha sik'eli yik tz'och yetb'eyumok winh yuninal winh hin patrón, xin chi t'a hin lesal chi'.

Ayto wal slajwi hin lesal chi' t'a esalil, ix wilani, ix k'och ix Rebeca tik, ix em ix b'aj ay ha' uk'b'ila', ayk'e sch'ub' ix t'a sjolom sjenhjab'. Ix walan t'a ix: Tzin tewi t'ayach, ak' wuk' jab'ok ha'al chi', xin chi t'a ix.

T'a elanhchamel ix yik'emta sch'ub' ix, ix yalan ix: Uk'ej ha' mamin, yet' pax nok' ha camello, ol wak'pax yuk'a' nok', xchi ix. Icha chi' jun, ix yak'an ha' ix wuk'ej, ix yak'anpax ha' ix yuk' nok' hin camello chi'.

Ix hin k'anb'an t'a ix: ¿Mach ayach yisil? xin chi t'a ix. Ix yalan ix t'ayin: Yisil hin winhaj Betuel, yuninal winhaj Nacor yet' ix Milca, xchi ix. Ix wak'anoch jun k'e'en icha uchikin t'a snhi' ix, ix wak'anpaxoch junjun k'e'en brazalete t'a junjun sk'ab' ix.

Ixlajwi chi' ix hin em kumnajok, ix walan hin b'a t'a Jehová hin Diosal yet' winh hin patrón t'a lesal, ix wak'an yuj diosal t'ay yujto aynhejoch wet'ok yik hin kot t'a yol b'e. Wach'nhej ix aj hin koti, yik tzul wik'an ix yetb'eyum winh yuninal winh hin patrón t'a he kal ha hex sk'ab' yok hex winh tik.
Ha tikne'ik jun, lolonanhek. ¿Wach'nhej am ol heyutej he pensar t'a winh hin patrón chi'? Tato ma'ay jun, alekpax t'ayin, yik wach' snachajel wu'uj tas tzin k'ulej, xchi winh chekab' chi'.
Ixlajwi chi' ix yalan winhaj Labán yet' winhaj Betuel: --Masanil juntzanh tik ix kot t'a Jehová, ha honh tik manhxalaj tas wach' kalan t'ayach.
Ina ix tik, ik'b'at ix, b'atokab' ix yetb'eyumok winh yuninal winh ha patrón chi', icha wal ix aj sna'an Jehová, xchi heb'.
Haxo yik ix yab'an winh chekab' chi' jun, ix em kumnaj winh t'a yichanh Jehová, ix yak'an yuj diosal winh t'ay.
Elanhchamel ix yik'k'eta jantak silab' winh, haton k'e'en oro, k'e'en plata yet' pichul, ix yak'an winh t'a ix Rebeca yet' t'a winh snulej ix yet' pax t'a ix snun ix.

Ixlajwi chi', ix wa winh yet' heb' ajun yet'ok, hata' ix waykan heb' t'a jun ak'wal chi'. Haxo yik ix k'e wa'an heb' t'a k'inhib'alil t'a junxo k'u, ix yalan winh chekab' chi': --Ha tikne'ik jun, chekekb'at ix wet'ok t'a winh hin patrón, xchi winh.
Ix tak'wi winh snulej ix yet' ix snun ix chi', ix yalan heb': --Kanokab' jaye'okxo k'uhal ix ket'ok, ichato chi' ol b'at ix het'ok, xchi heb' t'a winh.
Haxo ix tak'wi winh chekab' chi': --Manhxo hin heyamoch wa'an. Ha Jehová aynhejoch wet'ok, yuj chi' wach' ix aj yelk'och jun hin cheknab'il tik. Cha'ek hin pax t'a winh hin patrón, xchi winh.
Ix yalan heb': --Awtejekkot ix kob'es chi', ol kab'i tas xchi ix, xchi heb'.
Ix awtajkot ix Rebeca chi', ix sk'anb'an heb' t'a ix: --¿Tzam yal ha k'o'ol tzach b'at yet' jun winh winak tik? xchi heb'. --I' syala', ol hin b'atok, xchi ix.
Ixlajwi chi', ix yak'anb'at ix Rebeca chi' heb' winh yet' jun ix ix, ix ilan k'ib' ix yet' winh chekab' chi' yet' heb' yetb'eyum winh yet'nak.

Ix yalan wach' lolonel heb' t'a ix Rebeca icha tik: Yak'okab' swach'k'olal Jehová Dios t'a ib'anh, ol hach och snunok jantak smillonal anima. Ha jantak heb' ol och ajk'olal t'a heb' une' ol aljok, ol kan heb' t'a yalanh yuj heb' une' chi', xchi heb'.

Ixlajwi chi', ix k'e ix Rebeca yet' heb' ix schekab' t'a yib'anh nok' camello, ix och tzak'an heb' t'a spatik winh schekab' winhaj Abraham chi'. Ichaton chi' ix aj yik'anb'at ix Rebeca winh chekab' chi', ix b'at heb' b'i'an.
Ayik wan slak'anwi ja heb' t'a Beerseba, ha winhaj Isaac, toxo ix meltzaj winh t'a jun ha' uk'b'ila' skuch Ha Dios Pitzan Tzin Hilani. Ha t'a yol yik Neguev kajan winh.
Haxo yik wanxo yem k'u, wan sb'eyek' winh, wan sna'ub'tanhan winh, haxo ix yilan winh to ay juntzanh nok' camello skoti.

Hanhejtona' ix Rebeca, ix b'at k'elan ix, ix yilanb'at winhaj Isaac chi' ix. Ix sk'anb'an ix t'a winh chekab' chi': --¿Mach jun winh winak skot t'a kichanh tik? xchi ix. Ix yalan winh chekab' chi': --Haton winh hin patrón chi', xchi winh. Yuj chi', ix yik'anemta smusil sat ix, elanhchamel ix emta ix t'a yib'anh nok' camello chi'.
Ix yalan winh chekab' chi' t'a winhaj Isaac tas ix aj yelk'och scheknab'il.

Ix ik'jib'at ix Rebeca yuj winhaj Isaac t'a smantiado ix Sara, ix snun winh chamnak, ix yik'lan sb'a winh yet' ix. Te xajan ix Rebeca chi' yuj winh. Icha chi' ix aj yek' skusk'olal winh yuj schamel ix snun.
Ixto yik' junxo ix yetb'eyum winhaj Abraham chi' skuchan Cetura.
Ha heb' yuninal winh ix alji yet' ix, haton winhaj Zimram, winhaj Jocsán, winhaj Medán, winhaj Madián, winhaj Isbac yet' winhaj Súa.
Ha winhaj Jocsán smam winhaj Seba yet' winhaj Dedán. Ha pax heb' yinhtilal winhaj Dedán jun, haton heb' asureo, heb' letuse'o yet' heb' le'ume'o.
Haxo pax heb' yuninal winhaj Madián chi', haton winhaj Efa, winhaj Efer, winhaj Hanoc, winhaj Abida yet' winhaj Elda. Masanil juntzanh heb' tik yinhtilal winhaj Abraham chi' yet' ix Cetura.
Ix yak' winh masanil tas ay t'ay smakb'enok winhaj Isaac.

Haxo pax yune' juntzanhxo heb' ix chi' jun, haxonhej silab' ix ak'chaj t'a heb' yuj winh. Ayik pitzanto winh, ix och ijan winh schekankanel heb' winh chi' winh t'a stz'ey winhaj Isaac chi'. Ix chekjib'at heb' winh t'a stojolal b'aj sjawi k'u.
Ha winhaj Abraham chi', 175 ab'il sk'inal winh ayik ix cham winh.
Ichamilxo ix ik'an scham winh.

Ha heb' yuninal winh, haton winhaj Isaac yet' winhaj Ismael xit' mukan winh t'a k'e'en olan k'e'en t'a Macpela, t'a slak'anil lum slu'um winhaj Mamre t'a lum yikejnak jun'el winhaj Efrón yuninal winhaj Zohar, winh hitita.
Haton lum chi' manb'ilkan yuj winhaj Abraham t'a heb' hitita. Ha b'aj mukb'il ix Sara, hata' ix mukchaj winhaj Abraham chi'.
Haxo yik toxo ix cham winh, ix yak'ankot swach'k'olal Dios t'a yib'anh winhaj Isaac. Ix kan kajan winh t'a slak'anil ha' uk'b'ila' skuchan Ha Dios Pitzan Tzin Hilani.
Haton yab'ixal heb' yinhtilal winhaj Ismael yuninal winhaj Abraham yet' ix Agar, ix aj Egipto, haton ix ek'nak criada'il t'a ix Sara.
Haton stzolal tik, tas ix aj yalji heb': Winhaj Nebaiot, haton winh b'ab'el unin chi', slajwi chi' winhaj Cedar, winhaj Adbeel, winhaj Mibsam,
winhaj Misma, winhaj Duma, winhaj Masa,
winhaj Hadar, winhaj Tema, winhaj Jetur, winhaj Nafis yet' winhaj Cedma.
Haton sb'i heb' lajchawanh yuninal winhaj Ismael tik. Ha sb'i heb' winh chi' ix och sb'i'ok slu'um b'aj ix kajnaji. Junjun heb', yajal ix ajkan heb' t'a junjun chonhab'.
Ha winhaj Ismael chi', 137 ab'il sk'inal winh, ayik ix cham winh.

Ha masanil heb' yinhtilal winh chi', ix k'ochkan kajan heb' t'a skal Havila yet' Shur, t'a yichanhkot lum Egipto b'aj sb'at b'e'al Asiria. Hata' ix kajnaj heb', wach'chom malaj snib'ej heb' sk'ab' yok heb'.
Haton yab'ixal winhaj Isaac yuninal winhaj Abraham:
40 ab'il sk'inal winhaj Isaac chi' ayik ix yik'lan sb'a winh yet' ix Rebeca yisil winhaj Betuel, yanab' winhaj Labán arameo, haton winh kajan t'a Padán-aram.
Ha ix Rebeca chi' malaj yune' ix. Haxo winhaj Isaac ix lesalwi t'a Jehová yik tz'ak'ji yune' heb' yuj. Icha chi' jun, ix ab'ji slesal heb' yuj Jehová, ix och ix Rebeca yab'ixal.
Ha heb' unin chi', ti'ox heb'. Ix yak' owal heb' t'a yol sk'o'ol snun chi'. Yuj chi' ix sna' ix: ¿Tas yuj sja jun tik t'a wib'anh? xchi ix. Ixlajwi chi' ix b'at yalan sb'a ix t'a Jehová.

Ix tak'wi Jehová chi' t'a ix: Chab' chonhab'il ol aj yinhtilal heb' chawanh het'nak chi'. Yiktax manto aljok heb', ol och heb' ajk'olal t'ay junjun. Jun te ay yip, te tek'an t'a yichanh junxo. Ha winh b'ab'el, ol kan winh t'a yalanh smandar winh tzak'an, xchi t'a ix.
Ix k'och sk'uhal yalji heb' yune' ix Rebeca chi', ti'ox heb' unin ix alji chi'.
Ha winh b'ab'el ix alji, te chak tzeminak yilji winh, te ay xil sniwanil winh, Esaú ix yak' heb' sb'i'ej winh.
Tzak'an ix alji junxo yuktak chi', yub'yub' och t'a sjaj yok winhaj Esaú chi', yuj chi' Jacob ix yak' heb' sb'i'ej. 60 ab'il sk'inal winhaj Isaac chi' ayik ix alji heb' yune' ix Rebeca chi'.

Ix k'ib'nhej chawanh unin chi'. Ha winhaj Esaú pechoj nok' ix sk'ulej winh. Anhej kaltak te' snib'ej winh tz'ek'i. Haxo pax winhaj Jacob chi', malaj b'aj tz'ek' winh t'a najat, aynhejek' winh t'a scampamento.
Te xajan winhaj Esaú yuj winhaj Isaac chi' yujto snib'ej winh schi nok' k'ultakil nok' sja yuj winh. Haxo pax winhaj Jacob jun, te xajan winh yuj ix Rebeca.
Ay jun k'uhal, wan stz'anhan jun wa'el winhaj Jacob chi' ayik ix jax winhaj Esaú chi' b'eyelek' t'a kaltak te', te ay swejel winh.
Ix yalan winh t'a winhaj Jacob chi': Ak' wal jab'ok jun ha wa'el chak yilji tik t'ayin, yujto tzin cham yuj wejel, xchi winh. (Yuj chi' Edom ix ak'ji sb'i'ej winh.)
--T'a sb'ab'elal, ak'kan ha derecho yik b'ab'el winakil t'ayin, ichato chi' ol wak'ani, xchi winhaj Jacob chi'.
Ix yalanxi winhaj Esaú chi': --Ina wan hin cham yuj wejel, yilxo jun hin derecho yik b'ab'el winakil chi', ¿tas wal ol och wu'uj? xchi winh.

--Ak'kan ha ti' t'ayin t'a jun rato tik, xchi winhaj Jacob chi'. --Hinye, xchi winhaj Esaú chi'. Ix yak'an sti' winh yik sch'oxaneli to syak'kan sderecho winh yik sb'ab'el winakil t'a winhaj Jacob chi'.

Ixlajwi chi' ix yak'an ixim pan yet' jun plato wa'el winhaj Jacob chi' t'a winh. Haxo yik ix lajwi swa winh, ix k'e wa'an winh, ix b'at winh. Malaj yelk'och jun derecho yik b'ab'el uninal chi' t'a winh.

Ha t'a jun'el ix ja jun niwan wejel t'a jun lugar chi', icha jun yak'nak t'a yol stiempo'al winhaj Abraham. Yuj chi' ix b'atkan winhaj Isaac t'a yol yik Gerar, b'aj ayek' winhaj Abimelec sreyal heb' filisteo.
Hata' ix sch'ox sb'a Jehová t'a winh, ix yalani: Manh hach b'at t'a Egipto, kananh b'aj swal t'ayach.

Ha tikne'ik, wach' ajek' t'a jun lugar tik, ayinnhej ek' het'ok, ol hin ch'oxnhej hin wach'k'olal t'ayach, yujto ha jun lum tik ol wak' t'ayach smasanil yet' t'a masanil inhtilal, yik wach' tz'elk'och masanil tas walnakkan t'a winh ha mam aj Abraham.

Manh jantakok ol wutej heb' inhtilal, icha sb'isul k'e'en k'anal t'a satcha'anh icha chi' ol aj heb'. Ol wak'an jun lu'um tik smasanil t'a heb'. Yujnhej inhtilal chi' ol scha hin wach'k'olal masanil nación,
yujto ha winh ha mam aj Abraham chi', sk'anab'ajejnak winh tas walnak. Masanil hin cheknab'il, hin ley yet' hin k'ayb'ub'al wak'nak t'a winh, sk'anab'ajejnak winh, xchi Jehová t'a winh.
Yuj chi' ix kannhej winhaj Isaac chi' t'a Gerar chi'.

Haxo yik ix sk'anb'an heb' winh aj lugar chi' yuj ix yetb'eyum winh, ix yal winh to yanab' ix winh. Ix xiw winh yalani tato yetb'eyum ix winh, yujto ix sna' winh ta icha chi' smiljicham winh yuj heb', syik'anek' ix heb', yujto ha ix Rebeca chi' te wach' yilji ix.
Hata' ix ek' tiempo yuj heb'. Ay jun k'uhal ix yilelta winh rey chi' t'a yol jun wentena to chelcheloch winhaj Isaac chi' t'a ix Rebeca ix yetb'eyum chi'.

Ix b'at chekjikot winh yuj winh rey chi', ix yalan winh t'a winh: --Toxo ix wila' to etb'eyum ix ix tik, ¿icham chi', ma to ma'ay? ¿Tas yuj ix ala' to anab' ix? xchi winh. Ix yalan winhaj Isaac chi': --Ix hin na' k'inalok tzin smilcham heb' aj chonhab' tik yuj ix, xchi winh.
Ix yalan winh rey chi': --¿Tas yuj icha chi' ix ha k'ulej? Jab'xonhej maj honh ak'b'at t'a yol sk'ab' chukal. K'inalok ay junok winh ix way yet' ix, hu'ujnhej am wal tz'och ko mul, xchi winh.
Yuj chi', ix yalan winh rey chi' t'a masanil chonhab': --Tato ay junok mach stzuntzan jun winh winak tik, ma ix yetb'eyum winh, ol miljokchamok, xchi winh.
T'a jun ab'il chi' ix awwi trigo winhaj Isaac t'a jun lugar chi'. Lajunhe' quintal trigo ix yik' winh t'a junjun almul inhat, yujto ix yak' wal swach'k'olal Jehová t'a yib'anh winh.
Yuj chi' manh jantakok ix aj sb'eyumal winh. Manh jantakok tas ix yik' winh.
Ix te aj nok' skalnel winh, nok' swakax winh yet' schekab' winh. Yuj wal chi' ix te chichon sk'o'ol heb' winh filisteo chi' t'a winh.

Ayik pitzanto winhaj Abraham smam winhaj Isaac chi', ix sjoyankan juntzanh uk'b'ila' heb' schekab' winh b'aj syuk'a' nok' smolb'etzal nok' chi'. Haxo heb' winh filisteo chi' ix b'ut'anxi juntzanh uk'b'ila' chi'.
Ix yalan winh rey chi' t'a winhaj Isaac chi': --Elanh t'a tik, yujto ix ha te ik'ej ipok t'a kib'anh, xchi winh.
Ixlajwi chi', ix b'at winhaj Isaac chi', ix k'och kajan winh t'a sch'olanil yik Gerar. Hata' ix kajnaj winh.

Ix sjoyanxi juntzanh ha' uk'b'ila' chi' winh, ha' b'ob'ilkan yuj winh smam winh chi', haton juntzanh ha' ix smuk heb' winh filisteo ayik toxo ix cham winh smam winh chi'. Ha sb'i ha' aykanoch yuj winh smam winh chi', hanheja' ix yak'kanoch winh sb'i'ok ha'.
Ay jun k'uhal, ha heb' winh schekab' winhaj Isaac chi', ipan sjoyan jun ha' uk'b'ila' heb' winh t'a ak'lik chi', haxo ix aji, ix ilchaj jun sjaj ha' yuj heb' winh.

Haxo juntzanhxo heb' winh tanhwum kalnel aj Gerar chi', ix yal heb' winh to yik jun ha' chi' heb' winh, yuj chi' ix yak' owal heb' winh yet' heb' winh stanhwumal skalnel winhaj Isaac chi'. Yuj chi' ix yak' sb'i'ej jun ha' chi' winhaj Isaac Chaklajb'ail, yujto ix schaklaj sb'a heb' winh yuj ha'.
Ixlajwi chi', ix sjoyan junxo ha' heb' winh schekab' winhaj Isaac chi'. Hanheja' ix schaklajxi sb'a heb' winh yuj ha'. Yuj chi' Ajk'olal ix sb'i'ejkan ha' yuj winhaj Isaac chi'.

Ichato chi' ix b'at kajnaj winhaj Isaac chi' t'a najat. Hata' ix sjoyxi junxo ha' uk'b'ila' winh, palta manhxalaj owal yuj ha', yuj chi' B'ekan ix sb'i'ejkan ha' yuj winh. B'ekan honh yuj Jehová yik tzonh k'ib'cha'anh t'a lum tik, xchi winh.
Ixlajwi yel winhaj Isaac chi' ta', ix k'och winh t'a Beerseba.

Ha t'a jun ak'wal chi', ix sch'ox sb'a Jehová t'a winh, ix yalani: Ha hin sDiosal hin winh ha mam aj Abraham. Man hach xiwok, ayin och het'ok. Yujnhej to hin chekab' winhaj Abraham chi', yuj chi' ol wak' hin wach'k'olal t'a ib'anh, manh jantakok ol aj wik'ancha'anh sb'isul inhtilal, xchi t'a winh.
Hata' ix sb'o jun altar winhaj Isaac chi', yik syal sb'a winh t'a Jehová, haxo skajnajkan winh chi' ta'. Haxo heb' schekab' winh ix joyan junxo ha' uk'b'ila' chi'.

Ay jun k'uhal ix kot winhaj rey Abimelec t'a Gerar, ajun jun winh yamigo winh skuch Ahuzat yet'nak. Ajun pax winhaj Ficol yajal heb' soldado winh yet'nak. Ix ulek' winh lolonel yet' winhaj Isaac chi'.
Ix yalan winhaj Isaac chi' t'a heb' winh: --Ha hex tik, malaj tzin och heyu'uj, ix hin he pechel t'a sat he lu'um chi', ¿tasto yuj tzul hin heyila'? xchi winh t'a heb' winh.
Ix tak'wi heb' winh t'a winh: --Toxo ix kila' to ayoch Jehová het'ok, yuj chi' ix ko na' to smoj sko b'o junok ko trato het'ok. Ha jun trato ol ko b'o chi', haton jun tik:

Malajokab' b'ak'inh tzonh ixtej, yujto ha honh tik, maj kak' chukal t'ayach, ha tas ix aji, to xajan hach ku'uj, t'a junk'olalil ix hach ko chekeli. Skila' to aynhej swach'k'olal Jehová t'a ib'anh, xchi heb'.
Ayik ix lajwi slolon heb', ix sb'o'an jun niwan wa'el winhaj Isaac chi', ix wa heb' t'a tzalajk'olal.
Ha t'a junxo k'u, ix k'e wan heb' t'a k'inhib'alil, ix yak'lankan sti' heb' t'ay junjun. Ixlajwi chi' ix stak'lankan sb'a heb' t'a junk'olal, ix paxb'at heb' t'a slugar.
Haxo t'a jun k'u chi', ix ja heb' schekab' winhaj Isaac chi', ix ul yalan heb' t'a winh to ha t'a jun jul joyb'ilkan yuj heb' winh, ayxo ha ha' t'a yo'ol.
Yuj chi' Seba ix sb'i'ejkan jun ha' uk'b'ila' chi' yuj winhaj Isaac chi', yuj chi' ha jun chonhab' ay chi' ta' hanheja' skuch Beerseba.
40 ab'il sk'inal winhaj Esaú ayik ix yik'lan sb'a winh yet' ix Judit, yisil winhaj Beeri hitita. Ix yik'anpax ix Basemat winh, yisil ix winhaj Elón, hitita paxi.
Ix ak'ji'och skusk'olal winhaj Isaac yet' ix Rebeca yuj heb' ix chawanh chi'.

Ix ek'nhej tiempo, ix ichamwinakax winhaj Isaac chi', maxtzak ujilaj yilan winh. Ay jun k'uhal ix yawtejkot winhaj Esaú winh, haton winh sb'ab'el yuninal winh, ix yalan winh t'a winh: --Hach wuninal, xchi winh. --¿Tas xchi mamin? xchi winhaj Esaú chi'.
--Tik wal tzila' te icham winak hinxo. Manh wojtakok, k'inalok sja lemnaj hin chamel k'ik'an chab'ej.
Yuj chi' tzin nib'ej tzach b'at ha say junok nok' t'a kaltak te' yik tzik'kot hin chi'a. Ik'b'at ha jul-lab' yik tza jul junok wiko'.
Tza b'o'an junok hin wa'el te wach', icha wal hin gana. Ayik toxo ix b'o'i, tzik'ankot t'ayin. Yakb'an tzin wa'i, ol walankan wach' lolonel t'a ib'anh yakb'an manto hin chamok, xchi winh.
Haxo ix Rebeca, ix yab' ix tas ix yal winh t'a winhaj Esaú chi', yuj chi' ayik toxo ix b'at winhaj Esaú chi' t'a kaltak te' say schib'ej smam chi',
ix yalan ix t'a winhaj Jacob, winh schab'il yune' ix: --Ha tikne'ik hach wune', ix wab' wal yalan winh ha mam t'a winh uktak aj Esaú icha tik:

Ixik say junok k'ultakil nok' hin chi'a, tza b'o'an junok hin wa'el, te wach' tzutej. Yakb'an tzin wa'i ol wak'ankan yaxilal t'ayach, ol walankan wach' lolonel t'a ib'anh t'a yichanh Jehová yakb'an manto hin chamok, xchi winh ha mam chi' t'a winh.
Yuj chi' hach wune', k'anab'ajej wal tas ol wal tik.
Ixik b'aj ay nok' kalnel, tzik'ankot chawanhok nok' yunetak chiwa te wach', ol hin b'o'an junok swa'el winh ha mam chi', te wach' ol wutej icha wal tas snib'ej winh.
Ha hachxo ol ik'b'at t'a winh. Ayik wan swa winh, ol yalankan wach' lolonel winh t'a ib'anh yakb'an manto cham winh, xchi ix.
Ix yalan winhaj Jacob t'a ix snun chi': --Ha winh wuktak chi', ay xil sniwanil winh, palta ha hin tik malaj hin xi'il.
K'inalok ol hin smaslej winh hin mam chi', ol nachajel yuj winh, ol sna'an winh to tonhej swixtej winh, haxo katab' ol kotkan t'a wib'anh, manhxo'ok yaxilal ol wik'kani, xchi winh.

Ix tak'wi ix snun winh chi' icha tik: --Ma'ay hach wune', tato ay katab' syalkan winh, a'okab' t'a wib'anh skotkani. Ha tikne'ik, anhej to tza k'anab'ajej tas swala'. Ixik, ik'kot chawanhok nok' yunetak chiwa chi', xchi ix.
Ix b'at winhaj Jacob chi' yik'kot nok' yunetak chiwa chi', ix yak'an nok' winh t'a ix snun chi'. Wach' ix aj jun wa'el chi' yuj ix, icha wal snib'ej winhaj Isaac chi'.
Ixlajwi chi', ix yik'anelta spichul winhaj Esaú chi' ix, winh sb'ab'el yune' ix, juntzanh pichul te wach', sik'b'ilb'at b'aj ay smantiado, ix yak'anoch ix t'a winhaj Jacob winh schab'il unin chi'.
Haxo t'a stz'umal nok' chiwa chi' ix spich sk'ab' winh ix yet' sjaj winh b'aj malaj xi'il.
Ix yak'an ixim pan ix yet' wa'el ix sb'o chi', ix yik'anb'at winh.
Haxo ix ochb'at winh b'aj ayek' winh smam chi', ix yalan winh icha tik: --Mamin, xchi winh. --Oy, ¿mach hach hach wuninal? xchi winhaj Isaac chi'.

--Ha hin Esaú hin, ha b'ab'el unin hin. Toxo ix hin b'o ha wa'el icha ix al t'ayin. K'e'anh k'ojan, wa'anh. Ab'lej wal jab'ok nok' k'ultakil nok' ix b'at hin jul tik, tzalankan wach' lolonel t'a wib'anh, xchi winh.

Ix sk'anb'an winhaj Isaac chi' t'a winh icha tik: --¿Tas wal ix utej yamchaj nok' t'a elanhchamel, hach wuninal? xchi winh. --Ha Jehová ko Diosal ix och wet'ok, yuj chi' t'a elanhchamel ix ilchaj nok' wu'uj, xchi winh.
Ix yalanpax winhaj Isaac chi' t'a winh icha tik: --Nitzkot ha b'a t'a hin tz'ey, ol hach hin maslej, ta yel ha hach hach wuninal Esaú, xchi winh.

Ix snitzanoch sb'a winh t'a stz'ey winh smam chi', ix och ijan winh smaslan winh tato ay xi'il winh. Ixlajwi chi', ix yalan winh smam winh chi' icha tik: Icha wal yoch sjaj winhaj Jacob swab'i, anhej jun to ay xil ha k'ab' swab'i icha wal yik winhaj Esaú, xchi winh.
Maj nachajel-laj yuj winh smam winh chi', yujto ay xi'il sk'ab' winh icha wal yik winhaj Esaú chi', yuj chi' ix yalankan wach' lolonel winh t'a yib'anh winh.
Ix sk'anb'anxi winhaj Isaac chi' icha tik: --¿Yel am wal ha hach, hach wuninal Esaú? xchi winh. --I', ha hin ton Esaú hin, xchi winhaj Jacob chi'.

--Hach wuninal, ik'kot hin wa'el chi' an, yakb'an tzin chi nok' k'ultakil nok' xit' ik'kot chi', ol walankan wach' lolonel t'a ib'anh, xchi winh. Ix yak'an winhaj Jacob swa'el winh smam chi', ix yik'anpaxkot wino winh, ix yuk'an winh smam winh chi'.
Ix yalan winhaj Isaac chi' icha tik: --Nitzkot ha b'a t'a hin tz'ey hach wuninal, tza tz'ub'anelta hin ti', xchi winh.

Ix snitzanb'at sb'a winhaj Jacob chi', ix tz'ub'anelta sti' winh smam winh chi'. Ix suk'lan spichul winh winhaj Isaac chi', ix yalan wach' lolonel chi' winh t'a yib'anh winh icha tik: Icha sjab' anh ank'ultak ay t'a kaltak te' tz'ak'ji syaxil yuj Jehová, icha wal chi' sjab' winh wuninal.
Ak'jokab' nhab' t'a yib'anh lum ha lu'um yuj Dios yik te wach' ol aj sat awb'en. Manhxo jantakok ixim trigo yet' wino ol ik'a'.

Tzijtum anima ol hach ak'an serwil. Masanil nación ol yak'em sb'a t'ayach. Yajal ol hach aj t'a yib'anh heb' yinhtilal winh uktak. Ol yak'em sb'a heb' t'ayach. Ol kan skatab' Dios t'a yib'anh heb' chuk syutej sb'a t'ayach, palta ol yak' swach'k'olal t'a yib'anh heb' wach' syutej sb'a t'ayach, xchi winh.
Haxo yik ix lajwi yalankan masanil wach' lolonel chi' winh t'a yib'anh winhaj Jacob chi', hato wal yelta winh chi' b'aj ayek' winh smam chi', ix jax winhaj Esaú chi' juloj nok' chi'.

Ix sb'o'an jun wa'el winh te wach'. Ixlajwi chi' ix yik'anpaxb'at winh t'a winh smam chi', ix yalan winh icha tik: --K'e'anh wa'an mamin, tik hin jawi. Chi' nok' k'ultakil nok' ix b'at wik'kot tik, tzalankan wach' lolonel chi' t'a wib'anh, xchi winh t'a winh smam chi'.
Haxo ix sk'anb'an winhaj Isaac chi' icha tik: --¿Mach hach? xchi winh. --Ha hin ton Esaú hin, ha b'ab'el unin hin, xchi winh.

Ix te sat sk'o'ol winhaj Isaac chi', ix och ijan winh slukloni, ix yalan winh icha tik: --¿Mach pax jun winh ix b'at ik'ankot nok' t'a sb'ab'elal jun, ix yik'ankot jun wa'el chi' t'ayin? Toxo ix hin wa'i, ayik manto hach ja hach tik, yuj chi' toxo ix walkan hin wach' lolonel t'a yib'anh winh chi'. Toxonton ha winh ol cha'an hin wach'k'olal chi', xchi winh.
Ayik ix yab'an winhaj Esaú tas ix yal winh smam chi', ix el wek'ek'ok yaw winh yok'i, ix yalan winh icha tik: --Alpax wach' lolonel t'a wib'anh mamin, xchi winh.
Ix yalan winhaj Isaac chi' icha tik: --Ha winh uktak ix ul hin ixtanok, toxo ix yik'b'at masanil wach' lolonel winh iktaxon yaji, xchi winh. Haxo ix tak'wi winhaj Esaú chi':

Te wach' wal ochnakkan Jacob t'a winh. Scha'elalxo hin yixtan winh tik. T'a sb'ab'elal ix yik'ek' hin derecho winh t'a yik hin b'ab'el uninal, haxo pax tikne'ik syik'anpaxek' yaxilal winh to wiktaxon yaj hu'uj. Mamin, ¿manhxom wal junokxo yaxil ix ha k'ub'ejkan t'ayin? xchi winh.

Ix yalan winhaj Isaac chi' t'a winh: --Ina ix wak' yopisio winhaj Jacob t'a ib'anh, masanil heb' inhtilal ol ochkan schekab'ok winh. Hanheja' toxo ix walkani to te wach' ol yak' ixim strigo winh yet' swino. Manhxalaj tas wach' hach wutan hach wuninal, xchi winh.
Ix tewinhejoch winhaj Esaú chi' icha tik: --Mamin, ¿manhxom wal junok wach' lolonel syal alankan t'a wib'anh jun? Alkan junokxo ha wach' lolonel t'ayin, xchi winh. Ix helxi wek'ek'ok yaw winh yok'i.
Yuj chi' ix yalan winhaj Isaac chi' t'a winh icha tik: Te najat tzach elkan t'a sat lum lum yax sat yet' b'aj syak' nhab'.
Anhej k'e'en espada ol ak'och yipok ha k'o'ol, chekab' ol hach ajkan t'a winh uktak chi'. Haxo yik ayxo ip jun, ol ha kol ha b'a t'a winh, xchi winh.

Atax ta' ix chichonkanoch sk'o'ol winhaj Esaú t'a winhaj Jacob chi' yuj tas ix alchajkan t'a yib'anh winh yuj smam chi'. Yuj chi' ix sna'an winhaj Esaú chi' icha tik: Toxo ol cham winh hin mam tik, ol lajwok chi' ol hin milancham jun wuktak chi', xchi winh.

Haxo yik ix yab'an ix Rebeca tas wan yalan winhaj Esaú chi', ix yawtankot winhaj Jacob chi' ix, ix yalan ix t'a winh icha tik: --Hach wune', ha winhaj Esaú winh uktak, snib'ej winh ol hach smilchamok yik syak'ek' spak winh t'ayach.
Yuj wal chi', ab' wal tas swala': Elanh t'a tik, tzach b'atkan t'a Harán, tzach aj yet' winhaj Labán winh hin nulej.
Tzach kannhej yet' winh junok tiempo'al masanto tz'ek' yowal sk'o'ol winh uktak tik.
Haxo yik ol sat t'a sk'o'ol winh, ol walanb'at ab'i, ichato chi' ol hach paxta. Max yal hin k'o'ol to junnhej k'uhal tzex cham he chawanhil, xchi ix.

Ixlajwi chi', ix yalan ix Rebeca t'a winhaj Isaac icha tik: --Tzin te kus yuj heb' ix hitita, heb' ix yetb'eyum winhaj Esaú tik. Yuj chi' tato syik'laj sb'a winhaj Jacob tik yet' junok heb' ix hitita kajan t'a Canaán tik, wach' hama tato tzin chami, xchi ix.

Yuj chi' ix awtajkot winhaj Jacob yuj winhaj Isaac chi', ix och ijan winh yalankan wach' lolonel t'a yib'anh winh, ix yalankan jun cheknab'il winh t'a winh icha tik: Malaj b'ak'inh ol ik' junok ix etb'eyum t'a skal heb' ix aj Canaán tik.
Ha t'a yol yik Padán-aram t'a spat winh ha mam icham aj Betuel tzach b'ati, tzik' ha b'a yet' junok heb' ix yisil winhaj Labán, snulej ix ha nun.
Haxo Dios Syal Yuj Masanil, ol yak' swach'k'olal t'a ib'anh, manh jantakok ol aj sb'isul inhtilal. Ha t'a skal heb' inhtilal chi' tzijtum nación ol pitzwok.

Ol yak' swach'k'olal Dios t'ayach yet' masanil heb' inhtilal icha ix aj yak'ankan sti' yak'an t'a winhaj Abraham winh ko mam, yik wach' ol och jun lu'um b'aj ayonh ek' tik ikok. Ha wal Dios chi' aljinakkan t'a winh ko mam chi', xchi winhaj Isaac t'a winhaj Jacob chi'.
Ixlajwi chi', ix chekchajkanb'at winhaj Jacob yuj winhaj Isaac t'a Padán-aram. Ix b'atkan winh t'a spat winhaj Labán, yuninal winhaj Betuel arameo, snulej ix Rebeca, ix snun winh yet' winhaj Esaú.

Haxo ix yab'an winhaj Esaú to ix yal wach' lolonel winhaj Isaac t'a yib'anh winhaj Jacob, ix schekanpaxb'at winh t'a Padán-aram yik tz'och ix yetb'eyum winh ta'. Ix yab'an winh to ayik ix yalan wach' lolonel winhaj Isaac chi' t'a winh, ix yalan winh to max yal yik'lan sb'a winh yet' heb' ix aj Canaán chi'.
Ix sk'anab'ajej winhaj Jacob sb'atkan t'a Padán-aram icha ix aj yalan winh smam yet' ix snun.
Icha chi' ix aj snachajel yuj winhaj Esaú to ha winh smam winh chi' max scha sk'o'ol heb' ix aj Canaán winh.

Yuj chi', ix b'at winh yil winhaj Ismael haton winh yuktak winh smam winh chi'. Ix yik'an jun ix yisil winhaj Ismael chi' winh, Mahalat sb'i ix, ix och ix yetb'eyumok winh yet' heb' ix aytaxonek'i. Ha ix Mahalat chi' ay jun winh snulej ix skuchan Nebaiot.
Ayik ix el winhaj Jacob t'a Beerseba, ix b'at winh t'a sb'e'al Harán.
Ix k'och winh t'a jun lugar, yujto toxo ix em k'u, yuj chi' hata' ix waykan winh t'a jun ak'wal chi'. Ayik toxo sway winh, ix yik'ankot jun k'e'en winh sk'anh jolomok, ix ek' jichan winh.

Ha t'a jun ak'wal chi', ix och jun swayich winh, ix yilan winh to ay jun b'e icha k'o'och. Schak'e t'a sat lum tik, masanto sk'ek'och t'a satcha'anh. Ix yilan winh to ha heb' yángel Dios sk'e'i, tz'emta heb' t'a jun b'e chi'.

Ix yilanpax winh to ha Jehová linhanek' b'aj sk'ek'och jun b'e chi', ix yalan icha tik: Ha hin ton Jehová sDiosal hin winh ha mam icham aj Abraham yet' winhaj Isaac ha mam. Ol wak' jun lum b'aj jichan hach ek' tik t'ayach yet' t'a masanil heb' inhtilal.

Ha inhtilal chi' manh jantakok ol aj sb'isul icha spokokal lum lum. Ol pukaxkanb'at heb' t'a stojolal b'aj sjawi k'u yet' b'aj tz'em k'u, t'a stojolal norte yet' t'a sur. Masanil nación t'a yol yib'anhk'inal tik, ol scha swach'ilal heb' hu'uj yet' pax yuj inhtilal.
Ayinnhej och het'ok, ol hach hin tanhwejnhej b'aj ol hach b'atok, ol hach wik'an meltzaj t'a jun lum tik jun'elxo. Manh ol hach waktejkanlaj, palta ol wak'elk'och b'aj ix wak' hin ti' t'ayach, xchi.
Ayik ix el swayanh winh, ix sna'an winh icha tik: T'a wal yel ayek' Jehová t'a jun lugar tik, manh wojtakoklaj, xchi winh.
Ix xiw cha'anh winh, ix sna'an winh: Te ay smay jun lugar tik, spat Dios yaji, spuerta'il pax satcha'anh yaji, xchi winh.

Ayik ix sakb'i t'a junxo k'u, ix pet k'e wa'an winh, ix yik'ankot k'e'en k'e'en ix yak'och winh sk'anh jolomok chi, ix yak'ankank'e linhan k'e'en winh, ix kan k'e'en yechelok, ix sekank'e aceite winh t'a yib'anh k'e'en.
Ha t'a jun lugar chi', hata' ay jun chonhab' yiktax peka', Luz sb'i, haxo winhaj Jacob ix k'exan sb'i, ix yak'an winh skuch Betel.
Hata' ix yak'kan sti' winhaj Jacob, ix yalan winh icha tik: Tato ha Dios ol hin tanhwanok, ol ochnhej wet'ok b'aj wan hin b'at tik, ol yak'nhej hin wa'el yet' hin pichul,
wach' hin k'o'ol ayik ol hin meltzajpaxkot t'a spat hin mam, tato icha chi' ha Jehová tik ol och hin Diosalok.
Ha b'aj ix wawejkan k'e'en k'e'en tik, icha spat Dios tz'ajkani, ol wik'el sdiezmo'al masanil tas ol yak' t'ayin, ol wak'an t'ay, xchi winhaj Jacob chi'.
Icha chi' ix aj sb'atkan winhaj Jacob, ix k'ochkan winh t'a slu'um heb' winh kajan t'a stojolal b'aj sjawi k'u.
Ayik ix k'och winh ta', ix yilanb'at jun ha' uk'b'ila' winh. Ha t'a slak'anil ha' chi', ayek' ox umanh nok' kalnel, yujto ha ha' syuk' nok', ay jun niwan k'e'en ayoch smakulok sti' ha'.
Ayik smolb'an sb'a masanil nok' kalnel chi' ta', haxo heb' winh stanhwan nok' tz'ik'anel k'e'en smakul sti' ha' chi', syak'an ha' heb' winh yuk' nok', slajwi chi' smakanxikan sti' ha' heb'.
Ix sk'anb'an winh t'a heb' tanhwum kalnel chi' icha tik: --¿B'ajtil ayex hex wetanima'il? xchi winh. --Ha t'a Harán ayonh, xchi heb' winh.
--¿Heyojtak am winhaj Labán yixchikin winhaj Nacor? xchi winh. --Kojtakton winh, xchi heb'.
--¿Wach' am sk'o'ol winh heyila'? xchi winh. --Wach' sk'o'ol winh. Ina ha ix Raquel yisil winh wan skot yet' nok' skalnel chi', xchi heb' winh.
Ix yalan winhaj Jacob chi' t'a heb' winh: --Ayto k'u, ¿tas yuj manh tonhejok tzeyak' yuk'a' nok' he kalnel tik, tze tanhwan wa jab'okxo nok'? xchi winh t'a heb' winh.
Ix yalan heb' winh: --Max yal-laj, yowalil sko tanhwej smolb'an sb'a nok' smasanil, ichato chi' ol kik'anel k'e'en niwan smakul sti' ha' tik, yik syal yuk'an ha' nok' smasanil, xchi heb'.
Wanto slolon winhaj Jacob chi' yet' heb' winh, ix ja ix Raquel yet' nok' yik winh smam, yujto ha ix stanhwan nok'.

Ayik ix yilan winh sja ix yet' nok' yik winh smam chi', haton winh snulej ix snun winh, elanhchamel ix b'at lemnaj winh, ix yik'anel k'e'en smakul sti' ha ha' chi' winh, ix yak'an yuk' ha' nok' kalnel chi' winh.
T'a elanhchamel ix yak'an stzatzil sk'o'ol ix Raquel chi' winh, ix tz'ub'elta sti' ix winh, ix ok'k'e winh.
Ix och ijan winh yalan icha tik: Yune' hin ix Rebeca, ix yanab' winh ha mam, xchi winh. Haxo ix yab'an ix Raquel icha chi', ix b'at lemnaj ix yal t'a winh smam chi'.

Haxo ix yab'an winhaj Labán sb'inaj winhaj Jacob yune' yanab', ix b'at lemnaj winh schakot winh. Ix och lak'naj winh t'a winh, ix tz'ub'anelta sti' winh, ix yik'anb'at winh winh t'a spat chi'. Ix och ijan winhaj Jacob chi' yalani tas ix aj skoti.
Ix yalan winhaj Labán chi' t'a winh icha tik: Wal yel te ha honhto och het'ok, xchi winh. Jun ujal ix kan winh yet' winhaj Labán chi'.

Ayik ix ek' jun uj chi', ix yalan winhaj Labán chi' t'a winh icha tik: --Ha tikne'ik wach'chom ayto ku'uj ko b'a, palta max yal-laj nab'anhej ol hach munlaj t'ayin. Al t'ayin jantak ol hach hin tupu', xchi winh.
Ay chawanh yisil winhaj Labán chi': Ha ix b'ab'el, Lea sb'i ix, haxo ix schab'il Raquel.
Ha ix Lea chi', icha yilji taxon heb' ix ix yilji ix, anhej yol sat ix wach' yilji. Haxo pax ix Raquel jun, te wach' yilji sat ix yet' sniwanil smasanil.
Haxo winhaj Jacob chi', ix kan snib'ej winh t'a ix Raquel chi', yuj chi' ix yal winh icha tik: --Tzin kan uke'ok ab'il hin kaj ix Raquel, ix chab'il isil tik, xchi winh.
Ix yalan winhaj Labán chi': --Kananh, wach' ol wak' ix t'ayach, ¿tas gana ch'ok b'aj swak' ix? xchi winh.
Icha chi' ix aj skajan uke' ab'il ix winh. Maj yab' winh yek' jun pekti' chi', yujto te ay snib'ej winh t'a ix.
Haxo yik ix ek' uke' ab'il chi', ix yalan winh t'a winhaj Labán chi' icha tik: --Ha tikne'ik, ix lajwi ko trato yik tzin kaj ix. Ak' ix wetb'eyumok yik swik'an hin b'a yet' ix, xchi winh.
Haxo winhaj Labán chi' ix awtankot masanil heb' kajan t'a slak'anil chi', ix yak'anoch sk'inhal snupnajel ix yisil winh chi'.
Ayik toxo ix k'e ak'wal ix yik'ankot ix Lea winhaj Labán t'a winhaj Jacob chi', ix way winh yet' ix.
Ix ak'ji jun scriada ix yuj winhaj Labán chi', ha ix chi' Zilpa sb'i ix.

Ayik ix sakb'i, ix yilanelta winhaj Jacob chi' to ha ix Lea ix way yet' winh, ix b'at yalan winh t'a winhaj Labán chi' icha tik: --¿Tas yuj icha tik ix hin utej? Ha ix Raquel ix hin kaj t'ayach, ¿tas yuj tzin ixtej? xchi winh.
Ix yalan winhaj Labán chi' t'a winh icha tik: --Ha ko b'eyb'al t'a ko kal tik, max yal-laj to ha ix tzak'anto sb'ab'laj och winh yetb'eyum t'a ix b'ab'el.
k'anab'ajejkan jun semana sk'inh nupnajel yik ix Lea tik, ol ik'anpax ix Raquel chi' tato tzak' ha ti' ha kajan uke'okxo ab'il ix t'ayin, xchi winhaj Labán chi'.

Ix scha'an sk'o'ol winhaj Jacob jun lolonel chi'. Ix sk'anab'ajan jun semana k'inh nupnajel winh yet' ix Lea chi'. Ixlajwi chi', ix yak'anpax ix Raquel winhaj Labán chi' yik tz'och ix yetb'eyumok winh.
Ix yak'anpax jun ix scriada ix Raquel chi' winh haton ix Bilha.
Ix yik'lan sb'a winhaj Jacob yet' ix Raquel chi', yelxo wal xajanab'il ix aj ix yuj winh t'a yichanh ix Lea chi'. Yuj chi' uketo ab'il ix skaj ix winh.
Ayik ix yilan Jehová to chab'k'olab'il ix Lea chi', ix yak'an swach'k'olal t'a yib'anh ix yik tz'aj yune' ix. Haxo pax ix Raquel, malaj yune' ix.

Haxo ix Lea chi', ix och ix yab'ixal, ix alji jun yune' ix, Rubén ix yak' ix sb'i'ej, ix yalan ix: Ha Jehová ix yila' to patikab'il hin el yuj winh wetb'eyum, haxo tikne'ik xajan ol hin yil winh, xchi ix.
Ixlajwi chi' ix alji junxo yune' ix, Simeón ix yak' ix sb'i'ej, ix yalan ix icha tik: Ix yab' Jehová to chab'k'olab'il waji, yuj chi' ix yak' junxo wune' tik, xchi ix.
Ix aljipax junxo yune' ix, Leví ix yak' ix sb'i'ej, ix yalan ix: Ha tikne'ik junxonhej ol aj winh wetb'eyum tik wet'ok, yujto oxwanhxo wune' yet' winh, xchi ix.
Ix alji junxo yune' ix, Judá ix yak' ix sb'i'ej, ix yalanpax ix: Ha tikne'ik, swik'cha'anh sb'i Jehová, xchi ix. Haxonhej chi', ix och wa'an yilan sat unin ix.

Haxo ix Raquel chi' ix pitzwicha'anh ajk'olal t'a spensar ix, ix och ix ajk'olal t'a ix Lea chi' yujto malaj yune' ix, ix yalan ix t'a winh yetb'eyum chi' icha tik: --Ak' wune'. Tato ma'ay, tik tzin chami, xchi ix.
Yuj chi' ix kot yowal winhaj Jacob, ix yalan winh t'a ix icha tik: --¿Tokwal Dios hin? Ha Dios chi' max ak'anlaj une' chi', xchi winh.
Ix yalanxi ix t'a winh: --Wayanh yet' ix hin criada Bilha, ayik ol aljok yune' ix chi', icha wal wune' ol ajok, xchi ix.
Ix yak'an ix scriada ix chi' t'a winh, ix yik'lan sb'a winh yet' ix.
Haxo ix alji jun yune' ix Bilha chi',
ix yalan ix Raquel icha tik: Dan ol sb'i'ej winh unin tik, yujto ix yab' hin lesal Dios, ix hin sch'olb'itani, yuj chi' ix yak' jun unin tik t'ayin, xchi ix.
Ixlajwi chi', ix alji junxo yune' ix Bilha yet' winhaj Jacob chi'.
Ix yalanxi ix Raquel chi': Ha jun unin tik Neftalí ol sb'i'ej, yujto ix hin telaj hin b'a yet' ix hin nulej ix Lea, haxo tikne'ik ix kan ix yalanh wu'uj, xchi ix.
Haxo yik ix yilan ix Lea to manhxalaj yune' ix, ix yak'anpax ix scriada ix, haton ix Zilpa t'a winhaj Jacob chi'.
Ix alji jun yune' ix yet' winh.
--Wach' wiko' yuj chi' Gad swak' sb'i'ej winh unin tik, xchi ix Lea chi'.
Ixlajwi chi', ix alji junxo yune' ix Zilpa chi' yet' winhaj Jacob chi'.
Ix yalanpax ix Lea chi' icha tik: Te tzalajk'olal wiko', haxo heb' ix wetixal ol alanok to ay hin tzalajk'olal, yuj chi' Aser ol sb'i'ej winh unin tik, xchi ix.

Ay jun k'u ix b'at winhaj Rubén b'eyelek' t'a kaltak te', ayik wan sjochchaj ixim trigo. Hata' ix ilchaj juntzanh sat ank'ultak yuj winh to sloji, mandrágora sb'i. Ix yik'anb'at anh winh t'a ix Lea, haton ix snun winh. Haxo yik ix yilan anh ix Raquel chi', ix yalan ix t'a ix Lea icha tik: --Tzin tewi t'ayach to tzak' junok anh mandrágora ix yik'kot winh une' chi' t'ayin, xchi ix.

Ix yalan ix Lea chi' icha tik t'a ix: --¿Tom manh k'okb'ilok ix ik'ek' winh wetb'eyum, haxo tikne'ik, snib'ej ha k'o'ol tza k'anek' anh mandrágora ix yik'kot winh wune' tik? xchi ix. --Ak' anh t'ayin, tato icha chi' syal sway winhaj Jacob het'ok t'a jun ak'wal tik, xchi ix Raquel chi'.

Haxo yik wan sk'ik'b'i ix jax winhaj Jacob t'a smunlajel, ix b'at ix Lea schakot winh, ix yalan ix t'a winh icha tik: --Ha tikne'ik ol hach way wet'ok, t'a wal yel ix wak' anh mandrágora ix yik'kot winh wune' t'a ix hin nulej ix Raquel ha tojolok, xchi ix. Yuj chi' ix way winhaj Jacob chi' yet' ix t'a jun ak'wal chi'.
Ha Dios ix ab'an slesal ix, yuj chi' ix alji junxo yune' ix yet' winh, yo'il uninxo.
Ix yalan ix: Isacar ol sb'i'ej winh unin tik, yujto ix spaktzitej Dios t'ayin, yujto ix wak' ix hin criada t'a winh wetb'eyum, xchi ix.
Ixlajwi chi', ix alji junxo yune' ix yet' winhaj Jacob chi', haton swakil unin heb'.
Ix yalan ix: Ix yak' Dios jun silab' manhxo jantakok swach'il t'ayin, yuj chi' ol hin sxajanej winh wetb'eyum tik. Swakilxo jun unin tik swil yet' winh, yuj chi' Zabulón ol sb'i'ej, xchi ix.
Yikxo slajwub'al ix yilan sat jun ix unin ix, Dina ix yak' ix sb'i'ej.
Haxo ix Raquel chi', ix nachajkot ix yuj Dios, ix ab'ji slesal ix yuj, ix jawi yune' ix.
Ayik ix alji jun sb'ab'el unin ix, ix yalan ix: Ha hin k'ixwelal, toxo ix yik'el Jehová, yujto toxo ix yak' jun wune' tik.
Tzok wal el t'a sk'o'ol syak'pax junokxo wune', xchi ix. Yuj chi' José ix sb'i'ej jun unin chi' yuj ix.
Ayik toxo ix alji winhaj José, ix yalan winhaj Jacob t'a winhaj Labán icha tik: --Ha tikne'ik, cha hin pax t'a hin chonhab'.
Ak' heb' wuninal yet' heb' ix wetb'eyum, k'okb'ilokxob' hin kajan heb' ix t'ayach, smojxo wal tzin paxi. Ojtak wal tas ix aj hin munlaj t'ayach, xchi winh.
Haxo ix yalan winhaj Labán chi' t'a winh icha tik: --Ma'ay, tzin tewi t'ayach to wach'nhej ajek' wet'ok, yujto ix hin na'eli to hu'ujnhej ay swach'k'olal Jehová t'a wib'anh.
Al t'ayin jantak wal tzach hin tupu', xchi winhaj Labán chi'.
Ix yalanxi winhaj Jacob chi': --Ojtak wal tas ix aj hin munlaj het'ok yet' tas ix aj wilan nok' ha molb'etzal nok' tik.

Ojtak to jaywannhej nok' ha molb'etzal nok' tik ayik hin janak, haxo tikne'ik toxo ix k'ib' sb'isul nok'. Atax wal yik hin janak chi' syamannakoch Jehová yak'an swach'k'olal t'a ib'anh. Haxo tikne'ik, ¿b'ak'inh ol hin cha'el yich wilan wik yet' heb' ix wetb'eyum tik yet' heb' wuninal? xchi winh.
--¿Jantak ha tojol tza k'ana'? xchi winhaj Labán chi'. --Malajokab' hin tojol tzak'a', anhejto swil jab'okxo nok' ha kalnel tik, tato ol scha ha k'o'ol tas ol wala'.
Cha hin och t'a skal nok' ha kalnel yet' nok' ha chiwa tikne'ik, yik tzin sik'anel masanil nok' tz'ib'iltak, nok' jaskiltak stz'ib'ul, nok' yunetak k'ik'ik'. Ha nok' chi' ol och hin tojolok.

Yuj chi' jun, ayik tzach k'och il nok' ha nok' chi', nok' swik' hin tojolok chi', icha chi' ol aj ilankot hin tojolal. Tato ha t'a skal nok' wik chi' ay nok' chiwa, ma nok' kalnel chi' manh tz'ib'iltakok, mato manh k'ik'ik'ok, wan hach welk'an syal chi', xchi winh.
--Wach'okab'i. Scha hin k'o'ol tas tzal chi', xchi winhaj Labán chi'.

Hanhejtona' t'a jun k'uhal chi' ix sik'anel masanil nok' mam chiwa tz'ib'iltak winhaj Labán chi' yet' nok' jaskiltak stz'ib'ul, nok' nun chiwa soman jab'ok sakil yet' masanil nok' kalnel k'ik'ik' yilji, ix yak'an nok' winh t'a heb' yuninal.
Ix yik'anb'at nok' heb' yuninal winh chi' t'a najat, oxe' k'uhal stek'nab'il b'aj ix kan winhaj Jacob chi'. Ix kannhej winh stanhwej juntzanhxo nok' skalnel winhaj Labán chi'.

Elanhchamel ix sna'a winhaj Jacob chi', ix stzepel sk'ab'tak te te' skuch álamo winh, te' almendro yet' te' castaño. Tz'ib'iltak ix yutej te' winh sjosan stz'umal. Ay sak yet' k'ik'ik' ix aj yilji te' yuj winh.

Ix yak'anoch juntzanh te' k'ab'tak te' chi' winh t'a yichanh nok' kalnel chi', b'aj syuk'a' nok', haton ta' stajni nok'. T'a yichanh nok' aypaxoch te te' tz'ib'iltak yilji chi', yuj chi' ayik tz'aj yune' nok', tz'ib'iltak yilji yune' nok' chi'.
Ha masanil nok' tz'ib'iltak tz'aj chi', ix sik'kanel nok' winh t'a skal nok' yik winhaj Labán chi'. Icha chi' ix yutej winh sik'anel nok' skalnel chi' t'a skal nok' yik winhaj Labán chi'.
Masanil nok' te wach', ayik stajni nok', syak'anoch te te' winhaj Jacob chi' t'a yichanh nok' b'aj xit'ek' nok' yuk'a', yik wach' syil te te' chi' nok' ayik stajni nok' chi'.
Haxo yik sjawi nok' yatak wal ay, max yak'em te te' chi' winh t'a yichanh nok'. Yuj chi', ha nok' tz'ontak yik winhaj Labán chi', haxo nok' wach' yik winhaj Jacob chi'.

Icha chi' ix aj yoch winhaj Jacob chi' b'eyumal. Manh jantakok nok' swakax winh, nok' skalnel winh yet' nok' schiwa winh. Manh jantakok nok' scamello winh yet' nok' sb'uru winh yet' pax heb' winh schekab' winh yet' heb' ix schekab' winh.
Ayik ix yab'an winhaj Jacob to ha heb' winh yuninal winhaj Labán, wanxo yalank'e heb' winh icha tik: B'eyumxo winhaj Jacob tik yuj jantak tas ix yik'ek' t'a winh ko mam, xchi heb' winh.
Ix nachajel yuj winhaj Jacob chi' to manhxo wach'ok sna'an winhaj Labán chi' t'a spatik icha t'a yalanhtaxo.
Haxo Jehová ix halan t'a winh icha tik: Meltzajanh t'a slu'um ha mam icham b'aj ayek' heb' ha k'ab' ok, ol hin b'atnhej het'ok, xchi t'a winh.
Ixlajwi chi' ix yak'anb'at sti' winh t'a heb' ix yetb'eyum, haton ix Raquel yet' ix Lea, yik wach' skot heb' ix, sja heb' ix b'aj stanhwi kalnel winh.

Ayik ix ja heb' ix, ix yalan winh t'a heb' ix: --Hex wetb'eyum, ha tikne'ik toxo ix wila' to ha winh he mam, chukxolaj hin yilan winh, manh ichok t'a yalanhtaxo, palta ha sDiosal winh hin mam, aynhej wal och wet'ok.
Ha hex tik heyojtak wal to ix hin munlaj t'a winh he mam t'a swach'ilal t'a smasanil hin k'o'ol.
Haxo winh icha wal to tzin yixtej winh, lajunhelxo ix sk'ex hin tojol winh, palta ha Dios jun, max hin xcha ixtajok.

Ayik ix yalan winh he mam chi': Ol hach hin tup t'a nok' kalnel, nok' tz'ib'iltak, xchi winh, haxo yik ix alji yune' nok', nab'a tz'ib'iltak yune' nok' ix alji. Ayik ix yilan winh to icha chi', ix yalanxi winh: Ha nok' jaskiltak stz'ib'ul ol wak' ha tojolok, xchi winh, haxo ix alji yune' nok', nab'a jaskiltak stz'ib'ul nok' yune' tz'alji.
Icha chi' ix aj yik'ji'ek' nok' smolb'etzal nok' winh he mam chi' yuj Dios, ix yak'an t'ayin.
Ha jun'el ay jun hin wayich, ha ix wilani to wan stajni nok'. Ix wilani to ha nok' mam chiwa ix tajni yet' nok' nunab'il chi', nab'a tz'ib'iltak nok', ay pax nok' jaskiltak stz'ib'ul.
Haxo t'a jun hin wayich chi', ix hin yawtej Jun yángel Dios, ix hin tak'wi t'ay: Oy, ina wajek' tik, xin chi t'ay.
Ix yalan t'ayin icha tik: Scham wal hilani to ha nok' smam stajni yet' nok' snun, tz'ib'iltak nok', jaskiltak pax stz'ib'ul nok', yujto ix wil masanil tas ix hach utaj yuj winhaj Labán.

Ha hin Dios hin tik, ix hin ch'ox hin b'a t'ayach t'a Betel, b'aj ix ha sekkank'e aceite t'a yib'anh k'e'en k'e'en ix ak'kank'e linhan, haton b'aj ix ak'kan ha ti' t'ayin. Ha tikne'ik, aktejkan jun lugar tik, tzach pax t'a ha lu'um b'aj aljinak hach, xchi Dios t'ayin, xchi winhaj Jacob chi' t'a heb' ix yetb'eyum chi'.
Ix tak'wi ix Raquel yet' ix Lea chi' t'a winh icha tik: --Ha honh tik, manhxo jab'ok tas ol kik' t'a winh ko mam.
Yujto icha komon anima kaj t'a winh. Ina ix honh schonhel winh, ix slajanel ko tojol chi' winh, haton ix ak' t'a winh yik ix kik'lan ko b'a het'ok.
T'a wal yel masanil b'eyumal ix yik'ek' Dios t'a winh ko mam chi', kikxo yet' heb' kune'. Yuj chi' jun, masanil tas toxo ix yal Dios t'ayach, yik'okab'i, xchi heb' ix.

Ix yak'an lista sb'a winhaj Jacob yik spaxta winh t'a Canaán b'aj ayek' kajan winh smam winh, haton winhaj Isaac. Ix yak'ank'e heb' yuninal winh yet' heb' ix yetb'eyum winh t'a yib'anh nok' camello. Ix yik'ankot masanil tastak winh, ix b'at winh yet' masanil nok' nok' ix yik' t'a spatik smunlajel t'a Padán-aram chi'.
Yakb'an ayb'at winhaj Labán chi' t'a junxo lugar joxoj kalnel, haxo ix Raquel ix elk'ankot sdiosal winh ayoch t'a yol spat.
Hanheja' t'a jun pekti' chi' ix el winhaj Jacob t'a elk'altak, majxo yalkan kilkob'a winh t'a winhaj Labán arameo chi'.
Icha chi' ix aj yik'ankot masanil tastak winh. T'a elanhchamel ix ek'ta winh b'aj ay ha' niwan Éufrates, ix kotnhej winh t'a yichanh masanto ix jawi winh t'a juntzanh tzalkixtak t'a yol yik Galaad.
Schab'ji'alxo skot winhaj Jacob chi', ix yab'an winhaj Labán to ix kot winh.
Haxo winhaj Labán chi' ix ik'ankot heb' sk'ab' yok yet'ok, ix kot heb' syam winh. Yikxo swak'ji'al chi' ix jawi heb' t'a spatik winh t'a juntzanh tzalkixtak t'a yol yik Galaad.

Ha t'a jun ak'wal chi', ix sch'ox sb'a Dios t'a winhaj Labán chi' t'a swayich. Ix yalan Dios t'a winh icha tik: Scham wal ha na'ani tas ol al t'a winhaj Jacob chi'. Manh komonok ol hach lolonok, xchi t'a winh.
Haxo t'a junxo k'u, ix yamchaj winhaj Jacob yuj winhaj Labán chi' t'a tzalkixtak t'a yol yik Galaad, t'a scampamento winh. Hata' ix sb'opax scampamento winhaj Labán chi' yet' heb' winh yet'nak chi'.

Ix och ijan winhaj Labán chi' yalanoch t'a sat winhaj Jacob chi' icha tik: --¿Tas ix ha k'ulej? ¿Tas yuj ix hin ak'kan musansatil? Elelalxonhej ix utej ik'ankot heb' ix wisil, ichato t'a skal owal ix yamchaj heb' ix hu'uj.
Majxo alkan jab'ok t'ayin. Manhxo jab'ok ix wab'i, tato ma'ay, ix am hex hin tak'ejkot t'a tzalajk'olal, ix am och son yet' yunetak tanhb'il yet' arpa ayik hex koti.
Maj hin tz'ub'kanelta sti' heb' ix wisil yet' heb' winh wi hin chikin. Ichato malaj jab'ok ha pensar, yuj chi' icha chi' ix utej ha b'a.

Ha hin tik syal wak'an chukal t'ayex, tato syal hin k'o'ol, palta ha k'ik'i t'ak'wal ix sch'ox sb'a sDiosal winh ha mam t'ayin, ix yalani: Scham wal ha na'ani tas ol al t'a winhaj Jacob chi'. Manh komonok tzach loloni, xchi t'ayin.
Tato tza te na'ejb'at b'aj ay winh ha mam, yuj chi' icha chi' ix ha k'ulej, palta ¿tas yuj ix elk'ejkot juntzanh hin diosal? xchi winhaj Labán chi'.
Ix tak'wi winhaj Jacob chi' icha tik: --Ix hin el t'ayach t'a elk'altak yujto ix hin xiwi. Ha ix aj hin na'ani, talaj tzak' pural ik'ankanek' heb' ix isil tik t'ayin.

Tato ha junok heb' ayek' t'a tik b'aj ayek' ha diosal chi', syalnhej schami. Ha heb' ayek' ket'ok tik syal yak'an testigo'al heb'. Say ila', tato ay jab'ok ha tastak ix wik'koti, syal ik'anpaxok, xchi winhaj Jacob chi'. Palta manh yojtakok winhaj Jacob chi' tato ha ix Raquel ix elk'ankot sdiosal winh smam chi'.

Ix ochb'at winhaj Labán t'a yol smantiado winhaj Jacob chi', ix ochpax winh t'a smantiado ix Lea yet' t'a yik heb' ix chawanh criada, palta malaj tas ix ilchaj yuj winh. Ixlajwi yelta winh t'a yol smantiado ix Lea chi', ix ochxi winh t'a yik ix Raquel.
Haxo ix ix k'ub'an el juntzanh yechel chi' t'a yalanh stz'um nok' camello, ix emkan k'ojan ix t'a yib'anh. Ix ek'chaj winhaj Labán say t'a masanil mantiado, palta maj ilchajlaj sdiosal winh chi' yuj.

Ix yalan ix Raquel t'a winh icha tik: --Mamin, mokab' kot owal t'ayin, yujto max yal-laj hin k'e wan t'a ichanh, yujto ha tikne'ik ya'ay hin yuj sb'isul uj, xchi ix, tonhej ix tz'ak yal ix. Haxo winhaj Labán jun, ix ek'chaj winh say sdiosal chi', palta maj ilchajlaj.
Yuj chi' ix kot yowal winhaj Jacob, ix yalan winh: --¿Tas wal hin mul ix och t'ayach? ¿B'ajtil ay hin mul chi' yuj chi' tzak' wal och t'a ha k'o'ol hin ha sayanek'i?

Masanil hin k'a'el tza say ila', ¿tas junok ik ix ilchaj uj tikne'ik? Ch'ox t'a yichanh heb' winh het'nak tik yet' t'a yichanh pax heb' winh wet'nak tik, yik wach' ha heb' winh syal yalani mach honh yel skala'.
Ha t'a 20 ab'il ix hin munlaj het'ok, malaj wal junok nok' ha kalnel, malaj wal junok nok' smam ha chiwa ix hin chib'ati, malaj wal nok' snun tonhej ix ek' sti'.

Malaj b'aj ix wik'kot jilipok nok' ha kalnel ix chiji yuj nok' okes t'ayach, yujto ha nok' satb'ati tzin tupoch nok' t'ayach. Wach'chom k'uhalil ma t'ak'walil ix b'at nok' yuj elk'um, ina to ix ha k'an stojol nok' t'ayin.
Ha t'a k'uhalil, tzin te tz'a yuj k'ak', haxo t'ak'walil, tzin potzel yuj si'ik, max ochlaj hin wayanh tz'ek' ak'wal.

20 ab'il ix hin ek' het'ok, palta ix wak'nhej techajok. 14 ab'il ix hin kaj heb' ix isil tik, haxo wakexo ab'il jun, ix hin munlaj yuj nok' ha molb'etz, haton nok' ix ak' hin tojolok. Kotak skal ix hin ha k'exanh ti'ej yuj hin tojol.

Ta wal manh ayok och Dios wet'ok, haton sDiosal winh hin mam icham aj Abraham, haton Dios b'aj slesalwipax winh hin mam aj Isaac, wal yel, malaj am jab'ok tas t'a yol hin k'ab' tzin paxta. Palta ha Dios ix ilan hin yahelal yet' tas ix aj yelk'och hin munlajel, yuj chi' haton ix hach kachanoch wa'an k'ik'i t'ak'wal chi'.

Ix yalan winhaj Labán t'a winhaj Jacob chi' icha tik: --Wisil heb' ix tik, wi hin chikin pax heb' tik yet' nok' kalnel tik, wik nok' smasanil. Masanil tas ayek' tik, wiko'. Palta jun, ¿tasto wal swutej heb' ix wisil yet' yune' heb' ix?
Yuj chi', kotanh ko b'o junok ko trato tikne'ik yik ch'oxnab'il tz'ajkan t'a ko kal ko chawanhil, xchi winhaj Labán chi'.
Ix yik'ankot jun k'e'en k'e'en winhaj Jacob chi', ix yak'ank'e linhan k'e'en winh yik ch'oxnab'il tz'aj k'e'en.
Ix yalan winh t'a masanil heb' schekab' icha tik: --Molb'ejek k'e'en k'e'en, xchi winh. Masanil heb' ix molb'an k'e'en. Jun wal juyanh ix yutej k'e'en heb', ix wa heb' t'a stz'ey k'e'en.
Ix yak'anoch winhaj Labán chi' sb'i'ej jun juyanh k'e'en chi' t'a sti' heb' syala': Jegar Sahaduta Haxo pax winhaj Jacob chi' jun, Galaad ix yak' winh skuch jun k'e'en chi' t'a sti'.
Ixlajwi chi' ix yalan winhaj Labán chi' icha tik: --Ha tikne'ik, ha jun juyanh k'e'en tik testigo tz'ajkan ku'uj ko chawanhil, xchi winh. Yuj chi' Galaad sb'i jun lugar chi'.
Mizpa ix sb'i'ejpaxi yujto ix yal winhaj Labán chi' icha tik: --Ha Jehová tzonh ilan ko chawanhil yik manhxo ol yal kil-lan ko b'a junjun honh.
Tato ol ixtej heb' ix wisil tik, mato ol ha say juntzanhokxo heb' ix ol och etb'eyumok, wach'chom malaj mach tz'ak'an testigo'al, palta ha Dios testigo, xchi winh.
Ix yalanpax winh t'a winhaj Jacob chi': --Ina k'e'en b'ul k'e'en tik yet' k'e'en ix k'ekan linhan, haton wal k'e'en ix wak'kan t'a ko kal ko nanhal ko chawanhil.
Ha wal k'e'en tik tz'ak'an testigo'al t'ayonh to manhxo ol yal ko k'axpitan jun mojon tik yik skak'an chukal t'ayonh junjun honh.

A'okab' sDiosal winhaj Abraham ha mam icham yet' pax sdiosal winhaj Nacor hin mam icham, a'okab' tzonh ilan ko chawanhil, xchi winhaj Labán chi'. Ixlajwi chi' ix yak'an sti' winhaj Jacob chi' t'a sb'i Dios, haton Dios b'aj syak'em sb'a winhaj Isaac, winh smam winh.
Ix yak'an juntzanh silab' winh t'a Dios t'a schon jun tzalan chi', ix yawtankot heb' ajun yet'ok chi' wa'el. Masanil heb' ix wa'i, ha t'a chon tzalan chi' ix ek' ak'wal yuj heb'.

Haxo yik ix sakb'i t'a junxo k'u, ix k'e wa'an winhaj Labán chi', ix tz'ub'ankan sti' heb' yixchikin winh yet' heb' ix yisil winh, ix yalankan wach' lolonel winh t'a yib'anh heb', ix meltzaj winh t'a spat yet' heb' ajun yet'ok.
Ixlajwi chi', ix b'eykot winhaj Jacob chi'. Haxo ix aji, ix schalaj sb'a winh yet' juntzanh heb' yángel Dios.
Ayik ix yilan heb' ángel chi' winh, ix yalan winh: Scampamento heb' yejército Dios jun tik, xchi winh. Yuj chi' Mahanaim ix yak' winh sb'i'ej jun lugar chi'.
Ix schekankot juntzanh heb' schekab' winh t'a lum Seir, t'a yol yik Edom, yik skot heb' yal t'a winh yuktak winh, haton winhaj Esaú to wanxo skot winh t'a yol b'e.

Ix yalan winh t'a heb' schekab' chi' icha tik: Alek t'a winh wuktak aj Esaú icha tik: Ha winh uktak aj Jacob syak'och sb'a winh t'a yalanh ha mandar. Tzeyalanpaxi to ha yet' winhaj Labán ix hin ek' jun pekti' tik.

Ha tikne'ik ay nok' hin wakax, nok' hin kalnel, nok' hin chiwa, nok' hin b'uru. Ay heb' winh hin chekab' yet' heb' ix hin chekab'. Swalb'at jun ab'ix tik t'ayach mamin wuktak, yujto tzin nib'ej tzin och junk'olal het'ok, xchikot winhaj Jacob, xe chi t'a winh.

Haxo yik ix jax heb' winh chekab' chi', ix yalan heb' winh t'a winhaj Jacob icha tik: --Toxo ix honh xit'ek' t'a winh uktak, tik wan sja winh ul hach scha'a. Chanhe' ciento wal winak yet'nak winh, xchi heb' winh schekab' winh chi'.

Ayik ix yab'an juntzanh chi' winhaj Jacob chi', ix xiw cha'anh winh, ix te och winh ilk'olal. Ixlajwi chi' ix spojan b'at heb' anima winh yet'nak. Cha makan ix yutej winh yet' nok' wakax, nok' kalnel yet' nok' camello.
Yujto ix sna'a winh: Tato sjawi winhaj Esaú t'a junok makan, yakb'an syak' owal winh yet'ok, haxo junxo makan syal yeli, xchi winh.

Ixlajwi chi' ix lesalwi winh icha tik: Hach Jehová hin Diosal, sDiosal hach winh hin mam icham aj Abraham yet' winh hin mam aj Isaac. Ha hach ix ala' to tzin meltzajkot t'a hin lu'um, t'a skal heb' hin k'ab' wok. Ix halani to ayachnhej och wet'ok yik wach'nhej tzin elk'ochi.

Te manh hin mojok to tzin ha xajanej, manh hin mojok pax to aynhejoch ha wach'k'olal wet'ok. Ayik wek'nakb'at t'a yol ha' Jordán, anhej jun hin k'okoch wet'nak, haxo tikne'ik, chab'xo campamento'al ix hin elk'ochi, te ayxo tastak t'ayin.
Tzin tewi t'ayach to tzin ha kol t'a yol sk'ab' winh wuktak chi'. Tzin te xiwi, k'inalok sja winh t'ayin, smilancham heb' ix ix yet' heb' unin tik winh.
Ha hach ix ala' to wach'nhej ol hin elk'och hu'uj. Ix alanpaxi to manh jantakok ol ajelk'och sb'isul winhtilal, icha wal yarena'il ha' mar to max yal sb'ischaji, xchi winh t'a slesal chi'.
Ha t'a jun ak'wal chi', ix waykan winh ta'. Ayik ix sakb'i, ha t'a skal masanil tas yet'nak winh, ix sik'el tastak winh yik si'ej winh t'a winh yuktak chi':
200 nok' nun chiwa yet' 20 nok' mam chiwa. 200 nok' nun kalnel yet' 20 nok' ch'ak kalnel.
30 nok' nun camello yet' nok' yune' toto ix alji, 40 nok' nun wakax yet' lajunhwanh nok' toro, 20 nok' nun b'uru yet' lajunhwanh nok' mam b'uru.

T'a elanhchamel ix yak' winhaj Jacob junjun makan nok' t'a heb' winh schekab', makkiltak ix yutej winh, ix yalan winh t'a heb' icha tik: --B'ab'lajanhek yet' junjun makan nok', najtik tzeyutej skal junjun makan, xchi winh.

Ha t'a winh et'jinak nok' b'ab'el, ix yal winh icha tik: --Ayik ol ha cha'an ha b'a yet' winh wuktak chi', tato sk'anb'ej winh: ¿Mach ha patrón? ¿B'ajtil tzach b'ati? ¿Mach yik nok' nok' het'nak tik? tato xchi winh t'ayach,
tzalan t'a winh icha tik: Mamin Esaú, ha juntzanh tik silab' winhaj Jacob ha chekab' t'ayach. Tzak'anpax winh wu'uj, xa chi, xchi winhaj Jacob chi'.

Icha chi' ix aj yalan winh t'a winh et'jinak nok' schab'il makan yet' t'a winh et'jinak nok' yoxil makan. Icha chi' ix aj yalan winh t'a masanil heb' winh et'jinak junjun makan nok' nok' chi': --Ayik ol he chalan he b'a yet' winhaj Esaú chi', jun lajannhej ol heyutej heyalani.

Tzeyalani: Tzak'an winhaj Jacob ha chekab' ku'uj, xe chi, xchi winh t'a heb' winh schekab' chi'. Icha tik ix yutej sna'an winhaj Jacob chi': Tekan ol emta yowal sk'o'ol winhaj Esaú yuj hin silab' ix wak' b'ab'laj t'a wichanh, ol wilan wal och hin b'a yet' winh. Tato icha chi' tekan ol hin scha winh t'a wach'il, xchi winh.
Yuj chi', ix schek b'ab'laj masanil silab' winhaj Jacob chi'. Haxo winh jun, ixto kan junxo ak'wal winh t'a scampamento chi'.

Ha t'a jun ak'wal chi' ix k'e wan winhaj Jacob, ix yik'anb'at heb' ix yetb'eyum winh schawanhil yet' heb' ix chawanh criada yet' uxluchwanh yuninal winh, ix ek'ta heb' t'a sjayil jun ha' skuchan Jaboc yet' masanil tastak yet'nak.
Haxo yik ix kan winh sch'okojil, ix yak'an owal winh yet' jun winak masanto ix sakb'i.
Haxo jun winak chi', ix yila' to max ak'ji ganar winhaj Jacob chi' yuj, yuj chi' ix mak'ji'el yakanhil xub' winhaj Jacob chi' yuj. Ix el chinnaj xub' winh chi' ayik ix yak'an owal heb'.

Ix yalan jun winak chi' t'a winh icha tik: --Aktej hin eli yujto wanxo sakb'i, xchi. Ix yalan winhaj Jacob t'ay icha tik: --Manh ol hach waktejeli, tato manh ol alkan junok wach' lolonel t'a wib'anh, xchi winh.
--¿Tas ha b'i? xchi jun winak chi' t'a winh. --Jacob hin b'i, xchi winh.
Ix yalan t'a winh icha tik: --Ha tikne'ik manhxo Jacob-ok ol ha b'i'ej, palta Israelxo, yujto ix yal ak'an owal yet' Dios yet' pax anima, xchi.

--Ha tikne'ik al t'ayin tas ha b'i hach tik, xchi winhaj Jacob chi'. Haxo ix yalan jun winak chi' icha tik: --¿Tas yuj tza k'anb'ej hin b'i? xchi. Hata' ix yalkan wach' lolonel t'a yib'anh winhaj Jacob chi'.
Yuj chi' Peniel ix sb'i'ejkan jun lugar chi' yuj winhaj Jacob chi', ix yalan winh icha tik: Ix wil sat Dios, palta ina pitzan hinto, xchi winh.
Wanxo yek'b'at winhaj Jacob t'a Peniel chi', ix jawi k'u. Yujto ix el chinnaj xub' winh, yuj chi' tz'em sb'ey winh.
Yuj chi' ha heb' yinhtilal Israel, max schilaj sch'anhal sk'ojnub' xub' nok' nok' heb', yujto ha t'a xub' winhaj Jacob chi' yab'nak sya'il.
Haxo ix yilan winhaj Jacob to wan sja winhaj Esaú yet' 400 swinak, ix spojanek' heb' unin winh t'a skal heb' ix ix, haton ix Lea yet' ix Raquel yet' pax heb' ix chawanh scriada heb' ix.
Ha heb' ix criada chi', ix b'ab'laj b'at heb' ix yet' yune' chi'. Ichato chi' ix b'at ix Lea yet' heb' yiko'. Tzak'anto ix b'at ix Raquel yet' winhaj José.
T'a elanhchamel ix b'ab'lajb'at winhaj Jacob t'a yichanh heb' ix. Ukel ix em nhojnaj winh masanto ix k'och winh t'a yichanh winh yuktak chi'.
Ix jawi lemnaj winhaj Esaú chi', ix och lak'naj winh t'a sjaj winh yuktak chi', ix och tz'ub'naj winh t'a sti' winh, ix ok' heb' winh schawanhil.

Ixlajwi chi' ix yilanoch heb' ix ix yet' heb' unin winhaj Esaú chi', ix sk'anb'an winh icha tik: --Ha juntzanh heb' tik, ¿mach ay yik heb'? xchi winh. --Wuninal heb', ix yak' Dios t'ayin yuj swach'k'olal, xchi winhaj Jacob chi'.
Ichato chi' ix snitzankot sb'a heb' ix criada yet' heb' yune' t'a yichanh winhaj Esaú chi', ix em nhojan heb' t'a sat lu'um.
Ix snitzanpaxkot sb'a ix Lea yet' heb' yune', ix empax nhojan heb'. Tzak'anto ix jawi winhaj José yet' ix snun, haton ix Raquel, ix empax nhojan heb'.

Ix sk'anb'an winhaj Esaú t'a winhaj Jacob chi' icha tik: --¿Tas tza na t'a yib'anh juntzanh nok' nok' ix hin cha t'a yol b'e? xchi winh. --Ik yaj nok' smasanil yik tz'och junk'olal t'a ko kal, xchi winhaj Jacob chi'.
--Ma'ay wuktak, te tzijtum pax nok' wiko', kanokab' nok' het'ok, xchi winh.

Palta ix och ijan winhaj Jacob chi' yalan t'a winh icha tik: --Ma'ay wuktak, tato wach' hin t'a ichanh, cha juntzanh silab' swak' tik t'ayach, icha wal to ha Dios swilochi ayik tzach wilan tik, yujto t'a wach'k'olalil ix hin ha cha'a.

Tzin tewi t'ayach to tza cha juntzanh silab' ix wik'kot t'ayach, yujto ha Dios ix el t'a sk'o'ol yak'an hin b'eyumal tik, malaj jab'ok tas syak' palta t'ayin, xchi winhaj Jacob chi'. Ix ochnhej te'an winh t'a winh yuktak chi', yuj chi' ix scha nok' silab' chi' winh.
Ix yalan winhaj Esaú chi' icha tik: --Ha tikne'ik, koyek. Ha hin tzin b'ab'laj t'a heyichanh, xchi winh.

Ix tak'wi winhaj Jacob chi': --Hach wuktak, ojtak to ha heb' unin, k'un sk'unb'i heb', tzin na'anpax yuj nok' kalnel yet' nok' wakax nenetakto yune', tato tzin pech nok' ay smay junnhej k'uhal scham nok' smasanil.
Yuj chi' wach' tzach b'ab'laj wu'uj. Ha hinxo tik, k'ojank'olalnhej ol hin b'atok, icha syal sb'ey heb' unin yet' nok' nok' tik. Olxo hach wilk'och t'a Seir, xchi winh.

--Yik'okab' icha tzal chi'. Syal skan jaywanhok heb' winh hin chekab' tik yik skolwaj het'ok, xchi winhaj Esaú chi'. Palta ix yalan winhaj Jacob chi' icha tik: --Ma'ay, yuj wal Dios, manh ak' pensar wu'uj, xchi winh.
Ha t'a jun k'u chi', ix meltzaj winhaj Esaú t'a lum Seir.

Haxo winhaj Jacob, ix jakan winh t'a jun ak'lik. Hata' ix sb'o spat winh, ix sb'o'anpax juntzanh yunetak lechpat winh b'aj ix och nok' smolb'etzal nok'. Yuj chi' Sucot ix yak' winh sb'i'ej jun lugar chi'.
Ayik ix paxta winhaj Jacob t'a Padán-aram masanto ix jawi winh t'a yol yik Canaán, malaj tas ix ik'an winh, wach' sk'o'ol winh ix jaxi. Ix sb'o'an scampamento winh t'a yichanhb'at chonhab' Siquem.
100 k'e'en plata ix yak' winh yik smanan jun lum lum chi' winh t'a heb' yuninal winhaj Hamor, winh ix ik'anel yich chonhab' Siquem. Hata' ix sb'ok'e scampamento winh.
Ixlajwi chi' ix sb'o'ank'e jun altar winh, El-Elohe-Israel ix yak' winh sb'i'ej.
Ha ix yune' ix Lea yet' winhaj Jacob, haton ix Dina, ix b'at ix paxyal t'a skal heb' ix ix t'a Siquem chi'.
Ha winhaj Hamor heveo, yajal yaj t'a jun chonhab' chi'. Ay jun yuninal winh skuchan Siquem. Ayik ix yilanoch ix Dina winhaj Siquem chi', ix ixtaj ix yuj winh t'a ak'b'il puralil.
Yujto te ay snib'ej winh t'a ix, yuj chi' ix montaj ix yuj winh t'a wach'il.
Ix yalan winh icha tik t'a winh smam chi': --Mamin, oktom b'at ha k'an jun ix kob'es tik. Hin gana swik' hin b'a yet' ix, xchi winh.

Wach'chom ix yab' winhaj Jacob to toxo ix ixtaj ix yisil winh yuj winhaj Siquem chi', malaj tas ix yal winh masanto ix jax heb' yuninal winh tanhwoj kalnel. Ha ix yab'an heb' winh yuninal winh chi' tas ix uji, ix meltzajkot heb' winh, ix te kus heb' winh. Ix kotpax yowal heb' winh, yujto te k'ixwelal ix utaj heb' yinhtilal winhaj Israel, haton winhaj Jacob, yuj winhaj Siquem chi', yujto ix ixtaj ix yisil winh. Manh wach'ok tas ix sk'ulej winhaj Siquem chi'. Haxo winhaj Hamor chi' ix b'at lolon yet' winhaj Jacob chi'. Ix lolonpax winh yet' heb' yuninal winh, ix yalan winh: --Ha winh wuninal aj Siquem te ay wal snib'ej winh t'a ix heyanab', yuj chi' elokab' t'a he k'o'ol yik syik'laj sb'a ix yet' winh.
Ichato ol ko k'ab'kokej ko b'a. Ol kik'laj ko b'a yet' heb' ix heyisil, ha hex xo ol heyik'laj he b'a yet' heb' ix kiko'.
Kajnajanhek t'a ko kal tik, kolan tzex aj t'a sat ko lu'um tik, ak'ekoch he chonh, manek he lu'um, xchi winhaj Hamor chi'.
Ix yalanpax winhaj Siquem chi' t'a winh smam ix Dina chi' yet' t'a heb' winh snulej ix: --Yalnhej tas tze k'an t'ayin ol wak' t'ayex.
Wach'chom niwan tas swak' t'a yib'anh tas syak'taxon heb' anima yet' pax tzijtumok silab' syal wak'ani, palta malaj tz'ochi, anhej tato scha he k'o'ol swik' hin b'a yet' ix, xchi winhaj Siquem chi'.
Yujto toxo ix yixtej ix yanab' heb' winh chi' winh, ix tak'wi heb' winh t'a chab'satil t'a winh yet' t'a smam winh chi'.
Ix yalan heb' winh icha tik: --Max yal kak'an ix kanab' tik t'a junok winak to manh ak'b'ilok circuncidar, k'ixwelal tzonh ajkan icha chi'.

Anhej tato scha he k'o'ol icha kaj ha honh tik, tekan am skak' ix t'ayex, yujto ha honh tik, circuncidado honh. Tato syal he k'o'ol tzex ak'ji circuncidar yet' masanil heb' winh winak ay t'a he kal chi',
ichato chi' syal heyik'an heb' ix kisil ha honh tik, syalpax kik'an heb' ix heyiko'. Ichato chi' syal kaj t'a he kal, junxonhej chonhab'il tzonh aj heyet'ok.
Tato max scha he k'o'ol tze k'anab'ajej jun circuncisión chi' jun, ol honh el t'a tik, ol kik'anb'at ix kanab' tik ket'ok, xchi heb' winh.
Yuj chi' ix scha sk'o'ol winhaj Hamor yet' winh yuninal tas ix yal heb' winh chi'.
Majxo ek' wal niwan tiempo, yujto ay snib'ej winh t'a ix yisil winhaj Jacob chi'. Ha winhaj Siquem chi' anhej winh niwan yelk'och t'a skal heb' yuninal winhaj Hamor yet' t'a skal heb' sk'ab'yok.
T'a elanhchamel ix b'at winh yet' winh smam chi' t'a spuerta'il chonhab' b'aj smolb'ej sb'a heb' anima, ix och ijan heb' yalan icha tik t'a heb' winh winak:

--Ha juntzanh winak tik wach' spensar heb', ol kajnaj heb' t'a ko kal tik, ol yak'anoch schonh heb' t'a ko chonhab' tik. Te ay lum lum b'aj wach' yaj heb' winh. Syal kik'an ko b'a yet' heb' ix yisil heb' winh, syalpax yik'an sb'a heb' winh yet' heb' ix kiko'.
Anhej to snib'ej heb' winh to ko masanil ha honh winak honh tik, sko cha jun circuncisión icha yaj heb' winh, icha chi' junnhej chonhab'il tzonh aj yet' heb' winh.

Ha masanil stastak heb' winh yet' masanil nok' smolb'etzal nok' heb' winh, kikxo smasanil, anhej tato sko tak'wej t'a heb' winh, yik wach' skan heb' winh t'a ko kal, xchi winhaj Hamor yet' winhaj Siquem chi'.
Masanil heb' winh tz'akanxo spensar ix scha sk'o'ol heb' winh tas ix yal heb' chawanh chi', yuj chi' ix ak'ji circuncidar heb' winh masanil.

Haxo winhaj Simeón yet' winhaj Leví, yuninal winhaj Jacob, snulej ix Dina chi', ix b'at heb' winh t'a chonhab' chi' t'a schab'ji'al. Yakb'an yato ay heb' winh winak chi' yuj b'aj ix ak'ji circuncidar chi', ix k'och heb' winh chawanh chi' t'a yol chonhab' chi'. Ix och ijan heb' winh smilancham heb' winh ya yaj chi' smasanil t'a k'e'en espada, yujto manh na'anok yuj heb' aj chonhab' chi'.
Ix miljicham winhaj Hamor yet' winhaj Siquem yuj heb'. Ixlajwi chi' ix yik'anelta ix Dina heb' winh t'a yol spat winhaj Siquem chi', ix paxta heb' winh.

Ixlajwi chi' ix k'och masanil heb' winh yuninal winhaj Jacob chi', ix yik'anelta masanil tastak ay t'a heb' chamnak chi' heb' winh. Icha chi' ix aj spaktzitan heb' winh yuj b'aj ix ixtaj ix yanab' chi'.
Masanil tas ay t'a yol chonhab' chi' yet' tas ayel t'a najat ix yik'b'at heb' winh, nok' kalnel, nok' wakax yet' nok' b'uru.
Ix yelk'anb'at heb' winh masanil tas ay t'a yoltak pat, ix ik'jipaxb'at heb' kotak unin yet' heb' ix ix yuj heb' winh.

Palta ix yalan winhaj Jacob t'a winhaj Simeón yet' t'a winhaj Leví chi' icha tik: --Tik wal ha hex tzeyak' somchajel hin k'o'ol. Ha tikne'ik, masanil heb' winh kajan t'a juntzanh lugar tik, haton masanil heb' winh cananeo yet' heb' winh ferezeo, ol te och chi'an sk'o'ol heb' winh t'ayonh. Tekan ol smolb'ej sb'a heb' winh, ol yak'an owal heb' winh ket'ok. Jaywannhej ko winak ayek' ket'ok, tekan ol honh smilcham heb' winh ko masanil, xchi winhaj Jacob chi'.
Ix tak'wi heb' winh icha tik: --¿Tom ay sleyal syixtej ix kanab' tik winh, syutan ix winh icha junok ix ajmul ix? xchi heb' winh.
Ix yalan Dios t'a winhaj Jacob: Elanh t'a tik, ixik kajnajankan t'a Betel. Hata' tza b'ok'e jun altar t'ayin. Hata' hin ch'oxnak hin b'a t'ayach ayik elnak t'a winh uktak aj Esaú, xchi t'a winh.

Ix yalan winhaj Jacob chi' t'a heb' ix yetb'eyum yet' t'a heb' yuninal yet' t'a masanil heb' winh ajun yet'ok: --Ik'ekel masanil juntzanh komon Dios t'a he kal, tze b'ikanel he b'a, tze k'exanel he pichul he masanil.
Koyek elanhchamel t'a Betel. Hata' ol hin b'ok'e jun altar yik swik'cha'anh sb'i Dios, haton jun ix kolwaj wet'ok ayik ay hin och t'a ilk'olal yet' b'ajtak hin ek'i, xchi winh.
Icha chi' ix aj yak'an juntzanh komon Dios yet'nak heb' t'a winhaj Jacob yet' k'e'en yuchikin heb'. Haxo winh ix b'at mukanem t'a yich jun te' ji ayek' t'a slak'anil Siquem.
