Ayik ix el heb' ta', ha Dios ix ak'an xiwk'olal t'a yib'anh masanil juntzanh chonhab' ayek' t'a slak'anil chi', yuj chi' manhxalaj mach ix pechan heb'.
Ix k'och winhaj Jacob chi' yet' masanil heb' anima yet'nak t'a jun lugar skuch Luz, t'a yol yik Canaán. Hanhejtona' jun chonhab' chi' skuchan Betel.
Hata' ix sb'ok'e jun altar winh, El-Betel ix sb'i'ejkan jun lugar chi' yuj winh, yujto hata' ix sch'ox sb'a Dios t'a winh ayik ix el winh t'a winh yuktak.

Hanhejtona' hata' ix cham ix Débora, haton ix ilannak k'ib' ix Rebeca. Ix smukanem ix heb' t'a yich jun te' ji t'a slak'anil Betel chi'. Haxo winhaj Jacob chi' ix sayan sb'i jun lugar chi', Te' Ji yik Kusk'olal, xchi.
Ayik ix jax winh t'a Canaán, spetoj winh t'a Padán-aram, ix sch'oxanxi sb'a Dios t'a winh, ix yalan wach' lolonel t'a yib'anh winh.
Ix yalan icha tik: Ha hach tik Jacob ha b'i, palta ha tikne'ik, manhxo ichokta' ol ha b'i'ej, Israel ol ha b'i'ejkani, xchi t'a winh.

Ayik ix lajwi sk'exan sb'i winh chi', ix yalan t'a winh icha tik: Ha hin ton Dios hin Syal Wu'uj Smasanil, manh jantakok ol aj uninal yet' inhtilal. Ha t'ayach ol pitzwok jun nación, tzijtum chonhab'il ol ajpax elk'ochi. T'a skal inhtilal chi' ay heb' ol och reyal.
Ha lum lum ix wala' to ol wak'kan t'a winhaj Abraham yet' t'a winhaj Isaac, swalpax tikne'ik to ol wak'kan t'ayach yet' t'a heb' inhtilal, xchi t'a winh.
Ixlajwi chi' ix el Dios b'aj ix lolon yet' winh.

Ix sayan jun niwan k'e'en winhaj Jacob chi', niwan yaj k'atan k'e'en, ix sb'o'ankank'e linhan k'e'en winh b'aj ix lolon Dios yet'ok. Ix sekank'e aceite yet' wino winh t'a yib'anh k'e'en, yik syak' winh silab'ok t'a Dios.
Betel ix sb'i'ejkan jun lugar chi' yuj winh.
Ixlajwi chi' ix yaktankan jun lugar chi' heb'. Ayto sk'och heb' t'a Efrata, ix alji jun yune' ix Raquel.
Yik wal ayoch ix t'a ilk'olal yuj yab'an sya'il, haxo ix wetz'wajum ix halani: Manh hach xiwok, toxo ix alji junxo ha winak unin, xchi ix.
Palta ayik wanxo scham ix yuj jun unin chi', ix sayankan sb'i ix, Ben-oni ix sb'i'ejkani. Haxo winhaj Jacob chi' jun, Benjamín ix yak' winh sb'i'ej.
Hata' ix chamkan ix Raquel chi'. Ix mukchajkan ix t'a sb'e'al Efrata, haton jun lugar chi' skuch Belén tikne'ik.
Ix sb'o'ank'e linhan jun cimiento winhaj Jacob t'a yib'anh b'aj ix mukchaj sniwanil ix chi', haton jun chi' sch'oxankan b'ajtil mukan ix.
Ix b'atnhej winhaj Israel chi', ix sb'o'an scampamento winh t'a yichanhb'at Torre yik Edar.

Yakb'an kajan ek' heb' t'a jun lugar chi', haxo winhaj Rubén, yuninal winhaj Israel chi' ix way winh yet' ix Bilha, schab'il yetb'eyum winh smam chi'. Ix yab' winhaj Israel chi' tas ix sk'ulej winh yunin chi'. Lajchawanh heb' winh yuninal winhaj Jacob chi':
Ha heb' winh yuninal winh yet' ix Lea: Haton winhaj Rubén, winh b'ab'el unin, winhaj Simeón, winhaj Leví, winhaj Judá, winhaj Isacar yet' winhaj Zabulón.
Haxo heb' winh yuninal winh yet' ix Raquel: Haton winhaj José yet' winhaj Benjamín.
Haxo heb' yuninal winh yet' ix Bilha, ix scriada ix Raquel: Haton winhaj Dan yet' winhaj Neftalí.
Haxo pax heb' yuninal winh yet' ix Zilpa, ix scriada ix Lea: Haton winhaj Gad yet' winhaj Aser. Haton heb' tik yuninal winhaj Jacob ix alji t'a Padán-aram.
Ix b'at winhaj Jacob yil winh smam, haton winhaj Isaac, kajan t'a lum Mamre, t'a chonhab' Arba, Hebrón pax sb'i. Hata' ek'nak winhaj Abraham yet' winhaj Isaac chi'.
180 ab'il sk'inal winhaj Isaac chi' ayik ix cham winh.
Te ichamxo winh, haxo winhaj Esaú yet' winhaj Jacob, haton heb' winh yuninal winh, ha heb' winh ix mukankan winh.
Haton yab'ixal yinhtilal winhaj Esaú, Edom pax sb'i.
Ix yik'laj sb'a winhaj Esaú yet' heb' ix aj Canaán: Haton yet' ix Ada, yisil winhaj Elón hitita yet' pax ix Aholibama yisil winhaj Aná, yixchikin winhaj Zibeón heveo.
Ix yik'anpax ix Basemat winh, ix yisil winhaj Ismael. Ay jun winh snulej ix Basemat chi' skuchan Nebaiot.
Ha yune' ix Ada yet' winhaj Esaú, haton winhaj Elifaz. Haxo pax ix Basemat ix alji yune' ix, haton winhaj Reuel.
Haxo pax ix Aholibama ix alji heb' yune' ix: Haton winhaj Jeús, winhaj Jaalam yet' winhaj Coré. Haton heb' yuninal winhaj Esaú tik ix aj t'a yol yik Canaán, ayik kajanto'ek' winh ta'.

Ixlajwi chi', ix yik'anb'at heb' ix yetb'eyum winhaj Esaú chi' yet' heb' yuninal yet' masanil heb' kajanek' yet'ok. Ix b'at heb' t'a junxo lugar, yik tz'el winh t'a stz'ey winhaj Jacob, winh yuktak. Ix yik'anel masanil nok' smolb'etzal nok' winh t'a Canaán chi'.
Yujto tzijtumxo tas ay t'a heb' winh schawanhil, yuj chi' max yal-laj junnhej tz'aj heb' winh, yujto max yab'laj lum lum b'aj swa nok' smolb'etzal nok' heb' winh.
Yuj chi' ix b'at winhaj Esaú chi', ix b'at kajnaj winh t'a tzalkixtak t'a yol yik Seir.
Haton tik yab'ixal heb' yinhtilal winhaj Esaú, haton heb' smam yicham heb' winh edomita, heb' winh ix kajnajek' t'a tzalkixtak t'a Seir.
Haton sb'i heb' yinhtilal winhaj Esaú: Winhaj Elifaz, yune' ix Ada, winhaj Reuel yune' ix Basemat.
Haton heb' tik yuninal winhaj Elifaz: Winhaj Temán, winhaj Omar, winhaj Zefo, winhaj Gatam yet' winhaj Cenaz.
Ay jun ix schab'il yetb'eyum winhaj Elifaz chi', Timna sb'i ix. Ix alji jun yune' ix, Amalec ix yak' ix sb'i'ej. Haton heb' tik yixchikin ix Ada, ix yetb'eyum winhaj Esaú.
Ha heb' yuninal winhaj Reuel: Winhaj Nahat, winhaj Zera, winhaj Sama yet' winhaj Miza, haton heb' tik yixchikin ix Basemat, junxo ix yetb'eyum winhaj Esaú.
Aholibama sb'i junxo ix yetb'eyum winhaj Esaú chi', haxo heb' yune' ix haton winhaj Jeús, winhaj Jaalam yet' winhaj Coré. Ha ix Aholibama chi' yisil ix winhaj Aná, yixchikin winhaj Zibeón.

Ha heb' yajalil chonhab' ix el t'a skal yinhtilal winhaj Esaú, haton heb' tik: Ha heb' ix el t'a yinhtilal winhaj Elifaz, b'ab'el yuninal winhaj Esaú: Haton winhaj Temán, winhaj Omar, winhaj Zefo, winhaj Cenaz,
winhaj Coré, winhaj Gatam yet' winhaj Amalec. Ha juntzanh heb' winh yajal tik ix el t'a yinhtilal winhaj Elifaz t'a yol yik Edom. Masanil juntzanh heb' winh tik, yixchikin heb' winh ix Ada.

Ha t'a skal heb' yuninal winhaj Reuel yuninal winhaj Esaú, ha heb' ix och yajalilok chonhab': Haton winhaj Nahat, winhaj Zera, winhaj Sama yet' winhaj Miza. Ha heb' yajal tik ix el t'a yinhtilal winhaj Reuel t'a yol yik Edom. Masanil juntzanh heb' winh tik, yixchikin heb' winh ix Basemat yetb'eyum winhaj Esaú.
Ha heb' yune' ix Aholibama yisil winhaj Aná, yetb'eyum winhaj Esaú, ix och yajalilok chonhab': Haton winhaj Jeús, winhaj Jaalam yet' winhaj Coré.
Masanil juntzanh heb' winh yajal tik, yinhtilal heb' winhaj Esaú.
Ha heb' yuninal winhaj Seir horeo, ha heb' kajan t'a jun lugar chi' ayik manto k'och winhaj Esaú: Haton winhaj Lotán, winhaj Sobal, winhaj Zibeón, winhaj Aná,
winhaj Disón, winhaj Ezer yet' winhaj Disán. Haton heb' tik yajalil chonhab' t'a skal heb' horeo, heb' yinhtilal Seir, t'a yol yik Edom.
Haxo heb' yuninal winhaj Lotán, haton heb' tik: Winhaj Hori yet' winhaj Hemam. Timna sb'i ix yanab' winhaj Lotán chi'.
Ha heb' yuninal winhaj Sobal, haton heb' tik: Winhaj Alván, winhaj Manahat, winhaj Ebal, winhaj Sefo yet' winhaj Onam.
Eb' yuninal winhaj Zibeón, haton winhaj Aja yet' winhaj Aná. Ayik ix stanhwan nok' sb'uru winh smam winhaj Aná chi' t'a tzinan lu'um, ix ilchaj jun sjaj ha ha' yuj winh.
Haxo winhaj Aná chi', ay jun yuninal winh skuchan Disón, ay pax jun ix yisil winh skuchan Aholibama.
Ha heb' yuninal winhaj Disón, haton heb' tik: Winhaj Hemdán, winhaj Esbán, winhaj Itrán yet' winhaj Querán.
Ha heb' yuninal winhaj Ezer, haton heb' tik: Winhaj Bilhán, winhaj Zaaván yet' winhaj Acán.
Ha heb' yuninal winhaj Disán, haton winhaj Uz yet' winhaj Arán.
Ha heb' yajalil chonhab' t'a skal heb' horeo t'a yol yik Seir, haton heb' tik: Winhaj Lotán, winhaj Sobal, winhaj Zibeón, winhaj Aná, winhaj Disón, winhaj Ezer yet' winhaj Disán.
Haton heb' winh tik ix yak' yajalil t'a Edom, ayik mantalaj sreyal heb' israel.
Ha winhaj Bela, yuninal winhaj Beor aj Dinaba, ix yak' reyal winh t'a Edom.
Ayik ix cham winh, ix ochkan winhaj Jobab yuninal winhaj Zera aj Bosra reyal sk'exulok winh.
Ayik ix cham winhaj Jobab chi', haxo winhaj Husam aj Temán, ix ochkan reyal sk'exulok winh.
Ayik ix cham winhaj Husam chi', haxo winhaj Hadad yuninal winhaj Bedad aj chonhab' Avit ix ochkan reyal sk'exulok winh. Haton winh ix ak'an ganar heb' aj Madián t'a yol yik Moab.
Ayik ix cham winhaj Hadad chi', haxo winhaj Samla aj Masreca ix ochkan reyal sk'exulok winh.
Ayik ix cham winhaj Samla chi', haxo winhaj Saúl aj chonhab' Rehobot ix ochkan reyal sk'exulok winh. Ha jun chonhab' Rehobot chi', ha t'a sti' ha' niwan Éufrates ay.
Ayik ix cham winhaj Saúl chi', haxo winhaj Baal-hanán yuninal winhaj Acbor ix ochkan reyal sk'exulok winh.
Ayik ix cham winhaj Baal-hanán chi', haxo winhaj Hadad aj Pau ix ochkan reyal sk'exulok winh. Haxo ix yetb'eyum winhaj Hadad chi', Mehetabel sb'i ix, yune' ix ix Matred, yixchikin winhaj Mezaab.

Haton sb'i heb' yajalil chonhab' ix el t'a yinhtilal winhaj Esaú tik: Winhaj Timna, winhaj Alva, winhaj Jetet, winhaj Aholibama, winhaj Ela, winhaj Pinón, winhaj Cenaz, winhaj Temán, winhaj Mibzar, winhaj Magdiel yet' winhaj Iram. Hanhejtona' ha sb'i heb' ix och t'a junjun lugar b'aj ix ek' heb'. Ha winhaj Esaú chi' Edom pax sb'i winh, haton smam yicham heb' edomita.
Ha winhaj Jacob ix kannhej kajan winh t'a Canaán b'aj ek'nak kajan smam.

Haton yab'ixal winhaj Jacob tik. Ha winhaj José yuninal winhaj Jacob, 17 ab'il sk'inal winh, tanhwoj kalnel syak' winh yet' heb' winh yuktak. Ha heb' winh yuktak winh chi', haton heb' winh yune' ix Bilha yet' ix Zilpa, heb' ix chab'il yetb'eyum winhaj Jacob. Ha winhaj José chi' tz'ik'ankot ab'ix t'a winh smam tato manh wach'ok syutej sb'a heb' winh yuktak winh chi'.
Te xajan winhaj José chi' yuj winh smam t'a yichanh juntzanhxo heb' winh yuktak chi', yujto yolxo yichamwinakil ix alji winh. Yuj chi' ix sb'o jun spichul winh, tz'ib'iltak yilji.
Ha ix yilan juntzanhxo heb' winh yuktak winh chi' to yelxo wal te xajan winhaj José chi' yuj winh smam chi', ix te chichon sk'o'ol heb' winh t'a winh, te chuk slolon heb' winh t'a winh.

Ay jun swayich winhaj José chi' ix ochi, ix yalan winh t'a heb' winh yuktak chi' icha tik: --Ab'ek wal hin wayich. Ix hin wayichej to wan ko jochwi trigo, junjun honh ket' junjun manoja kiko'. T'a jun rato chi' ix k'e linhan ixim wiko' yet' ixim heyik chi', haxo ixim heyik chi' ix em nhojan ixim t'a spatik yichanh ixim wik chi', xchi winh. Ix tak'wi heb' winh yuktak winh chi' icha tik: --¿Am syalelk'och jun tzal chi' to ol hach och ko reyalok? ¿Ha hach am ol ala' tas ol ko k'ulej? xchi heb' winh. Ix te kot yowal heb' winh yuj swayich winh ix yal chi'.

Ixlajwi chi' ix och junxo swayich winhaj José chi', ix yalanxi winh t'a heb' winh yuktak chi' icha tik: --Ay wal junxo hin wayich ix ochi. Ha t'a jun hin wayich chi' ix wila', to ha k'u yet' k'e'en uj yet' huxluche' k'anal ix em nhojan t'ayin, xchi winh.

Ayik ix yalan swayich winh chi' t'a winh smam yet' t'a heb' winh yuktak chi', ix kot yowal winh smam winh chi, ix yalan winh t'a winh icha tik: --¿Tas syalelk'och jun ha wayich chi? ¿Tom ol hin em nhojan yet' ix ha nun yet' heb' winh uktak tik t'a ichanh? xchi winh.
Icha chi' ix aj sk'e wa'an schichonk'olal heb' winh yuktak winh chi' t'a spatik, palta haxo winh smam winh chi', ix sna'ub'tanhej wal winh tas wal syalelk'och jun swayich winh chi'.
Ay jun k'uhal ix b'at heb' winh yuktak winhaj José chi' t'a Siquem say b'aj wach' swa nok' skalnel winh smam heb' winh chi'.

Ixlajwi chi', ix yalan winhaj Israel t'a winhaj José chi' icha tik: --Ha tikne'ik ha heb' winh uktak, ha t'a Siquem ayek' heb' winh tanhwoj kalnel, tzin nib'ej tzach b'at il heb' winh, xchi winh. --Hinye, ol hin b'atok, xchi winhaj José chi'.

--Wach' jun, ixik, yik wach' tzila' chajtil yaj heb' winh yet' nok' kalnel chi', tzul halan wab'i, xchi winh smam winh chi'. T'a sch'olanil lum Hebrón ayek' winhaj José chi' ayik ix chekjib'at winh yuj winh smam. Haxo yik ix k'och winh t'a yol yik Siquem,
ix ek'chaj winh sayek' heb' winh yuktak chi' ta'. Ay jun winh winak ix schalaj sb'a winh yet'ok, ix sk'anb'an winh winak chi' icha tik: --¿Tas tz'ek' ha saya'? xchi winh t'a winhaj José chi'.
--To tzin ek' hin say heb' winh wuktak. ¿Maj am ila' b'ajtil stanhwej nok' kalnel heb' winh? xchi winhaj José chi'.

--Toxo ix b'at heb' winh t'a tik. Ix wab' yalan heb' winh: Wach' tzonh b'at t'a Dotán, xchi heb' winh ix wab'i, xchi winh winak chi'. Ix b'atnhej winhaj José chi', ix ilchaj heb' winh yuktak winh chi' yuj t'a Dotán chi'.
Ayik ix yilanb'at winh heb' winh t'a najat, ayto wal sk'och winh t'a heb' winh, ix slajti'an sb'a heb' winh tas syutej heb' winh smilancham winh.
Ix yalan heb' winh icha tik: --Ina sja winh swayichani.

Ko milekcham winh, ol ko julankanb'at winh t'a yol junok jul, ol kalani to ha am junok nok' nok' chi'um anima ix chi'anb'at winh. Ol kilan b'i'an tas ol aj yelk'och juntzanh swayich winh chi', xchi heb' winh.
Ayik ix yab'an juntzanh lolonel chi' winhaj Rubén, ix sna'an winh tas wach' syutej skolanel winhaj José chi' t'a yol sk'ab' heb' winh, ix yalan winh icha tik: --Ma'ay, manh ko milekchamlaj winh.

Mokab' och schamel winh chi' ko mulok. Anhejto skak'em winh t'a yol junok yet'tal ha' joyb'il t'a tzinan lum tik. Mokab'a junok honh tz'och ko k'ab' t'a winh, xchi winh. Ix yal jun lolonel chi' winhaj Rubén chi', yujto snib'ej winh skolkan winhaj José chi', yik wach' syak' meltzaj winh winh t'a winh smam.
Haxo ix k'och winhaj José b'aj ayek' heb' winh yuktak chi', elanhchamel ix tzak'jikot winh yuj heb' winh. Ix yik'anel spichul winh heb' winh ayochi, haton jun tz'ib'iltak yilji.
Ixlajwi chi' ix ak'ji'em winh yuj heb' t'a yol jun yet'tal ha' jul yich, malaj ha ha' t'a yo'ol.

Ixlajwi chi' ix em k'ojan heb' winh wa'el. Yakb'an chi' jun, ix yilan heb' winh skot jun nhilanh heb' winh ismaelita ix kot t'a Galaad. Ha perfume, bálsamo yet' mirra ayoch yib'anh scamello heb' winh, sb'at heb' winh schonh t'a Egipto.
Ix yalan winhaj Judá t'a heb' yuktak chi' icha tik: --¿Tas skak' ganar sko milancham winh kuktak tik, sko k'ub'aneli to maj kila' b'aj ix cham winh?
Wach' hama to sko chonhb'at winh t'a heb' winh ismaelita wan sja tik. Mokab' ko milcham winh yujto kuktak ko b'a yet' winh, xchi winh. Ix scha'an sk'o'ol heb' winh chi' tas ix yal winhaj Judá chi'.

Haxo yik ix ek' heb' winh aj Madián chi', elanhchamel ix ik'chajk'eta winhaj José t'a yol jun jul chi', ix schonhanb'at winh heb' winh t'a heb' winh chonhwajum chi'. 20 siclo plata ix yak' heb' winh t'a heb' winh stojolok. Icha chi' ix aj yik'chajb'at winhaj José chi' t'a Egipto.
Ayik ix jax winhaj Rubén chi', ix b'at winh yil t'a sti' jun jul chi', manhxalaj winhaj José chi' ayek'i. Ix snhik'chitanb'at sjaj spichul winh yuj skusk'olal.
Ix b'at lemnaj winh t'a heb' winh yuktak chi', ix yalan winh icha tik: --Manhxo ayokem winh kuktak t'a jun jul chi'. ¿Tas wach' tzin k'ulej tikne'ik? xchi winh.
Ha t'a jun rato chi', ix smilancham jun nok' yune' chiwa heb' winh. Ix yik'anelta schik'il nok' heb' winh, ix sb'onhanoch heb' winh t'a spichul winhaj José chi'.
Ix yak'anb'at jun pichul chi' heb' winh t'a winh smam, ix yalanb'at heb' winh icha tik: Ix ilchaj jun pichul tik ku'uj, ilnab'i talaj ha spichul winh uninal, xchib'at heb' winh.

Ayik ix yilan winhaj Jacob, to haton spichul winhaj José, ix yalan winh icha tik: Ay... haton wal spichul winh wuninal tik. Ay am wal junok nok' schi'an anima ix tzilchitanb'at winh, ix schi'anb'at wuninal, xchi winh.
Ixlajwi chi', ix snhik'chitanel spichul winh, ix yak'anoch jun pichul winh yik kusk'olal. Te niwan tiempo ix ok' winh yuj winh yunin chi'.

Masanil heb' yuninal winh yet' heb' ix yisil winh, ix yak'lej heb' yak'an sniwanil sk'o'ol winh, palta max yal-laj sk'o'ol winh tz'ak'ji sniwanil sk'o'ol. Tz'ok'nhej winh yuj winh yuninal chi'. Ix yalan winh icha tik: Ol te kusnhej wal hin k'o'ol yuj winh wuninal masanto ol hin b'at b'aj ayek' winh t'a skal heb' chamnak, xchi winh.
Haxo heb' winh aj Madián chi', ayik ix k'och heb' winh t'a Egipto chi', ix schonhanxib'at winhaj José chi' heb' winh t'a winhaj Potifar, yajal heb' stanhwan winh rey t'a Egipto chi'.
Ha t'a jun pekti' chi', ha winhaj Judá ix spojel sb'a winh t'a heb' yuktak, ix b'at kajnaj winh t'a slak'anil jun winh winak skuchan Hira, aj chonhab' Adulam.
Hata' ix yiloch ix yisil jun winh aj Canaán skuchan Súa winh, ix yik'lan sb'a winh yet' ix.
Ix skuchanoch yune' ix. Ayik ix alji yune' ix chi', Er ix sb'i'ej.
Ixlajwi chi' ix skuchanxi'och yune' ix. Ayik ix alji yune' ix chi', Onán ix yak' ix sb'i'ej.
Ix skuchanoch junxo yune' ix. Ayik ix alji, Sela ix yak' ix sb'i'ej. Ha t'a Quezib ayek' winhaj Judá chi' ayik ix alji winh unin chi'.
Haxo yik ix kelemax winhaj Er b'ab'el unin chi', ix sayji yetb'eyum winh yuj winhaj Judá chi', ix yik'an ix Tamar winh.
Te chuk ix yutej sb'a winhaj Er chi' t'a yichanh Jehová, yuj chi' ix cham winh yuj.

Ixlajwi chi' ix yalan winhaj Judá t'a winhaj Onán icha tik: --Ik'laj ha b'a yet' ix yetb'eyum winh uktak chamnak, tza k'anab'ajej ko ley, ichato yinhtilal winh uktak chi' ol elkan hu'uj yet' ix, xchi winhaj Judá chi'.

Palta yojtak winhaj Onán chi' to ha unin ol aljok chi', manh yikok winh ol aj yet' ix smu' chi', yuj chi' juntak el sway winh yet' ix, haxo yinhatil winh syak'kanem winh t'a sat lu'um yik max och ix yab'ixal, yik wach' max elkanlaj yinhtilal winh yuktak winh chi' sna'ani.
Ha tas ix sk'ulej winh chi', chuk t'a sat Jehová, yuj chi' ix cham winh.

Ixlajwi chi', ix yalan winhaj Judá t'a ix yalib' chi' icha tik: --Ha tikne'ik wach' tzach paxkan yet' ha mam ha nun. Malaj junokxo winak wach' tzik'a'. Hato yik ol k'och sk'inal winhaj Sela wuninal, ichato chi' ol yal ik'an ha b'a yet' winh, xchi winhaj Judá chi'. Tonhej ix yal winh icha chi', k'inalok schampax winhaj Sela chi' sna'an winh, icha ix aj scham chawanh heb' winh yuktak. Icha chi' ix aj sb'at ix Tamar yik skajnaj ix yet' smam snun.

Pekatax chi' ix cham ix yetb'eyum winhaj Judá chi', ix yisil winhaj Súa. Ixlajwi yek'b'at skusk'olal winh, ix b'at winh t'a chonhab' Timnat b'aj wan sjoxchajel xil nok' skalnel, haxo jun winh yamigo winh skuchan Hira ix b'at yuk'lewok.
Haxo yik ix yab'an spekal ix Tamar to wan sb'at winhaj Judá t'a Timnat yil sjoxchajel nok' skalnel,

t'a elanhchamel ix yik'el spichul ix, haton k'apak syak'och heb' ix chamnak yetb'eyum. Ix yak'anoch jun smusil sat ix, yik wach' malaj mach sna'aneli tato ha ix. Ix em k'ojan ix t'a sti'el chonhab' b'aj sk'och sb'e'al chonhab' Enaim, t'a sb'e'al Timnat chi'. Ix sk'ulej jun tik ix, yujto ix nachajel yuj ix to ha winhaj Sela ix k'ib'el winh, palta maxto yik'laj sb'a winh yet' ix.
Ayik ix yilanb'at ix winhaj Judá chi', ix sna'an winh to ajmul ix jun ix chi', yujto musab'il sat ix.

Ix el winhaj Judá chi' t'a yol b'e, ix b'at winh yilb'at ix. Manh yojtakok winh tato ha ix yalib' winh. Ix yalan winh t'a ix icha tik: --¿Max am yal ha k'o'ol tzin way het'ok? xchi winh. --Tato syal hin k'o'ol ¿tas junok tzak' t'ayin? xchi ix.
--Ol wak'kot junok yune' ha chiwa, xchi winh t'a ix. --Tzam yala', anhej tato ay junok tas tzak'kan t'ayin tikne'ik. Ayik sjawi nok' hin yune' chiwa chi', swak'anxi meltzaj t'ayach, xchi ix.

--¿Tas pax tza nib'ej swak'kan t'ayach? xchi winhaj Judá chi'. --Ak'kan ha sello yet' sch'anhal yet' ha k'okoch het'nak, xchi ix. --Syala', kanokab'i, xchi winh. Ixlajwi chi' ix way winh yet' ix, ix skuchankanoch yune' ix.
Ixlajwi chi', ix b'at ix, ix yik'anel smusil sat ix chi', ix yak'anxi'och sk'apak ix syak'och heb' ix chamnak yetb'eyum.

Ayik ix k'och winhaj Judá b'aj ayek' nok' skalnel chi', ix schekankot winh yamigo winh, haton winh aj Adulam, ix b'at yak'ankan nok' yune' chiwa chi' winh t'a ix ix chi' yik syik'paxta tas aykan chi' t'a ix yuj winhaj Judá chi' yalani, palta majxo ilchajlaj ix yuj winh schekab' win chi'.

Ix sk'anb'anek' winh t'a heb' aj chonhab' chi' icha tik: --¿B'ajtil ay jun ix ajmul ix t'a tik, jun ix tz'emnhej k'ojan t'a sti' sb'e'al Enaim tik? xchi winh chekab' chi'. --Malaj junok ix ajmul ix t'a tik, xchi heb' winh.
Ixlajwi chi' ix meltzajxi winh t'a winhaj Judá chi', ix yalan winh: --Majxo ilchajlaj ix wu'uj, ix yal heb' winh ayek' chi' ta' to malaj junok ix ajmul ix b'aj ay heb' chi', xchi winh.
Ix tak'wi winhaj Judá icha tik: --Kanokab' ix yet' juntzanh chi', yik wach' max el ko k'ixwelal. Ix hin k'anab'ajej, ix wak'anb'at nok' yune' chiwa, anhej to majxo ilchaj ix hu'uj, xchi winh.

Yoxil xom ujal chi', ix b'at alchaj t'a winhaj Judá icha tik: --Ha ix Tamar, ix alib', ay am mach ix sk'umej ix, yuj chi' yab'ixxo ix tikne'ik, xchi heb' winh t'a winh. Ix yalan winh: --Ik'ekel ix t'a sti'el chonhab' yik tze nhusantz'a ix, xchi winh.

Ayik wan yik'ji'elta ix yuj heb' winh, ix yak'anb'at schekab' ix t'a winhaj Judá chi', ix yalan icha tik: Ha winh ay yik juntzanh swak'b'at tik, haton winh ay yik unin wet'nak tik. B'eyk'olej mach ay yik jun sello yet' sch'anhal tik yet' jun k'okoch tik, xchib'at ix t'a winh.

Ayik ix yilanoch winhaj Judá to yik masanil juntzanh chi' winh, ix yalan winh icha tik: Ha ix ix chi' wach' tas ix sk'ulej ix. Ha hin chuk tas ix hin k'ulej. Ay hin mul. Maj wak'laj yik' sb'a ix yet' winh wuninal aj Sela, xchi winh. Yuj chi' maj nhusjitz'alaj ix. Majxo waylaj winh yet' ix jun'elxo.
Haxo ix b'o sk'o'ol ix Tamar chi', ti'ox heb' unin ix alji chi'.
Ayik wan yalji heb' unin chi', ayik ix elul sk'ab' jun b'ab'el, ix spixanoch jab' chak ch'al ix wetz'wajum t'a sjaj sk'ab' jun unin chi', ix yalan ix: Haton jun b'ab'el tik, xchi ix.

Palta ix yik'anxi'och sk'ab' jun nene' chi', haxo junxo yuktak chi' ix alji sb'ab'elal, yuj chi' Fares ix sb'i'ej yuj ix wetz'wajum chi'. Ix yalan ix: ¿Tas yuj ix ha b'ab'laj ekejelta ha b'a? xchi ix.
Ixlajwi chi' ix alji winh nene' ayoch anh chak ch'al chi' t'a sjaj sk'ab', Zara ix sb'i'ej yuj ix.

Ayik ix k'och winhaj José yuj heb' winh ismaelita t'a Egipto chi', ay jun winh skuch Potifar ix mananel winh. Ha jun winh chi', niwan yopisio winh t'a winh sreyal Egipto, yajal yaj winh t'a heb' soldado stanhwan winh rey chi'.
Ha Jehová ayoch yet' winhaj José chi', te wach'nhej yajek' winh t'a spat winh spatrón chi'.
Ix nachajel yuj winh spatrón winh chi' to ay wal och Jehová yet' winh, wach'nhej tz'elk'och winh t'a smasanil.
Yuj chi', te wach'nhej winhaj José t'a yichanh winh spatrón chi'. Ix yak'och winh winh stanhwumalok spat yet' masanil tastak ay t'ay.

Yiktax ix yak'anoch winh winhaj Potifar chi' stanhwumalok spat chi', ix yak' swach'k'olal Jehová t'a yib'anh winhaj Potifar chi' yet' masanil tas ay t'a winh. Yujnhej winhaj José chi' ix k'echa'anh swach'k'olal t'a spat winh yet' t'a najateli.

Ix kannhej winhaj José chi' stanhwumalok smasanil, yuj chi' manhxalaj tas ix sna' winhaj Potifar chi', palta anhej tas tz'aj sb'o swa'el winh syila'. Te wach' yilji winhaj José chi', te wach' pax sniwanil winh smasanil.
Ix ek' jab'ok tiempo'al, haxo ix yetb'eyum winhaj Potifar chi', ix te kan snib'ej ix t'a winhaj José chi'. Ix yalan ix t'a winh icha tik: --Oktom wal syal ha k'o'ol tzach way wet'ok, xchi ix.

Te maj schalaj sk'o'ol winhaj José tas ix yal ix chi'. Ix yalan winh icha tik: --Ma'ay, ojtak hach tik to ix hin yak'och winh etb'eyum stanhwumalok masanil stastak t'a tik. Ina manhxo jab'ok tas sna' winh yuj masanil stastak yakb'an ay hin ek'i.

Malaj junokxo mach niwan yelk'och t'a wichanh t'a jun pat tik. Masanil tastak ayoch t'a yol hin k'ab', anhej t'ayach ha hach tik, max yal-laj wak'anoch hin k'ab', yujto yetb'eyum hach winh hin patrón, ¿tom ol yal hin k'ulan jun niwan chukal, yik tz'och hin mul t'a sat Dios? xchi winh.
Ix ochnhej ijan ix stewi'och t'a winh. Junjun k'u syal ix to sway winh yet' ix, palta jun'elnhej max ochlaj t'a sk'o'ol winh sway yet' ix, max yalpaxlaj sk'o'ol winh sk'och b'aj ayek' ix.
Ay jun k'u ix och winhaj José chi' t'a yol pat yik smunlaji, malaj junokxo mach ayek'i, anhej ix.

Haxo ta' ix och tzuktzuk ix t'a spichul winh, ix yalan ix icha tik: --Wayanh wet'ok, xchi ix. Haxo ix yab'an jun chi' winh, ix spich'anel sb'a winh t'a yol sk'ab' ix. Ix elta lemnaj winh t'a ti pat, haxo spichul winh ix kan t'a yol sk'ab' ix.
Ayik ix yilan ix to ix el lemnaj winh, ix kan spichul winh t'a yol sk'ab' ix,

ix el yaw ix, ix yawtankot heb' munlajwum ix t'a slak'anil pat chi', ix yalan ix: --Ilek wal jun winh hebreo ix yik'kot winh wetb'eyum tik. Ha winh tik, snib'ej winh tzin yixtej. Ix ochul lemnaj winh t'a yol pat tik, snib'ej winh sway wet'ok, palta cha'anh ix el waw.
Ayik ix yab'an winh yel waw chi', ix el lemnaj winh, haxonhej spichul winh ix kani, xchi ix.
Ix sik'ankan jun spichul winh chi' ix masanto ix jax winh spatrón winh chi' t'a spat.
Ix yalan ix icha ix aj yalan t'a sb'ab'elal chi': --Ha winh hebreo ix ik'kot chekab'ok tik, ix ochul winh t'a yol hin cuarto, snib'ej winh ix way wet'ok.
Palta te cha'anh ix el waw, yuj chi' ix el lemnaj winh, haxonhej spichul winh ix yaktejkan t'a tik.
Icha wal chi' ix hin yutej jun winh ha chekab' tik, xchi ix. Haxo winh spatrón winhaj José chi', ix te kot yowal winh sik'lab'il ayik ix yab'an winh tas ix yal ix yetb'eyum chi'.
Ix schekan yamjok winhaj José chi' winh, ix yalan winh to tz'och winh t'a preso b'aj ayoch juntzanh heb' winh t'a preso yuj winh rey.
Palta aynhejoch Jehová yet' winhaj José chi', ix sch'oxnhej swach'k'olal t'a winh. Yuj chi' te wach' ix elk'och winh t'a yol sat winh tanhwum preso chi'.
Haxo winh tanhwum preso chi' ix ak'anoch winh stanhwumalok heb' yetpresowumal chi'. Ix ak'jipaxoch winh yilumalok tastak ix sb'o heb' t'a preso chi'.
Ha winh stanhwumal preso chi', manhxalaj tas sna'a winh, masanil tas aykanoch t'a yol sk'ab' winhaj José chi' yuj winh. Yujto aynhejoch Jehová yet' winh, yuj chi' wach'nhej ix elk'och smasanil.

Ixlajwi chi', ay chawanh winak ix och preso: Ha jun winh, yajal yaj winh t'a heb' winh tz'ak'an swino winh rey, haxo junxo winh, yajal yaj winh t'a heb' winh b'o'um pan swa winh rey chi'. Ay smul heb' winh ix och t'a winh rey chi'.
Yuj chi' ix kot yowal winh t'a heb' winh.
Ix yalan winh rey to tz'ak'ji'och heb' winh t'a preso t'a spat winh yajal t'a heb' soldado stanhwan winh, haton ta' aypaxoch winhaj José t'a preso.
Hanheja' t'a yol sk'ab' winhaj José chi' ix kan heb' winh chawanh smunlajwum winh rey chi' yuj winh yajal preso chi' yik ha winh tz'ak'an serwil heb' winh. Ix kan heb' winh jun pekti' t'a preso chi'.
Haxo t'a jun ak'wal ix och swayich heb' winh chawanh chi', junjun wayich chi' ay syalelk'ochi.
Haxo ix sakb'i ix k'och winhaj José yil heb' winh. Ix yilan winh to te ayoch heb' winh t'a ilk'olal.
Ix sk'anb'an winh t'a heb' winh: --¿Tas yuj te kuseltak yilji he sat? xchi winh t'a heb' winh.

--Ay wal ko wayich ix och t'a jun ak'wal tik, palta malaj mach t'a tik tz'alan t'ayonh tas syalelk'ochi, xchi heb' winh. --¿Tom manhok Dios syal yalani tas syalelk'och wayich? Alek t'ayin tas ix he wayichej chi', xchi winhaj José chi'.
Yuj chi' ha winh yajal yaj t'a heb' winh tz'ak'an swino winh rey, ix och ijan winh yalan swayich chi' t'a winhaj José icha tik: --Ha t'a hin wayich, ix wil jun te' uwa,
ay oxe' sk'ab' te'. Ix wil sk'eta swol, ix yak'an xumakil, haxo xumakil chi', ix och b'uyan sat, te k'inhxo.
Ha ix wilani to yamb'ilk'e skopa winh rey wu'uj, ix wik'ankot sat te' uwa chi', ix hin pitz'anem yal t'a yol skopa winh rey chi', ix wak'anoch t'a yol sk'ab' winh, xchi winh.
Ix yalan winhaj José t'a winh icha tik: --Ichaton tik syalelk'och ha wayich chi': Ha oxe' sk'ab' te' uwa ix il chi', oxe' k'uhal syala'.
Ayik chab'ej tikne'ik ol sb'eyk'olej ha mul winh rey chi'. Ol lajwok chi' ol hach yak'anxi'och winh t'a ha munlajel, ol ak'xi skopa winh chi' icha t'a yalanhtaxo.
Ayik ol elk'och jun swal tik, tzin ha na'ankot t'a winh rey chi', yik wach' tzin elpax t'a yol preso tik. Ok'okab' ha k'o'ol t'ayin.
Ha hin tik ichato elk'ab'il hin kot t'a skal heb' winh hebreo. Manh hin mojok ay hin och t'a preso tik, yujto malaj jab'ok tas chuk ix hin k'ulej, xchi winhaj José chi'.

Ayik ix yab'an winh yajalil heb' winh sb'o'an ixim pan to ha winhaj José wach' ix aj yalanel swayich winh chi' winh, ix yalanpax winh icha tik: --Ha hin tik ix hin wayichej to ayk'e oxe' mo'och ixim pan t'a hin jolom.

Ha t'a yol jun yune' mo'och t'a jun yoxil ayk'e t'a hin jolom chi', tzijtum makanhil ixim pan ayem t'a yo'ol yik swa winh rey, palta haxo nok' much ix jawi ix stzok'ank'eta ixim nok' t'a yol te' mo'och chi', xchi winh.
Ix yalanxi winhaj José t'a winh icha tik: --Ha tas syalelk'och ha wayich chi', haton tik: Ha oxe' mo'och chi' sch'oxkot oxe' k'uhal.

Yuj chi' yik chab'ej tikne'ik, ol sb'eyk'olej winh rey tas yaj ha mul. Slajwi chi' ol schekan winh ik'chajel ha jolom, ha ha niwanil ol ak'jokk'e t'a schon jun te te', haxo nok' ostok ol ja schib'at ha niwanil chi', xchi winhaj José chi' t'a winh.

Schab'ji'al wal yalan swayich heb' winh chawanh chi' winhaj José chi', ix yak'an sk'inhal yab'ilal winh rey. Ix yawtankot winh masanil heb' winh niwak winak ayoch yajalil yet'ok. T'a yichanh heb' winh niwak yajal chi' ix chekji ik'chajelta heb' winh chawanh ayoch t'a preso chi'.
Ha winh tz'ak'an swino winh rey, ix ak'chajxi'och winh t'a smunlajel.
Haxo winh yajal yaj t'a heb' sb'o'an ixim pan, ix yal winh rey to smiljicham winh icha wal ix aj yalan winhaj José.
Palta majxo nachajkot winhaj José yuj winh tz'ak'an swino winh rey chi'.
Haxo yik toxo ix ek'b'at chab' ab'il, ay jun ak'wal ix och swayich winh rey. Ix yil winh to linhanek' winh t'a sti' ha' niwan Nilo.
Ha t'a yol ha' chi', ix k'e'ul ukwanh nok' wakax te wach', te b'ak'ech, swa nok' t'a sti' ha' chi'.
Ixlajwi chi' ix k'e'ul ukwanhxo nok' wakax te chuklaj yilji, te b'ak, ix b'at nok' t'a slak'anil nok' b'ak'ech chi'.
Ix och ijan nok' b'ak chi' schi'anb'at nok' b'ak'ech chi'. Ixlajwi chi', ix el swayanh winh rey chi'.
Ix wayxib'at winh. Haxo ix yilan winh to ay jun pitanh ixim trigo ix k'ib'i, uke' wal ix aj sjolom ixim, te wach', b'ut'an wal yuj sat.
Ix yilanpax winh t'a spatiktak ixim b'ab'el chi', ix elpaxkot ukexo jolom trigo te malaj sat, nab'a pach'uch'tak, malaj jab'ok swach'il.
Ha uke' jolom trigo te pach'uch'tak chi', ha' ix k'uxanb'at ixim uke' te ay sat chi'. Haxo yik ix el swayanh winh rey chi', ix nachajel yuj winh to wan swayichan winh.

Haxo ix sakb'i, te taknakel sk'o'ol winh yuj swayich chi'. Ix schekan winh awtajkot masanil heb' syal sna'an el lolonel t'a Egipto yet' heb' te yojtak yalani. Ix och ijan winh rey chi' yalan swayich chi' t'a heb', palta malaj junok heb' syal yalani tas syalelk'och swayich winh chi'.
Yuj chi' haxo winh yajal yaj t'a heb' tz'ak'an swino winh rey chi' ix halan t'a winh icha tik: --Hato wal tikne'ik sja t'a hin k'o'ol to ay jun hin palta'il ix wak'ochi.
Ayik ix kot owal t'ayin yet' winh yajal heb' b'o'um pan, ix honh ak'och t'a yol sk'ab' winh yajal heb' tzach tanhwani, ix honh ochkan t'a preso.
Ay jun ak'wal ix och ko wayich ko chawanhil, junjun ko wayich chi' ay syalelk'ochi.
Hata' ayek' jun winh kelem hebreo, schekab'ejnak winh yajal heb' winh tzach tanhwan chi'. Ix kalan ko wayich chi' t'a winh. Te wach' ix yutej winh yalan tas syalelk'och ko wayich chi'.
Icha wal ix aj yalan winh chi', icha chi' ix aj yelk'ochi. Ina ix hin ochxi t'a hin munlajel, haxo junxo winh wet'nak chi, ix ak'jik'e t'unhan sniwanil winh, xchi winh yak'umal swino winh rey chi'.

Ixlajwi yab'an jun ab'ix winh rey chi', ix schekan winh ik'ji'elta winhaj José t'a yol preso. Elanhchamel ix b'at ik'chajelta winh, ix yak'an joxchajel sb'a winh, ix sk'exanel spichul winh, ix b'at winh t'a yichanh winh rey chi'.

Ix yalan winh rey chi' t'a winh icha tik: --Ay wal jun hin wayich. Malaj junok heb' winh ay t'a tik snachajel yuj tas syalelk'ochi. Ix wab' spekal tob' snachajel hu'uj tas syalelk'och wayich, xchi winh rey chi' t'a winh.
--Ha jun chi' manh yolok wik snachajel wu'uj, palta ha Dios ol alanok tas tz'elk'och ha wayich chi' yik tz'och ha wach'ilok, xchi winhaj José chi'.
Ix och ijan winh rey yalan swayich t'a winhaj José chi' icha tik: --Ha ix wilani to linhan hin ek' t'a sti' ha' Nilo.
T'a yol ha' chi' ix k'e'ul ukwanh nok' wakax te wach', te b'ak'ech. Ix wa'ek' nok' t'a stitak ha' chi'.
Ixlajwi chi' ix k'epaxul ukwanhxo nok' te b'ak, chuklaj yilji nok'. Manta b'aj swil junok wakax chuklaj yilji icha nok' chi' t'a Egipto tik.
Ha ukwanh nok' b'ak chi', ha nok' ix chi'anb'at ukwanh nok' b'ak'ech b'ab'el ix k'e'ul chi'.
Ayik ix lajwi'el nok' b'ak'ech schi'anb'at nok' b'ak chi', hanheja' b'ak ix ajkan nok', maj b'ak'echb'oklaj jab'ok nok'. Ixlajwi chi', ix el hin wayanh.
Ix kotxi hin wayanh, ix hin wayichanxi. Ix wilani, ay jun pitanh ixim trigo uke' wal sjolom ix yak'a', te b'ut'an yuj sat.
Ixlajwi chi' ix elpaxul ukexo sjolom, palta tonhej pach'uch'tak, malaj sat.

Haxo ixim chi' ix k'uxanb'at ixim wach' ay sat chi'. Ix wal hin wayich tik t'a heb' winh snachajel yuj yalani, palta malaj wal junok heb' winh syal snachajel yuj tas syalelk'ochi, xchi winh rey chi' t'a winh.
Ix yalan winhaj José chi' icha tik: --Mamin rey, ha chab' ha wayich chi', junnhej tas syalelk'ochi. Ha Dios ix ak'an ha wayichej tas nab'il yuj.
Ha wal syalelk'och nok' ukwanh wakax b'ak'ech chi', uke' ab'il sch'oxo'. Hanheja' uke' sjolom ixim trigo te wach' chi', hanhejtona' chi' syala'.
Ha pax ukwanh nok' wakax te b'ak, chuklaj yilji ix k'e'ul chi', hanheja' uke' ab'il pax sch'oxo'. Hanheja' ixim jolom trigo te pach'uch'tak, malaj jab'ok sat, uke' ab'il wejel syalelk'ochi.
Ha tas ix wal t'ayach tik, ichaton chi' syalelk'och ha wayich chi'. Ha Dios ix ak'an ha wayichej tas nab'ilxo yuj.
Ol ja uke' ab'il, te wach' ol aj sat awb'en t'a Egipto tik.

Ol lajwok chi', ol ja uke' ab'il wejel. Ayik chi' manhxa mach ol na'ankot jantak sat awb'en ix yak' sobre t'a Egipto tik ayik yek'nak uke' t'a yalanhtaxo, yujto ha wejel chi' ol ixtankanb'at jun chonhab' tik.
Te niwan wejel ol yutej sb'a. Manhxalaj b'aj ol cheklaj jab'okxo tas ix yak' sobre t'a jun pekti' wach' ix ek' chi'.
Cha'el wal ix aj yoch ha wayich chi' yik wach' snachajel uj sik'lab'il to nab'ilxo yuj Dios to ol elk'och t'a elanhchamel.
Yuj chi, wach' tato tza say junok winak te jelan, te ay spensar. Tzak'anoch winh yajalil t'a yol nación tik.

Tza sayanpax jaywanhokxo heb' winh ol och yajalil, sb'at heb' winh t'a masanil yol nación yik tz'ek' heb' winh smol chab' almul t'a junjun quintal awb'en tz'el t'a sat lu'um chi' t'a junjun ab'il, masanto slajwi uke' ab'il ol ste ak'ej sat awb'en chi'.
Masanil jantak syak' sobre smolb'an heb' winh chi', syak'kan heb' winh t'a yol ha k'ab', sik'chajkanb'at t'a junjun chonhab' t'a yol yik Egipto tik, yik wach' ay tas swa heb' anima.
Masanil tas ol sik'chajkanb'at chi', ha' ol swa heb' anima ayik ol ja uke' ab'il wejel chi', yik wach' max ixtaxel jun chonhab' tik yuj wejel, xchi winhaj José chi'.
Ha jun ix yal winhaj José chi', ix scha sk'o'ol winh rey yet' masanil heb' ayoch yajalil yet'ok.
Ix yalan winh rey chi' t'a heb' icha tik: --Ma chekel tato ay b'aj ol chax junokxo winak ku'uj to ayoch Yespíritu Dios yet'ok icha wal jun winh tik, xchi winh rey chi'.
Ix yalan winh t'a winhaj José chi' icha tik: --Malaj mach jelan, malaj mach ay spensar icha hach tik, yujto ha Dios tz'ak'an ojtakejel masanil juntzanh tik.
Ha hach ol hach ochkan yajalil t'a hin despacho tik. Masanil anima ol k'anab'ajan tas ol ala'. Ha hinxonhej niwan welk'och t'a ichanh, yujto rey hin.
Ha hin tzach wak'och gobernadoral t'a masanil yol yik Egipto tik, xchi winh.

Ayik ix yalan jun lolonel chi' winh, ix yik'anel skolk'ab' winh ayoch t'a sk'ab' b'aj ayoch sello, ix yak'anoch winh t'a sk'ab' winhaj José chi'. Ix schekan winh rey chi' ak'ji'och spichul winhaj José chi' to ha lino te wach'. Tz'ak'ji'och junok cadena nab'a oro t'a sjaj winh.

Ix chekchajk'e winh t'a yol carruaje, haton jun schab'il yik winh rey chi', ix schekan winh to schekji'el heb' anima t'a yol b'e ayik tz'ek' winhaj José chi'. Icha chi' ix aj yochkan winhaj José chi' gobernadoral yet' yilumalok masanil chonhab' Egipto chi'.
Ixlajwi chi' ix yalan winh rey t'a winhaj José chi' icha tik: --Ha hin tik rey hin, palta malaj junok mach syal yalan t'a yol chonhab' tik, tato manhok hach tzala', xchi winh.

Zafnat-pane'a ix yak' winh rey sb'i'ej winhaj José chi', ix yak'an winh rey chi' yik'laj sb'a winh yet' ix Asenat, yisil jun winh Potifera sb'i, sacerdote yaj winh t'a yol chonhab' On. 30 ab'il sk'inal winhaj José chi' ayik ix ik'jib'at winh t'a yichanh winh rey chi'. Ixlajwi chi', ix elta winhaj José chi' t'a yichanh winh rey chi', ix b'at winh t'a yol masanil chonhab' t'a yol yik Egipto chi'.
Ha t'a uke' ab'il, manh jantakok sat masanil awb'en ix yak'a'.
Masanil ixim trigo ix yak' sobre t'a uke' ab'il chi', ix sik'chajb'at ixim t'a junjun chonhab' yuj winhaj José chi'.
Icha yarena'il sti' ha' mar, icha wal chi' yilji ixim trigo ix molchaj yuj winh. Te niwanxo ixim trigo chi', yuj chi' majxo echtajlaj ixim, maxtzak yal-laj sb'ischaji.
Ayik manto el yich jun niwan wejel chi', chawanhxo yuninal winhaj José yet' ix Asenat chi'.

Ha winh b'ab'el unin, Manasés ix yak' winh sb'i'ej, ix yalan winh: Ha Dios ix ak'an sat t'a hin k'o'ol masanil syahelal ix ek'b'at t'a wib'anh yet' hin kusk'olal yuj heb' ayto wu'uj hin b'a yet'ok, xchi winh.
Haxo jun winh schab'il unin, Efraín ix yak' winh sb'i'ej, ix yalan winh: Ha Dios ix ak'an swach'k'olal t'ayin t'a jun lugar b'aj ix wab' syahelal tik, xchi winh.
Ixlajwi yek' uke' ab'il ayik manh jantakok swach'il ix aj sat awb'en t'a Egipto,
ix scha'anel yich uke' ab'il wejel chi', icha ix aj yalan winhaj José. Ix japax niwan wejel t'a yol masanil nación t'a slak'anil chi'. Haxo t'a masanil yol smakb'en Egipto ay tas swa heb' anima.

Haxo yik ix em wejel chi', tzijtum heb' aj Egipto chi' sk'och t'a winh rey k'anb'oj trigo. Syalan winh rey chi' t'a heb': Ixikek t'a winhaj José. Masanil tas syal winh ha tze k'anab'ajej, xchi winh t'a heb'.
Masanil yol yik Egipto chi' ayem wejel, yuj chi' ix jakwi masanil yet'tal b'aj sik'an ixim trigo yuj winhaj José chi', ix chonhji ixim t'a heb' aj Egipto chi'.
Masanil juntzanhxo nación ix ja manoj trigo t'a winh yujto masanil b'aj ay wejel, manhxalaj tas swa heb' anima.
Ha winhaj Jacob kajan winh t'a Canaán, ix yab' spekal winh to te ay ixim trigo t'a Egipto. Yuj chi' ix yal winh t'a heb' winh yuninal icha tik: ¿Tas tze k'ulej, tonhej tzeyil-lajoch he b'a?
Ix wab' spekal to te ay ixim trigo t'a Egipto. Ixikek he man tas sko wa yik wach' max honh cham yuj wejel, xchi winh.
Yuj chi', ix b'at lajunhwanh yuktak winhaj José manoj trigo t'a Egipto chi'.
Haxo winhaj Benjamín, yuktak winhaj José chi', maj chajib'atlaj winh yuj winhaj Jacob chi', yujto ix sna' winh: Ay talaj tas tz'ik'an winh wuninal tik, xchi winh.
Tzijtum juntzanhxo heb' winh manum trigo ix b'at yet' heb' winh yuninal winhaj Israel chi', yujto t'a masanil yol yik Canaán chi', ix te em wejel.

Ha winhaj José yajal yaj t'a yol yik Egipto chi', ha winh tz'ak'anelta ixim trigo t'a heb' manwajum sk'och chi'. Ayik ix k'och heb' yuktak winh chi' t'a yichanh, ix em nhojjab' heb' winh t'a sat lu'um.

T'a jun rato chi, ix yiloch heb' yuktak winhaj José chi', palta haxo ix yutej sb'a winh ichato manh yojtakok winh, ow ix yutej winh slolon t'a heb' winh: --¿B'ajtil ix hex kot ha hex tik? xchi winh. --Aj Canaán honh, to tzonh jawi manoj trigo, xchi heb' winh.
Wach'chom ha winhaj José chi' yojtak winh to yuktak sb'a winh yet' heb' winh, haxo pax heb' winh jun, maj nachajel-laj yuj heb' winh.

Ichato chi' ix sna'ankot winhaj José tas ix swayichej t'a yib'anh heb' winh t'a yalanhtaxo. Ix yalan winh: --Ha hex tik tonhej tzul honh heyileli, tonhej tzex jawi heyila' tato ay b'aj syal yochul heb' ajk'o'ol t'a yol jun chonhab' tik, xchi winh.
--Ma'ay mamin, ha honh ha chekab' honh tik, manoj trigonhej tzonh jawi.
Ha honh tik junnhej ko mam, kuktaknhej ko b'a, wach'nhej ko pensar, malaj b'aj tonhej tz'ek' kileli, xchi heb' winh.
--Wal yel ha hex tik tonhej tzex ja heyilb'ati ta sekojtak tz'ochul heb' ajk'o'ol t'a tik, xchi winh.

Ix tak'wi heb' winh icha tik: --Ma'ay mamin, ha honh ha chekab' honh tik, lajchawanh honh, kuktaknhej ko b'a, junnhej ko mam, kajan honh t'a Canaán. Ha winh kuktak tzak'an unin, aykan winh yet' winh ko mam chi', ay junxo winh, manhxo ayok ek'laj winh, xchi heb'.
--Wal yel swala', ha hex tik tonhej tzex ja heyileli tas yaj t'a tik.
Ol to yal sb'a tas ol aj jun tik: Tzin lok sb'i winh rey to manh ol hex aktajelok tato manh ol heyik'kot winh heyuktak tzak'an unin chi'.

Ha tikne'ik tzex b'at junok hex heyik' winh, ha hexxo tik ol hex kannhej preso t'a tik, yik wach' skila' tato yel tzeyala'. Tato tonhej tzeyala', toxo ix hin lok sb'i winh rey to tonhej tzul honh heyileli, xchi winhaj José chi.
Ix och heb' winh preso yuj winh. Hato t'a schab'ji'al chi' ix yalan winhaj José chi' t'a heb' winh icha tik: --Ha hin tik tzin xiw t'a Dios. Tato tze k'anab'ajej jun tas swal tik, tzex kolchajkani.
Tato yel wach' hex, junxonhej hex tzex kan t'a yol preso tik, tzex b'at he masanil t'a he chonhab' chi', tzeyik'anb'at ixim trigo swa heb' ix heyetb'eyum yet' heyuninal wan scham yuj wejel chi'.
Slajwi chi', tzeyik'ankot winh heyuktak tzak'an unin chi'. Ichato chi' ol wilani tato yel tzeyala', manh ol hex chamlaj, xchi winhaj José chi'. Ichokab' ta', xchi heb' winh.

Ix yalan heb' winh t'ay junjun icha tik: --Ha yuj tas kutejnak winh kuktak, yuj chi' sja jun yahelal tik t'a kib'anh. Wal yel te chuk kutejnak ko b'a t'a winh, manh ko chanakok kab'i ayik stewinak winh t'ayonh to tz'ok' ko k'o'ol t'a winh, wach'chom kilnak to te kusnak winh, xchi heb' winh.

Ix yalanpax winhaj Rubén t'a heb' winh yuktak chi' icha tik: --Walnak t'ayex to max heyutej he b'a t'a winh icha chi', palta manh he chanakok heyab'i tas walnak chi'. Ha tikne'ik, tik wal skot t'a kib'anh yuj schamel winh, xchi winh.
Maj nachajel yuj heb' winh tato wan yab'an winhaj José tas syal heb' winh chi', yujto t'a sti' heb' aj Egipto slolon winh, anhej to ay junok mach tz'alaneli tas syal winh.
Ix el winhaj José chi' t'a stz'ey heb' winh, ix och ijan winh yok'i. Ix jax winh, ix lolonxi winh yet' heb' winh. Ix yik'anel winhaj Simeón winh, t'a yichanh heb' winh ix tzek'chajkan winh.

Ixlajwi chi', ix yalan winhaj José chi' to tz'ak'ji b'ut'jok skoxtal heb' winh, ix ak'ji'em k'e'en stumin heb' winh t'a yol sti' skoxtal chi', ix ak'jib'at swa'el heb' winh yik yol sb'e. Icha chi' ix sk'ulej winh yet' heb' winh.
Ixlajwi chi', ix yak'anoch yikatz nok' sb'uru heb' winh, ix paxta heb' winh b'i'an.

Haxo ix k'och heb' winh b'aj ol wayok, ix sjakan skoxtal junok heb' winh yik syik'ank'eta chab'ok strigo nok' sb'uru winh chi' yalani. Haxo ix yilan winh to ayem k'e'en tumin t'a yol sti' skoxtal, k'e'en ix yak'lab'ej heb' winh smanan ixim strigo chi'.

Ix yalan winh t'a heb' winh yuktak chi' icha tik: --Ileknab'i, ix ak'jixi meltzaj k'e'en hin tumin. Ay wal em k'e'en t'a yol sti' hin koxtal tik, xchi winh. Masanil heb' winh ix ib'xik'e yuj xiwelal, ix yalan heb' winh icha tik: --¿Tas yuj icha tik tzonh yutej Dios? xchi heb' winh.
Haxo yik ix jax heb' winh t'a yol yik Canaán chi', ix yalan heb' winh t'a winh smam tastak ix ek' t'a yib'anh. Ix yalan heb' winh icha tik:
--Ha winh ayoch yajalil t'a jun chonhab' chi', te ow ix yutej winh slolon t'ayonh. Ix yalan winh to tonhej honh xit' kilelta tas yaj schonhab' chi'.
Ix kalani to wach' honh, manh chukok ko pensar tzonh ek'i, malaj b'aj tonhej tz'ek' kilel tas yaj heb'.
Ix kalani to lajchawanh ko b'eyi, junnhej ko mam, jun winh kuktak manhxo ayokek'laj, haxo winh tzak'an unin, aykan winh yet' winh ko mam t'a Canaán, xko chi t'a winh.
Ixlajwi chi', ix yalan winh icha tik: Tato yel wach' hex, kanokab' junok winh heyuktak t'a tik, tzeyik'anb'at jab'ok ixim trigo t'a heb' ix heyetb'eyum yet' t'a heyuninal wan scham yuj wejel chi'.

Slajwi chi', tzeyik'ankot junxo winh heyuktak tzak'an unin chi' wil t'a tik. Ichato chi' ol wojtakaneli to manh chukok he pensar syal chi'. Masanto sjawi junxo winh heyuktak tzak'an unin chi', ol hin jakanelta winh heyuktak ix kan t'a preso tik, yik icha chi' libre hex he b'eyek'i, xchi winh, xchi heb' winh.

Haxo ix sjakan skoxtal heb' winh chi', ix yilan heb' winh to ayem junjun yunetak mukuk tumin yol sti' koxtal chi', haton k'e'en tumin chi' ix yak'lab'ej heb' winh smanan ixim trigo. Ix ak'chajxi meltzaj k'e'en. Ix te xiw cha'anh heb' winh, ix te xiwpax winh smam heb' winh chi.

Ixlajwi chi' ix yalan winh t'a heb' winh icha tik: --Te chuk tzeyutej he b'a t'ayin. Manhxo junok wuninal skan heyu'uj. Winhaj José, manhxo ayokek'laj winh, winhaj Simeón, ix kan winh t'a preso, he gana tzeyik'paxb'at winhaj Benjamín. Ha mach tz'ab'an sya'il, ha hin toni, xchi winh.

Ix yalan winhaj Rubén t'a winh smam chi' icha tik: --Manh hach xiw mamin. Ak'b'at winh kuktak tzak'an unin tik ket'ok. Ha hin swak' hin b'a yuj winh, tato manhxo ol jax winh wu'uj, wach'chom tza mak'cham chawanh wuninal tik yuj winh, xchi winh.

Ix tak'wi winhaj Jacob chi' icha tik: --Manh ol b'atlaj winh wuninal tik heyet'ok, haxonhej winh ayek' wet'ok. Ina winh yuktak winh, chamnakxo winh, talaj ay tas tz'ik'anpax junxo winh tik t'a yol b'e, tik ha hex wal tzeyak'och he mul yik tzin cham yuj kuselal, xchi winhaj Jacob chi'.
Te ow yak'an wejel t'a yol schonhab' heb' winh.
Ix lajwi'el ixim trigo xit' yik' heb' winh chi' swa'an winhaj Jacob yet' yuninal, ix yalanxi winh t'a heb' winh icha tik: --Ixikekxi t'a Egipto, b'at manek jab'okxo tas sko wa'a, xchi winh.
Ix yalan winhaj Judá icha tik: --Te jichan ix yutej winh schonhan ixim trigo chi' yalani: Tato max heyik'kot winh heyuktak tzak'an unin chi', manhxo ol heyil hin sat t'a tik, xchi winh.
Yuj wal chi', tato sb'at winh kuktak tik ket'ok, tzonh b'at manoj trigo chi'.
Tato max ha chab'at winh ket' jun, manhxo ol honh b'atlaj, icha ix aj yalan winh chonhum trigo chi': Tato max heyik'kot winh heyuktak tzak'an unin chi', manhxo hex jawoklaj t'a wichanh, xchi winh.
Ix yalan winhaj Israel chi' icha tik: --¿Tas yuj ix heyal t'a jun winh chi' to ay junokxo heyuktak? Tzin heyak' wal och t'a ilk'olal, xchi winh.

Ix tak'wi heb' winh icha tik: --Ix sk'anb'ej winh tastak kaji, mach ayonh yinhtilal. Ix sk'anb'anpax winh tato ayto'ek' ko mam, tato aytopax kuktak. Yuj chi' ix kal t'a winh to ayto'ek' ko mam, aytopax junxo kuktak. ¿Tokwal kojtak tato ol yal winh to skik'b'at winh kuktak tik? xchi heb' winh.

Ix yalanxi winhaj Judá t'a winh smam chi': --Tato max yal ha k'o'ol tzonh cham yuj wejel ko masanil, chab'at winh kuktak tik ket'ok. Ha hin tzin tek'b'ej hin b'a hin tanhwan winh, tato icha chi', tik tzonh b'at t'a elanhchamel.
Ha hin tzin tek'b'ej hin b'a tato ay tas tz'ik'an winh, tato manhxo ol ja winh wu'uj, te chuk ol hin kan t'a ha sat.
Tato maj ek' ko tiempo t'a tik, toxo ix kak' cha'elok na'ik, xchi winh.

Ix tak'wi winh smam heb' winh chi' icha tik: --Tato manhxa tas wach' skutej, yik'okab' icha tzeyal chi', ixikek. Ik'ekb'at jab'ok he silab' t'a winh. Ha juntzanh tas wach' sk'ib' t'a tik, ha' tzeyik'b'ati: Haton bálsamo, nok' yalchab', perfume, mirra, te' nueces yet' te' almendras.
Ik'ekb'at he tumin yik tze manan ixim trigo chi', tzeyik'anxib'at k'e'en tumin ix yak' meltzaj heb' winh t'ayex t'a sti' he koxtal chi', tekan tonhej ix sat sk'o'ol heb' winh, yuj chi' ayem k'e'en.
Ik'ekb'at winh heyuktak tik, tzex b'atxi heyil winh yajal chi'.

Ha Dios Syal Yuj Smasanil, ha' ol och t'a spensar winh yik ol aktajel winh heyuktak aj Simeón. Wach' ol aj smeltzajkot winhaj Benjamín tik heyet'ok. Ha hinxo tik, tato tzin kan manh uninal, hin kanokab'i, ¿tasto wal ol wutej? xchi winh smam heb' winh chi'.

Ixlajwi chi', ix yak'anem silab' heb' winh chi' t'a yol skoxtal yet' k'e'en tumin. Ix yik'anb'at winhaj Benjamín heb' winh, ix b'atxi heb' winh t'a Egipto chi'. Haxo yik ix k'och heb' winh t'a yichanh winhaj José,

ix yilan winh to ajun winhaj Benjamín chi'. Ix yalan winh t'a winh yilumal spat icha tik: --Ik'b'at juntzanh heb' winh tik t'a hin pat, tzak'an miljokcham junok nok' wakax, yik sb'o junok wa'el, to ol wa heb' winh wet'ok t'a chimk'uhalil tik, xchi winhaj José chi'.
Ixlajwi chi', ix ik'jib'at heb' winh yuj winh ilum pat chi', ix sk'anab'ajan winh tas ix yal winhaj José chi'.

Ix te xiw cha'anh heb' winh yujto ix ik'chajb'at heb' winh t'a spat winh, ix yal-lan yab' heb' winh icha tik: --Chuk tas sna'a winh t'a kib'anh. Tekan yuj k'e'en tumin ix yak' meltzaj heb' winh t'ayonh, yuj chi' tzonh ik'chajkot t'a tik. Tekan ol honh yak'och winh schekab'ok yet' nok' ko chej tik, xchi heb' winh.
Yuj chi', ayik ix k'och heb' winh t'a spuerta'il pat chi', ix och te'an heb' winh t'a winh yilumal te' chi'.
Ix yalan heb' winh icha tik: --Mamin, ina ha honh tik, ix honh ulek' manoj trigo jun'el,

haxo yik ix honh meltzaji, ix honh way t'a yol b'e. Ayik ix ko jakan ko koxtal, ix kilani tz'akan yajem k'e'en tumin t'a sti' ko koxtal chi', haton k'e'en ix ko k'ana' ayik ix ko manan ixim ko trigo. Ix kik'anxi meltzaj k'e'en tumin chi' tikne'ik, tz'akan ol kutej kak'anxi k'e'en t'ayach.
Manh kojtakok mach ix ak'anem k'e'en t'a yol sti' ko koxtal chi'. Ch'ok ix kik'paxkot k'e'en stojol ixim ol ko man chi' tikne'ik, xchi heb' winh.

Ix yalan winh chi' icha tik: --Manh heyak' pensar yuj jun chi'. Manh hex xiwok. Ha sDiosal he mam yet' hex paxi, ha ix ak'anem k'e'en t'a sti' he koxtal chi'. Ha hin ix hin cha k'e'en tumin ix heyak' stojolok ixim he trigo ix heyik' chi', xchi winh t'a heb' winh. Ixlajwi chi', ix ik'ji'elta winhaj Simeón t'a yol preso yuj winh yilumal chi', ix elul winh b'aj ayek' heb' yuktak chi'.
Ix ik'chajb'at heb' winh smasanil yuj winh t'a spat winhaj José chi', ix yak'an ha ha' winh yik sb'ikel yok heb' winh, ix ak'jipax yanh schej heb' winh.
Ixlajwi chi', ix yik'ank'eta silab' heb' winh t'a yol skoxtal ol yak' t'a winhaj José ayik ol k'och winh t'a chimk'uhalil chi', yujto yojtakxo heb' winh to ol wa heb' winh yet' winh.
Haxo ix k'och winhaj José chi', ix yak'an silab' heb' winh chi' t'a winh, ix em nhojjab' heb' winh t'a sat lum t'a yichanh winh.

Ixlajwi chi' ix sk'anb'an winh t'a heb' winh tato wach'nhej sk'o'ol heb' winh, ix yalan winh: --¿Janik' sk'o'ol winh he mam, winh te ichamxo ix heyal t'ayin? ¿Pitzan tom winh? xchi winh t'a heb' winh.
Ix em nhojan heb' winh, ix yalan heb' winh: --Ha winh ko mam chi', ayto'ek' winh, wach'to sk'o'ol winh, xchi heb' winh.

Haxo ix yilanoch winhaj Benjamín winh, haton winh junnhej snun winh yet'ok, ix yalan winh: --¿Ha am winh heyuktak tzak'an unin ix heyal tik t'ayin? xchi winh. --Haton winh, xchi heb' winh. --Yak'okab' swach'k'olal Dios t'a ib'anh, xchi winh t'a winhaj Benjamín chi'.

Ixlajwi yalan jun chi' winh, ix te sat wal sk'o'ol winh yilan winh yuktak chi'. Ix och pitz'an t'a spixan winh, ijan wal ix ok' winh. Elanhchamel ix b'at lemnaj winh t'a yol scuarto yik sb'at ok' ta'.
Haxo yik ix ek'b'at skusk'olal winh chi', ix sb'ikanel sat winh, ix elta winh, ix yalan winh t'a heb' schekab': Ik'ekelta ko wa'el chi' china'ik, xchi winh.

Jun smexa winhaj José chi' sch'okojil. Ch'ok junxo mexa b'aj ix och heb' winh yuktak winh chi', ch'ok pax junxo mexa b'aj swa heb' winh aj Egipto chi', haton heb' swataxon yet' winhaj José chi', yujto ha heb' winh aj Egipto chi' ay yowalil tato junnhej swa heb' winh yet' heb' winh hebreo chi'.

Ha heb' winh yuktak winhaj José chi', t'a stzolal ix aj yak'ji'em k'ojan heb' winh yuj winh schekab' winhaj José chi', hato syala' jantak sk'inal junjun heb' winh, yujto icha chi' ix aj yalan winhaj José chi'. Winh b'ab'el masanto winh tzak'an unin. Toxonhej ste sat sk'o'ol heb' winh yil-lanoch sb'a.

Ha wa'el ay t'a smexa winhaj José chi', ha' ix ak'ji t'a heb' winh. Haxo pax t'a winhaj Benjamín chi', oye'to makan ek'b'al yik winh ix ak'ji t'a yichanh yik juntzanhxo heb' winh chi'. Ichato chi' ix wa heb' winh, ix yuk'an wino heb' winh t'a tzalajk'olal.

Ixlajwi chi', ix yalan winhaj José t'a winh yilumal spat: --Ak' b'ut'jok skoxtal heb' winh tik t'a ixim trigo, yalnhej jantak syal yik'anb'at heb' winh. Tzak'anpaxem k'e'en tumin t'a yol sti' skoxtal junjun heb' winh, haton k'e'en b'aj sman ixim trigo chi' heb' winh.
Tzak'anpaxem k'e'en hin kopa plata yet' k'e'en tumin t'a yol sti' skoxtal winh tzak'an unin, xchi winh. Ix sk'anab'ajan winh tas ix yal winhaj José chi'.
Ayik ix ja kopnaj yok k'u t'a k'inhib'alil, ix chaji meltzaj heb' winh yet' nok' schej t'a schonhab'.

Kenanto wal sb'at heb' winh, ix yalan winhaj José t'a winh yilumal spat chi' icha tik: --Ixik tzak'an yuj heb' winh chi'. Ayik syamchaj heb' winh hu'uj, tzalani: ¿Tas yuj ha swach'k'olal winh hin patrón, chukxo tzeyutej he paktzitankani? ¿Tas yuj ix heyelk'ejkot skopa winh, haton jun nab'a plata,
jun skopa winh b'aj syuk' swino, sk'ananpax winh yik sna'anel junok lolonel? Te chuk ix heyutej he b'a ha hex tik, xa chi t'a heb' winh, xchi winhaj José chi'.
Ix b'at winh yilumal spat winhaj José chi' b'i'an. Haxo yik ix yamchaj heb' winh yuj winh, ix yalan winh t'a heb' winh icha ix aj yalan winhaj José chi'.
Ix tak'wi heb' winh t'a winh: --Mamin, ¿tas yuj icha chi' tzutej halan t'ayonh? ¿Tom malaj ko pensar, yuj chi' ol kelk'ejkot junok tasi?
Ina hato t'a Canaán kajan honh. T'a sb'ab'el, ha k'e'en tumin ix cheklaj t'a sti' ko koxtal, ix kik'xikot k'e'en. ¿Tom hato wal junok plata ma oro yik winh ha patrón chi' ol kelk'ejkot t'a spat?
Ha junok honh b'aj scheklajelta k'e'en kopa chi' t'a yol skoxtal, wach' tato smiljichamok, ha honhxo ko masanil, tzonh ochkan ha chekab'ok, xchi heb' winh.
Ix tak'wi winh icha tik: --Yik'okab' icha tzeyal chi', palta anhej winh b'aj ol ilchajelta jun kopa chi' wu'uj, ha winh chi' ol ochkan hin chekab'ok. Ha hexxo tik, he masanil libre hex, xchi winh.
T'a elanhchamel ix yak'em skoxtal heb' winh chi' smasanil, ix stijan sti' heb' winh.

Ix sayan yil masanil yoltak koxtal chi' winh. T'a stzolal ix say yil winh, ix sb'ab'laj sayej yil yik winh b'ab'el winak winh masanto t'a winh tzak'an unin. Haxo t'a yol yik winh tzak'an unin chi' ix k'eta k'e'en kopa chi', haton winhaj Benjamín.
Ix och ijan heb' winh snhik'chitan spichul yuj skusk'olal. Ix yak'anxi'och yikatz nok' sb'uru heb' winh chi', ix meltzajxi heb' winh t'a spatik.
Ayto ek' winhaj José chi' t'a spat, ix k'och winhaj Judá yet' heb' yuktak chi', ix em nhojan heb' winh t'a sat lu'um t'a yichanh winh.
Ix yalan winh t'a heb' winh icha tik: --¿Tas yuj icha chi' tzeyutej he b'a? ¿Tom manh heyojtakok to ha junok winak ay yopisio icha hin tik, syal snachajel junok tas yuj? xchi winh.

Ix tak'wi winhaj Judá icha tik: --Mamin, ¿tasto wal ol aj ko tak'wi t'ayach? ¿Tasto ol kutok kilanoch ko b'a tato wach' honh kalani? Ay ko mul t'a yichanh ko Mam Dios, tik ayonh ek' t'a ichanh. Syal tzonh och ha chekab'ok yet' winh b'aj ix ilchajelta k'e'en kopa chi', xchi winh.

Ix yalanxi winhaj José chi' icha tik: --Ma'ay, anhej winh b'aj ix ilchajelta k'e'en hin kopa chi', anhej winh skan hin chekab'ok. Ha hexxo tik, meltzajanhek t'a junk'olal b'aj ay winh he mam, xchi winh.

Ix snitz wal b'at sb'a winhaj Judá t'a stz'ey winhaj José chi', ix yalan winh: --Mamin, tzok el wal t'a ha k'o'ol swalan t'ayach tas hin pensar. Tzin tewi t'ayach, mokab' kot owal t'ayin, wach'chom icha hach winh rey.
Ha hach wal ix ha k'anb'ej t'ayonh tato ayto'ek' winh ko mam ha honh tik, tato aytopax junokxo kuktak.

Yuj chi', ix kalan t'ayach to ayto'ek' winh ko mam, anhejto te icham winakxo winh. Ha junxo winh kuktak tzak'an unin, t'a yicham winakilxo winh ko mam chi' ix alji winh. Haxo junxo winh junnhej snun winh yet'ok, chamnakxo winh, yuj chi' te xajan winh yuj winh ko mam chi', yujto haxonhej winh.
Ha hach ix ala' to skik'kot winh, yik tzojtakejel winh.
Ix kalan t'ayach to max yal sk'o'ol winh ko mam chi' tz'elta winh t'a stz'ey, yujto ijanxo scham winh yuj kusk'olal yalani tato tz'el winh t'a stz'ey winh.
Palta ix alpax t'ayonh tato max kik'kot winh, maxtzak yal ko jax t'a ichanh halani.
Ayik ix honh k'och t'a ko pat chi', ix kalan t'a winh ko mam chi' tas ix aj halan t'ayonh.
Haxo winh ix halan t'ayonh to tzonh kotxi manoj trigo.
Ix kalan t'a winh icha tik: Max honh b'atlaj tato max kik'b'at winh kuktak tzak'an unin tik, yujto tato max b'at winh ket'ok, maxtzak yal-laj ko k'och t'a yichanh winh yajal chi', xko chi.
Ix yalan winh ko mam chi' t'ayonh: Heyojtak to chawannhej wuninal ix wil yet' ix wetb'eyum chamnak.
Jun winh jun'elnhej b'atnakkani, manhxa b'aj ix wil sat winh, ay am wal junok nok' nok' chi'um anima chi'annakb'at winh.
Tato tzeyik'xib'at junxo winh tik, tato ay pax tas tz'ik'an winh, heyu'uj am wal tzin cham yuj kusk'olal, xchi winh t'ayonh.
Yuj chi', icha wal to sk'inal winh ko mam chi' yajoch winh wuktak tik. Tato manhxo ol meltzaj winh ket'ok
ol cham winh ko mam yuj kusk'olal, ha honh tik tz'och ko mul.
Ha hin ix hin tek'b'ej hin b'a yuj winh t'a winh hin mam chi', ix walani: Tato manhxo ol jax winh wu'uj, te chuk tzin kan t'a yol ha sat t'a jun'elnhej, xin chi t'a winh hin mam chi'.
Yuj wal chi' tzin tewi t'ayach, tato syala', ha hin tzin kan sk'exulok winh wuktak tik ha chekab'ok. Yuj chi' tzaktejel winh, spax winh yet' heb' winh wuktak tik.
Tato ma'ay jun, ¿tasto wal ol aj hin b'at wil winh hin mam chi', tato manhok jun winh wet'ok? Manh jab'ok syal hin k'o'ol swil skusk'olal winh hin mam tato icha chi' tzuji, xchi winhaj Judá chi'.

Majxo techaj yuj winhaj José chi', ijanxo tz'ok'k'e winh t'a yichanh masanil heb' winh smunlajwum, yuj chi' te cha'anh ix yal winh: Elanhek t'a tik, xchi winh. Yuj chi' manhxo junok heb' winh munlajwum chi' ix kan ta, ix yalan winh t'a heb' winh yuktak chi' to yuktak sb'a winh yet' heb' winh.
Ichato chi', ix ok'wal winh sik'lab'il. Masanil heb' winh aj Egipto ix ab'ani. Ix k'och spekal jun chi' t'a spalacio winh rey.

Ix yalan winhaj José chi' t'a heb' winh yuktak chi' icha tik: --Ha hin ton tik José hin, kuktak ko b'a. ¿Yel am wal to pitzanto winh ko mam chi'? xchi winh. Ix te xiw cha'anh heb' yuktak winh chi' t'a yichanh. Majxo yal-laj slolon heb' winh yuj xiwelal.

Ix yalan winhaj José chi: --Swal t'ayex tikne'ik, nitzekkot he b'a t'a hin tz'ey tik, xchi winh. Haxo yik ix snitzanb'at sb'a heb' winh, ix yalan winh t'a heb' winh icha tik: --Ha hin ton José hin, wuktak hin b'a heyet'ok. Ha hin ton tik he chonhnak hin kot t'a heb' winh ismaelita chonhwajum t'a Egipto tik.

Palta mokab' chab'ax he k'o'ol, mokab' kot heyowal t'ayex junjun hex yuj b'aj hin he chonhnakkot chi'. Spensar Dios yaj jun chi' yik tzin b'ab'lajkot t'a heyichanh, yik tzijtum anima skolchaji, yuj chi' icha chi' ix aji.
Schab'ilto ab'il yel yich wejel t'a yol yib'anhk'inal tik. Oye'to ab'il ol yak'a', manh ol yak' sat awal inhat, wach'chom ay mach ol awanok, palta malaj jab'ok sat ol yak'a'.
B'ab'el ix hin chekjikot yuj Dios yik ol hex hin kolkan t'a jun niwan wejel tik, yik wach' max satel heyinhtilal t'a yol yib'anhk'inal tik.

Yuj chi' ha Dios chekannak hin kot t'a jun lugar tik, manhokexlaj heyak'nak hin koti. Ha Dios ix hin ak'anochi yik swak' sna'a winh rey, yik tzin ochpax yajalil t'a masanil tas ay t'a spat winh yet' t'a masanil yol yik Egipto tik.

Ha tikne'ik pilek heyip, ixik alek t'a winh ko mam chi' icha tik: Icha tik ix aj yalan winhaj José uninal: Ha Dios ix hin ak'anoch yajalil t'a yol yik Egipto tik, yuj chi' kotanh t'a elanhchamel, yik tzul hin ilan t'a tik.
Ha t'a lum Gosén ol hach kajnajok yik wach' t'a hin lak'anil ol hach aj yet' masanil heb' uninal, heb' i'achikin yet' nok' ha molb'etzal nok' yet' masanil tastak ay t'ayach.

Ol wak'an ha wa'el yet' masanil heb' winh wuktak yet' masanil heb' ayek' het'ok, yujto oye'to ab'il ol yak' jun wejel tik. Yuj chi' manh ol hach och meb'a'il yet' masanil heb' ayek' het'ok, xchi winh, xe chi t'a winh ko mam chi'.
Testigo yaj winh wuktak aj Benjamín tik yet' hex pax tik, to ha hin wal swal jun lolonel tik.

Alek t'a winh ko mam chi' to ha hin tik te niwan welk'och t'a yol yik Egipto tik. Tzeyalan t'a winh yuj masanil tastak ix heyil t'a tik. Yuj chi' ixikek heyik'kot winh ko mam chi' t'a elanhchamel, xchi winhaj José chi'.
Ixlajwi chi', ix b'at lak'naj winhaj José chi' t'a winhaj Benjamín chi', ix och ijan winh yok'i. Hanhejtona' ix ok'pax winhaj Benjamín chi'.

Ixlajwi chi', ix stz'ub'anelta sti' heb' winh yuktak winh chi' smasanil. Ayik lak'lak' och winh t'a heb' winh, ix och ijan winh yok'i. Ixlajwi juntzanh chi', ix stek'b'an sb'a heb' winh slolon yet' winh.

Ix k'och spekal t'a spalacio winh rey to yuktak sb'a winhaj José yet' heb' winh ix k'och chi'. Ix te tzalaj winh rey chi' yet' masanil heb' ayoch t'a yopisio yet' winh t'a spalacio chi' ayik ix yab'an heb'.
Ix yalan winh rey t'a winhaj José chi' icha tik: --Al t'a heb' winh uktak chi', yak'okab'och yikatz nok' schej heb' winh yik smeltzaj heb' winh t'a Canaán chi'.
Syik'ankot yetb'eyum heb' winh yet' heb' yuninal yet' winh ha mam chi' t'ayin. Ha lum lum te wach' t'a Egipto tik ol wak' t'a winh.
Al t'a heb' winh to syik'b'at carreta heb' winh t'a tik, yik wach' syik'kot yetb'eyum heb' winh yet' heb' yuninal yet' winh ha mam chi'.
Mokab' yak' pensar heb' winh yuj tastak ay tikne'ik, yujto ha tas wach' ay t'a Egipto tik, ha' ol wak' t'a heb' winh, xchi winh rey chi'.
Icha chi' ix yutej heb' winh yuninal winhaj Israel chi'. Haxo winhaj José chi' ix ak'an carreta chi' t'a heb' winh yet' tastak swa heb' t'a yol b'e icha ix yutej winh rey yalani.
Ix ak'jipax pichul ak'to t'a heb' winh yik tz'och sk'ex k'apakok heb' winh. Haxo t'a winhaj Benjamín, 300 siclo plata ix ak'ji, ix ak'jipax oye' mojanh spichul winh.

Ix yak'anb'at lajunhwanh nok' b'uru winhaj José chi' t'a winh smam. Te al ix ajb'at nok' yuj masanil tas wach' ay t'a Egipto chi'. Ix b'atpax lajunhwanhxo nok' nun b'uru ix ik'anb'at ixim trigo yet' ixim pan yik swa winh t'a yol b'e yik skoti.
Ayik ix stak'anb'at heb' yuktak winhaj José chi', ix yalan winh: --Mokab' heyak' owal t'a yoltak b'e, xchi winh.
Ix el heb' winh t'a Egipto chi', ix k'och heb' winh t'a Canaán b'aj ay winh smam chi'.
Haxo ix yalan heb' winh t'a winh smam chi' to pitzanto winhaj José, to ayoch winh schab'il yajalil t'a Egipto. Ix te sat sk'o'ol winh yab'ani, maj schalaj winh tas ix yal heb' winh.
Palta ichato ix pitzwixi winh ayik ix yab'an masanil tas ix yalkot winhaj José chi', ix yilanpaxoch jantak carreta ix yak'kot winh yik tz'ik'jib'at winh.
Ichato chi' ix yalan winh: k'okb'ilnhej ix wab'i to pitzanto winh wuninal chi'. Ol b'at wil winh yakb'an manto hin chami, xchi winh.
Ixlajwi chi', ix b'at winhaj Jacob yet' masanil heb' yiko' yet' masanil tastak ay t'ay. Ayik ix k'och winh t'a Beerseba, ix snhusan silab' winh t'a sDiosal, haton sDiosal winh smam winh.
Ha t'a jun ak'wal chi', ix lolon Dios t'a winh t'a swayich, ix awtaj winh yuj: --Jacob, xchi. Ix tak'wi winh: --Oy, ina wajek' tik Mamin, xchi winh.
Ix yalan Dios t'a winh icha tik: --Ha hin ton ha Diosal hin yet' winh ha mam, manh hach xiw ha b'at t'a Egipto chi'. Yakb'an ayex ek' ta' ol hin b'o jun niwan chonhab' t'a inhtilal.

Ol hin b'atnhej het'ok t'a Egipto chi', haxo yik ol k'och stiempo'al, ol hin ochnhej yet' heb' inhtilal ayik ol meltzajxikot heb' t'a jun lugar tik. Haxo yik ol hach chamok, ha winh uninal aj José chi', ayek' winh t'a ha tz'ey, xchi Dios t'a winh.

Ixlajwi chi', ix ak'jik'e winh yuj heb' winh yuninal t'a yol carreta ix yak'kot winh sreyal Egipto chi'. Ix yak'anpaxk'e heb' unin yet' heb' ix yetb'eyum heb' winh. Ichato chi' ix el heb' winh t'a Beerseba chi'.
Ix kot heb' winh t'a Egipto, ix yik'ankot nok' skalnel heb' winh yet' nok' swakax yet' masanil tastak ix yik' heb' winh t'a Canaán chi'.
Ix yik'ankot masanil heb' winh yuninal winhaj Jacob chi' yet' heb' ix yisil yet' heb' yixchikin.

Ha heb' yinhtilal winh yet' ix Lea ix kot yet'ok t'a Egipto, 33 heb' t'a smasanil, ayoch heb' winak yet' heb' ix ix sb'isulok. Ha heb' yuninal winh yet' ix, haton heb' tik: Winhaj Rubén, haton winh b'ab'el unin, winhaj Simeón, winhaj Leví, winhaj Judá, winhaj Isacar, winhaj Zabulón yet' ix Dina. Ha heb' tik ix alji ayik ayek' winh t'a Padán-aram. Ha heb' yuninal winhaj Rubén: Haton winhaj Hanoc, winhaj Falú, winhaj Hezrón yet' winhaj Carmi. Ha heb' yuninal winhaj Simeón: Haton winhaj Jemuel, winhaj Jamín, winhaj Ohad, winhaj Jaquín, winhaj Zohar yet' winhaj Saúl, winh yune' jun ix aj Canaán. Ha heb' yuninal winhaj Leví: Haton winhaj Gersón, winhaj Coat yet' winhaj Merari. Ha heb' winh yuninal winhaj Judá: Haton winhaj Er, winhaj Onán, winhaj Sela, winhaj Fares yet' winhaj Zara. (Ha winhaj Er yet' winhaj Onán chi', chamnakxo heb' winh t'a Canaán). Ha heb' yuninal winhaj Fares chi', haton winhaj Hezrón yet' winhaj Hamul. Ha heb' yuninal winhaj Isacar: Haton winhaj Tola, winhaj Fúa, winhaj Job yet' winhaj Simrón. Ha heb' yuninal winhaj Zabulón: Haton winhaj Sered, winhaj Elón yet' winhaj Jahleel.

Ha heb' yinhtilal winhaj Jacob chi' yet' ix Zilpa, 16 heb' t'a smasanil. Ha ix Zilpa chi', haton ix scriada ix Lea ix ak'ji yuj winh sman, haton winhaj Labán. Ha heb' yuninal winh yet' ix, haton heb' tik: Winhaj Gad yet' winhaj Aser. Ha heb' yuninal winhaj Gad: Haton winhaj Zifión, winhaj Hagui, winhaj Ezbón, winhaj Suni, winhaj Eri, winhaj Arodi yet' winhaj Areli. Ha heb' yuninal winhaj Aser: Haton winhaj Imna, winhaj Isúa, winhaj Isúi, winhaj Bería yet' ix yanab' heb' winh skuchan Sera. Ha heb' yuninal winhaj Bería chi', haton winhaj Heber yet' winhaj Malquiel.

Ha heb' yinhtilal winhaj Jacob chi' yet' ix Raquel, 14 heb' t'a smasanil. Ha heb' yuninal winh yet' ix: Haton winhaj José yet' winhaj Benjamín. Ha heb' yuninal winhaj José chi' yet' ix Asenat yisil winhaj Potifera sacerdote t'a chonhab' On: Haton winhaj Manasés yet' winhaj Efraín, haton heb' ix alji t'a Egipto. Ha heb' yuninal winhaj Benjamín chi': Haton winhaj Bela, winhaj Bequer, winhaj Asbel, winhaj Gera, winhaj Naamán, winhaj Ehi, winhaj Ros, winhaj Mupim, winhaj Hupim yet' winhaj Ard.

Ha heb' yinhtilal winhaj Jacob chi' yet' ix Bilha, ukwanh heb'. Ha ix Bilha chi', haton ix scriada ix Raquel ix ak'ji yuj winhaj Labán. Ha heb' yuninal winh yet' ix, haton heb' tik: Winhaj Dan yet' winhaj Neftalí. Ha yuninal winhaj Dan chi', anhej winhaj Husim. Ha heb' yuninal winhaj Neftalí chi': Haton winhaj Jahzeel, winhaj Guni, winhaj Jezer yet' winhaj Silem.
66 heb' yinhtilal winhaj Jacob chi' t'a smasanil, haton heb' tik ajun yet' winh ayik ix k'och winh t'a Egipto. Haton wal heb' tik yinhtilal winh, ch'ok pax heb' ix alib'al.
Ch'ok pax yaj winhaj José yet' chawanh heb' yuninal ix alji t'a Egipto chi', yuj chi' 70 sb'isul winhaj Jacob chi' yet' heb' yinhtilal ayik ayxo'ek' winh ta'.
Ix b'ab'lajb'at winhaj Judá yuj winhaj Jacob chi', yik sb'at winh yal yab' winhaj José chi' to skot winh chawal t'a yol yik Gosén. Haxo yik ix k'och heb' t'a Gosén chi',

ix schekan winhaj José chi' ak'chaj lista scarruaje yik b'at scha'an winh smam winh t'a Gosén chi'. Ayik ix k'och winh t'a yichanh winh smam chi', ix och lak'naj winh t'a winh. Te junip ix em nhojan winh yok' t'a sjolom sjenhjab' winh smam chi'.
Haxo ix yalan winh smam winh chi' icha tik: --Ha tikne'ik, tik wal ix wilxi'och ha sat, tik wal pitzan hachto, junk'olalxo ol hin cham tikne'ik, xchi winh.

Ixlajwi chi', ix yalan winhaj José chi' t'a heb' winh yuktak yet' t'a masanil heb' ayek' yet' winh smam winh chi': --Tik tzin b'at wal t'a winh rey: Masanil heb' winh wuktak yet' masanil heb' yinhtilal winh hin mam ay t'a Canaán, toxo ix ja heb' wet'ok.
Yet'nak masanil nok' skalnel heb', nok' swakax yet' masanil tas ay t'a heb', yujto ha smunlajel heb' haton moloj kalnel yet' moloj wakax, xin chama.
Yuj chi', ayik ol hex awtajb'at yuj winh rey chi', ol sk'anb'an winh t'ayex tas b'aj tzex munlaji,

tzeyalani to moloj kalnel yet' moloj wakax tze k'ulej. Anhej nok' kalnel ko molb'etz yaji yiktax honh kotoch uninal icha wal heb' ko mam kicham, xe chi. Yuj chi' ol hex kan t'a lum Gosén tik, yujto ha heb' winh aj Egipto tik ay yowalil tato junnhej tz'aj heb' winh yet' heb' winh molum kalnel, xchi winhaj José chi'.

Ixlajwi chi', ix b'at winhaj José yal t'a winh rey chi' icha tik: Ha winh hin mam yet' heb' winh wuktak toxo ix jawi heb' winh t'a Gosén. Ix kot heb' winh t'a Canaán, yet'nak nok' skalnel heb' yet' nok' swakax yet' masanil tas ay t'a heb', xchi winh.
Sik'b'ilxo'el owanh heb' winh yuktak winh chi' yuj yik sb'at heb' winh t'a yichanh winh rey chi' yik tz'ojtakajel heb' winh yuj winh.
Ix sk'anb'an winh rey chi' t'a heb' winh icha tik: --¿Tas munlajelal syal heyu'uj? xchi winh. Ix yalan heb' winh: --Mamin, ha honh ha chekab' honh tik, molum kalnel honh icha heb' ko mam kicham.

Ix honh ja t'a jun lugar tik yujto ha t'a Canaán b'aj kajan honh te ay wejel, manhxa b'aj wach' swa nok' ko kalnel, yuj chi' tzonh tewi t'ayach, komonok scha ha k'o'ol tzonh kajnaj t'a lum Gosén, xchi heb' winh.
Ixlajwi chi', ix yalan winh rey chi' t'a winhaj José: --Yakb'an ix ja winh ha mam yet' heb' winh uktak het'ok,

wach' tz'ajkan heb' winh t'a tik. Ak' lum Gosén chi' t'a heb' winh. Ha wal lu'um chi' te wach' t'a yol yik Egipto tik, syal skajnaj heb' winh ta'. Tato ay heb' winh uktak chi' te jelan t'a iloj nok' chi', syal tzak'och heb' winh yilumalok nok' hin molb'etzal nok', xchi winh rey chi'.
Ix yik'anpaxb'at winh smam winhaj José t'a yichanh winh rey chi', yik wach' tz'ojtakajel winh yuj winh. Ichato chi' ix yak'an stzatzil sk'o'ol winh rey chi' winhaj Jacob chi'.
Ix sk'anb'an winh rey chi' t'a winh: --¿Jayexo ab'il ha k 'inal? xchi winh.

Ix tak'wi winhaj Jacob chi' icha tik: --Kenanto hin k 'inal, anhejanto 130 ab'il, tonhej tzin b'eyek'i, palta t'a yatakil ix aj yek'b'at janik' tiempo'al tik wu'uj. Manto k'ochlaj hin k 'inal icha wal ix aj yab'ilal heb' hin mam wicham, xchi winh.
Ixlajwi chi', ix yalan wach' lolonel winh t'a yib'anh winh rey chi', ix elixta winh t'a yol sdespacho winh.
Ichato chi', ix yak'an lum lum te wach' winhaj José t'a winh smam yet' t'a heb' yuktak t'a yol yik Egipto chi', haton lum ay t'a slak'anil chonhab' Ramesés, icha ix yutej winh rey chi' yalani.
Aynhejoch winhaj José chi' yak'an swa'el heb', hato syala' jantak sb'isul junjun heb'.
Ix te em wejel t'a masanil yol yik Egipto chi' yet' t'a yol yik Canaán, manhxalaj ixim trigo, junlajanxonhej wan scham heb' anima yuj wejel.
Masanil k'e'en stumin heb' aj Egipto yet' heb' aj Canaán chi', ix b'at yak'kan heb' yuj ixim trigo. Masanil k'e'en ix sik'b'at winhaj José t'a yol sdespacho winh rey.

Haxo yik ix lajwi'el k'e'en tumin t'a Egipto yet' t'a Canaán chi', ix b'at yalan heb' winh aj Egipto chi' t'a winhaj José icha tik: --Ha tikne'ik mamin, na'a tas tzonh aji. Toxo ix lajwib'at k'e'en ko tumin, ak' tas sko wa'a, yik wach' max honh chami, xchi heb' winh.
Ix tak'wi winhaj José t'a heb' winh icha tik: --Tato manhxa k'e'en he tumin chi', ik'ekkot nok' he molb'etzal nok', syal wak'an ixim he trigo sk'exulok nok', xchi winh.
Yuj chi', ha t'a jun ab'il chi', ix yak' nok' schej heb' winh, nok' skalnel heb' winh, nok' swakax heb' winh yet' nok' sb'uru heb' winh sk'exulok ixim trigo chi'.

Ha yuj nok' molb'etzal nok' ix ek' jun ab'il chi', palta hanheja' ay wejel. Ix b'at yalanxi heb' winh t'a winhaj José chi': --Max yal-laj ko k'ub'anel t'ayach mamin, manhxalaj k'e'en ko tumin, manhxa paxlaj nok' ko molb'etzal nok', ikxo nok' smasanil. Manhxa tas syal kak'an t'ayach, haxonhej to skak'och ko b'a yet' ko lu'um t'a yol ha k'ab'.

Kolwajanh t'ayonh, yik wach' max honh chami, max kanlaj ko lu'um tik t'a ichnhejta'. Wach' tzonh ha manel yet' lu'um, tzonh kannhej schekab'ok winh rey, syikejkanel lum lum winh b'aj tzonh munlaj chi'. Anhej to tzak' ixim trigo ko wa'a yet' inhat skawej t'a sat lu'um, yik max honh chami, yik max kanpax tzinan lu'um, xchi heb' winh t'a winhaj José chi'.

Icha chi' ix yutej winhaj José smanankanel masanil lum lum t'a heb' winh aj Egipto chi' yik tz'ochkan lum yikok winh rey. Yuj jun niwan wejel chi', ix schonhkanel sb'a heb' yet' slu'um chi'. Masanil heb' ix ochkan schekab'ok winh rey chi'.
Anhej slu'um heb' sacerdote maj smanel-laj winhaj José chi', yujto tz'ak'ji strigo heb' swa yuj winh rey chi', yuj chi' malaj slu'um heb' winh chi' ix schonheli.
Ix yalan winhaj José chi' t'a heb' anima icha tik: --Ha tikne'ik yik hexxo winh rey yet' lum he lu'um, yujto ix hex hin mankaneli. Ik'ekb'at ixim inhat, yik tzeyawej ixim.

Hato syala' jantak tzeyik' t'a lu'um, tzeyak'an chab' almul t'a junjun quintal t'a winh rey, haxo t'a ixim wajxake' almul, hata' ol elta ixim inhat ol heyawej, hanhejtona' hata' ol elta ixim ol he wa yet' heyuninal yet' masanil mach ayek' heyet'ok, xchi winh.
Yuj chi', ix yalan heb' winh icha tik: --Te wach' ha pensar mamin, hu'uj manh ol honh chamok. Ha tikne'ik, tik tzonh ochkan schekab'ok winh rey chi', xchi heb' winh.

Ichaton chi' ix yutej winhaj José yak'an jun ley chi', chab' almul yik winh rey t'a junjun quintal syak' heb' anima kajan t'a masanil yol yik Egipto chi'. Icha chi' ix ajkan jun ley chi'. Anhej heb' winh sacerdote max ak'anlaj stojol chi', yujto maj schonhel-laj slu'um heb' t'a winh rey chi'.
Masanil heb' yinhtilal winhaj Israel, ix kan heb' t'a Egipto, ix smakkan lum lum heb' t'a Gosén. Hata' ix te k'ib'cha'anh sb'isul heb'.
17 ab'il ix ek' winhaj Israel t'a Egipto chi', yuj chi', 147 ab'il sk'inal winh.

Ayik toxo wal scham winh syab'i, ix schekan winh awtajkot winhaj José. Ix yalan winh t'a winh icha tik: --Tato xajan hin wal hu'uj, ak'och ha k'ab' t'a yalanh hin xub' tik, tzak'an ha ti' t'a yichanh Dios to ol ha k'anab'ajej tas ol wal tik. Tzin tewi t'ayach to manh ol hin ha muk t'a Egipto tik,
ha t'a stz'ey b'aj mukan heb' hin mam wicham, hata' tzeyik'b'at hin niwanil tik, tze mukanem b'aj mukan heb' chi', xchi winh. --Icha chi' ol wutej mamin, xchi winhaj José chi'.
Ix yalanxi winh to syak' sti' winhaj José chi' t'a Dios, ix yak'an sti' winh chi'. Ixlajwi chi' ix em nhojan winhaj Israel chi' t'a sjolom sch'at, ix yak'an yuj diosal winh t'a Dios.

Ix ek' jab'ok stiempo'al, ix alchaj t'a winhaj José chi' to penaxo'ay winh smam winh. Yuj chi' ix b'at winh yil winh, ix yik'anb'at heb' yuninal winh schawanhil yet'ok, haton winhaj Manasés yet' winhaj Efraín.
Ayik ix alchaj t'a winhaj Israel to toxo ix ja winhaj José chi' yila', ix yak' pural sb'a winh sk'e k'ojan t'a sti' sch'at.
Ix yalan winh icha tik: --Ha Dios Syal Yuj Masanil, ha' ix sch'ox sb'a t'ayin t'a chonhab' Luz, t'a yol yik Canaán. Hata' ix yal wach' lolonel t'a wib'anh, ix yalan icha tik:

Ab' jun, tzijtum sb'isul inhtilal ol wak'a'. Ha jantak inhtilal, tzijtum nación ol ajelk'ochok. Ol wak'anpax jun lu'um tik t'ayach yet' t'a masanil heb' inhtilal chi', ol heyikej lum t'a jun'elnhej, xchi Dios chi'.

Yuj chi', ha wal chawanh uninal ix alji t'a Egipto tik ayik manto hin jawok, haton winhaj Manasés yet' winhaj Efraín, wiktaxon yaj heb' winh, icha wuninal tz'ajkan heb' winh, icha wal yaj winhaj Rubén yet' winhaj Simeón.
Ha jantakto heb' uninal toto ol aljok, ikxo ol aj heb', ha t'a smakb'en chawanh heb' yuktak heb' tik ol yik' yik heb'.
Ayik hin meltzajnak t'a Padán-aram, chamnakkan ix ha nun t'a Canaán ayik manto hin jawilaj t'a Efrata. Ha t'a sb'e'al Efrata chi' ix hin mukkan ix, xchi winh. (Ha jun lugar chi' Belén sb'i tikne'ik.)
Ixlajwi chi', ix b'at k'elan winhaj Israel chi' t'a heb' winh chawanh yuninal winhaj José chi', ix sk'anb'an winh icha tik: --Ha heb' winh tik, ¿mach heb' winh? xchi winh.

--Ha heb' winh wuninal ix yak' Dios t'ayin t'a Egipto tik, xchi winhaj José chi'. Ixlajwi chi, ix yalan winh smam winh chi': --Elokab' t'a ha k'o'ol, snitzokab'kot sb'a heb' winh t'a hin tz'ey tik yik wach' ol walkan wach' lolonel t'a yib'anh heb' winh, xchi winh.

Yujto te icham winakxo winhaj Israel chi', maxtzak yal-laj yilan winh. Yuj chi' ix nitzchajkot heb' winh yuj winhaj José chi' t'a stz'ey winh. Ix och lak'lak' winh t'a heb' winh, ix tz'ub'ji'elta sti' heb' winh yuj winh.

Ixlajwi chi' ix yalan winh t'a winhaj José icha tik: --Te maxtzak hin nalaj tato olto hach wila'. Tik wal manhok hachnhej tzato hach wila', palta ix el t'a sk'o'ol Dios to ixto wal wiloch heb' winh uninal tik, xchi winh.
Ixlajwi chi', ix yik'anelta heb' winh winhaj José chi' t'a skal yok winh smam chi', ix em nhojan winh t'a yichanh winh smam chi.

Ix yik'anxib'at heb' winh yuninal winh chi': Ha winhaj Efraín t'a swach' winh, haxo winhaj Manasés t'a sk'exanh winh. Ix yik'anb'at heb' winh b'aj ay winh smam chi'. Yuj chi' ha winhaj Efraín chi' ix kan t'a sk'exanh winhaj Israel chi', haxo winhaj Manasés ix kan t'a swach' winh.

Ayik ix yak'anb'at sk'ab' winh chi' t'a yib'anh heb' winh, kulus ix yutejb'at sk'ab' winh chi' t'a yib'anh heb' winh. Yuj chi', ha swach' winh ix k'och t'a yib'anh winhaj Efraín chi', haxo sk'exanh winh ix k'och t'a yib'anh winhaj Manasés chi', wach'chom b'ab'el winak winhaj Manasés chi'.

Ix yalan wach' lolonel winh t'a yib'anh winhaj José chi', icha tik: Ha Dios haton jun ix k'anab'ajaj yuj winh hin mam icham aj Abraham yet' winh hin mam aj Isaac, ha' tzin tanhwani yiktax ix hin alji yet' pax ix hin b'eynhejkoti.

Ha jun yángel Dios ix hin kolan t'a syahelal. Yak'okab' swach'k'olal Dios t'a yib'anh heb' winh chawanh tik, yujokab' heb' winh tzin nachajkoti, nachajokab'paxkot winh hin mam icham aj Abraham yet' winh hin mam aj Isaac. Tzijtum ol aj sb'isul yinhtilal heb' winh chawanh tik t'a sat lum lum b'aj ol kajnajok, xchi winhaj Israel chi'.

Max schalaj sk'o'ol winhaj José chi' to ha t'a yib'anh winhaj Efraín chi' ix yak'k'e swach' k'ab' winh smam chi'. Yuj chi' ix yak'lej winh yik'anel swach' k'ab' winh smam chi' t'a yib'anh winhaj Efraín chi', ix yak'ank'e winh t'a yib'anh winhaj Manasés yalani.
Ix yalan winh icha tik: --Ma'ay mamin, manh ichokta' tzutej, ha t'a winh b'ab'el tik, hata' tzak'k'e ha wach' k'ab', xchi winh.

Maj yal-laj sk'o'ol winh smam winh chi', ix yalan winh icha tik: --Wojtakxo hach wuninal. Ha winh tik, niwan chonhab' ol aj yelk'och winh t'a b'ak'inh, palta ha winh tzak'an tik yelxo wal niwan ol aj yelk'och winh t'a winh b'ab'el tik, haxo yinhtilal winh, tzijtum nación ol ajelk'ochok, xchi winh.

Ixlajwi chi', ix yalan wach' lolonel winh t'a yib'anh heb' schawanhil: --Icha tik ol aj he b'inaj yuj heb' he k'ab' heyok t'a b'ak'inh ayik ol snib'ej heb' yalan wach' lolonel t'a yib'anh junok anima: Yak'okab' swach'k'olal Dios t'a ib'anh, icha ix aj yak'an t'a winhaj Efraín yet' t'a winhaj Manasés, xcham heb', xchi winhaj Israel chi'. Ha t'a aloj wach' lolonel chi', b'ab'el ix yak' b'inaj winhaj Efraín chi' winh t'a yichanh winhaj Manasés chi'.

T'a elanhchamel ix yalanxi winh t'a winhaj José chi': --Hach wuninal, ha hin tik toxo ol hin chamok, palta aynhejoch Dios heyet'ok, aynhejpaxoch yet' heb' heyinhtilal. Ha ol hex ik'an meltzaj t'a slu'um ko mam kicham.
Swak' junxo makan makb'en t'ayach ek'to t'a yichanh yik heb' uktak, haton lum pak'an ix wik'kanek' t'a heb' amorreo t'a skal owal, xchi winhaj Israel chi' t'a winhaj José chi'.
Ixlajwi chi' ix yawtankot heb' yuninal winhaj Jacob chi' smasanil, ix yalan winh: Hex wuninal, nitzekkot he b'a t'a hin tz'ey. Ab'ek tas ol hex aj t'a yik b'ak'inh:
Nitzekkot he b'a t'a hin tz'ey, ol walan t'ayex. Ab'ek tas ol wal ha hin Israel he mam hin tik:
Hach Rubén, ha hach ton hin b'ab'el unin hach, sch'oxel sb'a wip t'ayach. Ha hach tik toxonton ay ha may, niwan elk'och t'a yichanh heb' uktak.
Ha tikne'ik, manhxalaj ol aj elk'ochi, yujto lajan hach icha junok eluma', yujto k'ixweltak ix hin utej t'a hin waynub' ayik ix hach way yet' ix schab'il wetb'eyum.
Ha hach tik hach Simeón yet' hach tik Leví, heyuktak he b'a, ha heyamk'ab' yik owal ix heyak'lab'ej ayik ix he k'ulan chukal.
Jun'elnhej malaj hin gana tzin k'och b'aj tz'och he molchajel, yujto ayik ix kot oynaj ix heyila', ix he milcham anima. Ina ayik ix kot heyowal ix he mak'k'ichaj yok nok' mam wakax.
Kotokab'kan katab' t'a heyib'anh yuj yowal he jolom chi', ina manh jab'ok tz'ok' he k'o'ol. Yuj chi' ol hex hin saklemejkanb'at t'a skal heb' heyetchonhab' Israel.
Hach wuninal Judá, ol alchaj wal wach' lolonel t'ayach yuj heb' uktak tik. Ol hach och b'inb'in t'a sjaj heb' ayoch ajk'olal t'ayach. Ol em nhojjab' heb' uktak tik t'ayach.

Lajan hach wal icha junok nok' kelem choj, ayik slajwi schi'anb'at junok nok' nok' ix smila', spaxta t'a snhak'e'en. Tz'em nhojan, tz'em kutzan t'a sat lum. Icha wal junok niwakil choj, ¿mach wal junok ol stek'b'ej sb'a hach stzuntzani?
Malaj mach syal yik'anek' sniwanil elk'ochi. Malaj mach syal yik'anek' ha k'okoch t'a yol ha k'ab', masanto ol ja jun Mach ay yiko', jun mach to masanil nación ol k'anab'ajanok.
Ol yetzb'anoch sb'uru t'a jun yib' te' uwa yelxo wal wach', ol sjuk'an spichul t'a yal uwa.
Ha yol sat, te k'ik' yilji t'a yichanh wino, haxo k'e'en ye, yelxo wal te sak t'a yichanh nok' lech.
